dialogue.en: Chloe, look over there by the shallow creek! Do you see those flickering lights?
dialogue.zh: Chloe，看那邊淺水溪流旁邊！你有看見那些閃爍跳動的光芒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Yes! They look like tiny magical fairies glowing gently in the dark.
dialogue.zh: 看見了！它們就像在黑暗中溫柔發光的微小神奇小精靈一樣。

dialogue.speaker: Tim
dialogue.en: Those are fireflies! Remember to cover our flashlight with red cellophane paper.
dialogue.zh: 那些是螢火蟲！記得把我們的手電筒罩上紅色玻璃紙喔。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Right. Red light does not hurt their sensitive eyes or disrupt their flashing signals.
dialogue.zh: 對的。紅光不會傷害它們敏感的眼睛，也不會干擾它們求偶的光信號。

dialogue.speaker: Tim
dialogue.en: Watching them float through the cool night air is like stepping into a fairy tale.
dialogue.zh: 看著它們在清涼的夜空中飄浮飛舞，就像走進了童話故事裡一樣夢幻。

vocabulary.example: Dozens of fireflies illuminated the humid meadow.
Candles flickered gently across the dining room.
Wrap the red cellophane around the torch lens.

dailyPhrase.zh: 踏入……、走進……之中。

cultureTip: 每年四月中旬至五月中旬是台灣的螢火蟲旺季。賞螢守則包含「三不一要」：不捕捉、不喧嘩、不拿強光直射，以及「要」為手電筒貼上紅色玻璃紙，愛護珍貴的生態奇觀。

topic.en: Earth Day 2026: Sustainable Living and Zero-Waste School Initiatives
topic.zh: 世界地球日：推動零廢棄校園與永續綠色實踐

situation: 4月22日世界地球日，高中環保社社長 Alex 和副社長 Brenda 正在籌辦校園減塑與自備餐具倡議活動。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Brenda, as Earth Day arrives today, our environmental club needs to move beyond mere symbolic slogans and foster tangible behavioral shifts.
dialogue.zh: Brenda，今天是世界地球日，我們的環保社不能僅停留在象徵性的口號，更要促成實質的行為轉變。

dialogue.speaker: Brenda
dialogue.en: I wholeheartedly agree. Single-use plastic waste generated from lunch takeout is one of our school's most glaring issues.
dialogue.zh: 我完全贊同。午餐外帶所產生的一次性塑膠垃圾，正是目前我們學校最刺眼的環保痛點之一。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Starting this week, we are collaborating with cafeteria vendors to offer discounts to students bringing reusable containers and tumblers.
dialogue.zh: 從這週開始，我們正與學生餐廳店家合作，為自備環保餐盒與保溫隨行杯的同學提供專屬折價優惠。

dialogue.speaker: Brenda
dialogue.en: Economic incentives work wonders. We are also setting up composting bins for organic food scraps beside the garden.
dialogue.zh: 經濟誘因往往能創造奇效。我們同時也在花園旁設置堆肥箱，用來回收果皮與廚餘殘渣。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Transforming waste into nutrient-rich soil for our campus green space beautifully illustrates the circular economy.
dialogue.zh: 將廢棄物轉化為滋養校園綠地的肥沃土壤，正是循環經濟理念最美麗生動的實踐體現。

dialogue.speaker: Brenda
dialogue.en: Every micro habit counts. When hundreds of students make mindful choices daily, the collective ecological footprint shrinks drastically.
dialogue.zh: 每一個微小的習慣都至關重要。當數百名學子每天都做出友善環境的自覺選擇，整體的生態足跡便會大幅縮減。

vocabulary.example: We need tangible results, not vague promises.
Tax incentives encouraged families to install solar panels.
Deforestation poses a catastrophic ecological crisis.

dailyPhrase.zh: 創造奇蹟、產生不可思議的絕佳效果。

cultureTip: 4月22日是全球公認的世界地球日（Earth Day），源於1970年美國大規模環境保護抗議。現今倡導「循環經濟（Circular Economy）」與「減塑零廢棄（Zero Waste）」，強調個人微行動能凝聚巨大的環境變革力量。

topic.en: World Book and Copyright Day: Celebrating the Magic of Reading
topic.zh: 世界閱讀與版權日：沉浸在文學世界的心靈啟迪

situation: 4月23日世界閱讀日，校園圖書館舉辦換書沙龍，Victor 和 Irene 分享一本深刻影響自己世界觀的小說。

dialogue.speaker: Victor
dialogue.en: Irene, what book did you bring to today's World Book Day exchange salon?
dialogue.zh: Irene，你今天帶了哪一本書來參加世界閱讀日的換書沙龍呢？

dialogue.speaker: Irene
dialogue.en: I brought Harper Lee's classic novel, 'To Kill a Mockingbird'. It deeply shaped my perspective on empathy and moral integrity.
dialogue.zh: 我帶了哈波李的經典小說《梅岡城故事》。它深深塑造了我對同理心與道德誠信的看法。

dialogue.speaker: Victor
dialogue.en: A masterpiece indeed! In our digital era dominated by fifteen-second short clips, deep reading has become an endangered art.
dialogue.zh: 確實是一部不朽名作！在當今充斥著十五秒短影音的數位時代，深度閱讀幾乎成了一種瀕危的藝術。

dialogue.speaker: Irene
dialogue.en: Precisely. Scrolling provides transient dopamine hits, whereas reading a book allows you to inhabit someone else's mind across centuries and borders.
dialogue.zh: 精闢。滑手機只會提供短暫的多巴胺刺激，但讀一本書卻能讓你跨越世紀與國界，走進另一個靈魂的心靈世界。

dialogue.speaker: Victor
dialogue.en: I brought Orwell's '1984' in return. Engaging with challenging prose sharpens our critical thinking against misinformation.
dialogue.zh: 我則帶了歐威爾的《1984》作為交換。閱讀深邃有挑戰性的散文著作，能磨礪我們抵抗假訊息的思辨力。

dialogue.speaker: Irene
dialogue.en: A quote from George R.R. Martin says it best: 'A reader lives a thousand lives before he dies; the man who never reads lives only one.'
dialogue.zh: 作家喬治馬丁的名言說得最貼切：『讀書的人在死前能活過一千種人生；而不讀書的人，一輩子只能活一次。』

vocabulary.example: Literature helps young minds develop deep empathy for others.
Online fame is often superficial and transient.
Great actors inhabit their characters completely.

dailyPhrase.zh: 塑造某人的世界觀與思考角度。

cultureTip: 4月23日是聯合國教科文組織設立的「世界圖書與版權日（World Book and Copyright Day）」，這一天正是大文豪莎士比亞（William Shakespeare）與塞萬提斯（Miguel de Cervantes）的逝世紀念日。在西班牙加泰隆尼亞，傳統上這天男女會互贈玫瑰與書籍。

topic.en: Community Charity Flea Market: Giving Old Toys New Life
topic.zh: 社區公益跳蚤市場：賦予舊玩具與書籍全新生命

situation: 週末社區活動中心前舉辦二手跳蚤市集，Sammy 和 Noah 佈置好自己的小攤位，販賣保存完好的繪本與積木玩具。

dialogue.speaker: Sammy
dialogue.en: Noah, our folding table looks so organized with handwritten price tags on every item!
dialogue.zh: Noah，我們的折疊桌擺得好整齊，每樣物品上都貼著手寫的可愛標價卡呢！

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: I wiped down all the wooden puzzle blocks and board games until they shone like new.
dialogue.zh: 我把所有的木質拼圖積木和桌遊都擦得乾乾淨淨，亮得跟新的一樣。

dialogue.speaker: Sammy
dialogue.en: Look, a mother and her young daughter are walking over to check out our illustrated fairy tale books.
dialogue.zh: 你看，一位媽媽和她的小女兒正好走過來翻看我們的童話繪本呢。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Good morning! These picture books are twenty dollars each, or three for fifty dollars!
dialogue.zh: 早安！這些精美繪本一本二十元，買三本只要五十元喔！

dialogue.speaker: Sammy
dialogue.en: Pass on pre-loved treasures instead of dumping them in landfills. It feels so rewarding!
dialogue.zh: 把珍愛過的二手寶物傳承下去，而不是丟進垃圾掩埋場，這種感覺真有成就感！

vocabulary.example: We found vintage comic books at the weekend flea market.

vocabulary.zh: 二手但保存完好的、曾被珍愛過的
vocabulary.example: She opened an online boutique selling pre-loved clothes.

vocabulary.zh: 有意義的、令人有成就感的
vocabulary.example: Volunteering at the shelter is deeply rewarding work.

dailyPhrase.zh: 徹底擦拭乾淨。

cultureTip: 西方文化廣泛使用「Pre-loved（二手但滿載愛心與回憶）」取代帶有陳舊感的「second-hand」，在跳蚤市場中傳遞物件的生命力與環保減廢理念。

topic.en: Weekend Baking Fun: Fresh Strawberry Tarts
topic.zh: 週末烘焙時光：酸甜可口的手作草莓水果塔

situation: 週六午後，Mason 和 Ella 在廚房跟著媽媽一起做春日草莓水果小甜點塔。

dialogue.speaker: Mason
dialogue.en: Ella, the baked tart crusts just came out of the oven. They smell so buttery!
dialogue.zh: Ella，剛烤好的塔皮出爐囉。聞起來奶油香氣好濃郁呀！

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: Let them cool for ten minutes first. I finished whipping the vanilla custard cream.
dialogue.zh: 先讓它們放涼十分鐘。我剛剛已經把香草卡士達醬打得綿滑細緻了。

dialogue.speaker: Mason
dialogue.en: I carefully washed and sliced these sweet, ruby-red strawberries.
dialogue.zh: 我仔細把這些香甜如紅寶石般的草莓清洗乾淨並切成薄片了。

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: Let's pipe the cream inside each crust and arrange strawberry slices in a flower pattern!
dialogue.zh: 我們把卡士達擠進每個塔皮裡，然後把草莓片排成盛開花朵的圖案吧！

dialogue.speaker: Mason
dialogue.en: Dust a little powdered sugar on top! It looks like a dessert from a fancy French café!
dialogue.zh: 最後在頂部灑上一層糖粉！這看起來簡直就像高級法國咖啡館賣的精緻甜點！

vocabulary.example: The pie crust was golden and exceptionally flaky.
Warm vanilla custard pairs beautifully with berry tarts.
Dust the chocolate cake with icing sugar.

dailyPhrase.zh: 剛從烤箱新鮮出爐。

cultureTip: 春季是草莓季尾聲，手作烘焙（Home Baking）是美式與歐式家庭極受歡迎的親子週末活動，藉由量秤原料與裝飾甜點培養孩子的專注力與美感。

topic.en: Secretly Preparing a Mother's Day Card and Gift
topic.zh: 悄悄籌劃母親節禮物：手作賀卡與感恩驚喜

situation: 距離五月的母親節只剩兩週，Oliver 和 Maya 在文具店挑選水彩紙與緞帶，策劃一場溫馨的驚喜。

dialogue.speaker: Oliver
dialogue.en: Mother's Day is coming up in two weeks, Maya. Have you thought of a surprise for your mom?
dialogue.zh: Maya，再過兩週就是母親節了。你想好要給你媽媽什麼驚喜了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I am designing a handmade pop-up card featuring a bouquet of carnations and warm gratitude messages.
dialogue.zh: 我正在設計一張手工立體卡片，裡面會有一束立體的康乃馨花束和溫暖的感謝詞。

dialogue.speaker: Oliver
dialogue.en: That is so touching! Store-bought gifts are convenient, but handmade crafts carry unique warmth.
dialogue.zh: 那太感人了！買現成的禮物固然方便，但親手做的手作工藝卻擁有無可替代的溫度。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: My brother and I also decided to secretly clean the entire house and cook breakfast on Mother's Day morning.
dialogue.zh: 我和我哥哥還決定，要在母親節那天早晨偷偷把整間屋子打掃乾淨，並親手做早餐給媽媽吃。

dialogue.speaker: Oliver
dialogue.en: Relieving mothers of their daily chores is truly the greatest gift of all.
dialogue.zh: 幫媽媽分擔卸下平時繁瑣的家務勞動，真的是最棒、最貼心的母親節禮物了。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Let's pick out some pastel watercolor paper and silk ribbons to start crafting right away!
dialogue.zh: 那我們趕快挑選一些柔和色調的水彩紙和絲綢緞帶，今天就開始動手做吧！

vocabulary.example: Pink carnations symbolize unconditional motherly love.
She expressed heartfelt gratitude to her supportive family.
The nursery was painted in soft pastel shades.

dailyPhrase.zh: 帶有獨一無二的溫度。

cultureTip: 每年五月的第二個星期日是母親節（Mother's Day）。安娜·賈維斯（Anna Jarvis）推廣康乃馨（Carnation）作為象徵，粉色與紅色康乃馨象徵對母親的感恩與祝福。

topic.en: Visiting the Modern Art Exhibition: Interpreting Visual Language
topic.zh: 參觀現代藝術特展：品味色彩與當代視覺語言的交會

situation: 週日午後，高中生 Ethan 和 Natalie 漫步於市立美術館的當代藝術特展，欣賞抽象表現主義畫作。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: Natalie, observe this massive abstract canvas. The bold, sweeping strokes of crimson juxtaposed with deep indigo are electrifying.
dialogue.zh: Natalie，看看這幅巨大的抽象油畫畫布。鮮紅大膽的粗獷筆觸與深邃靛藍並列對比，視覺衝擊力十足。

dialogue.speaker: Natalie
dialogue.en: It is mesmerizing. Many visitors find abstract art baffling because they look for literal representation instead of emotional resonance.
dialogue.zh: 真令人著迷。很多參觀者覺得抽象藝術令人費解，是因為他們執著於尋找具象實物，而不是去體會情感共鳴。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: Well stated. Art doesn't merely replicate reality like a camera; it translates inner subconscious states into texture and rhythm.
dialogue.zh: 說得真好。藝術絕非像相機一樣單純複製現實，而是將內在潛意識狀態轉譯為質地與節奏。

dialogue.speaker: Natalie
dialogue.en: The museum's curator noted that this artist painted during a transitional era of rapid urbanization.
dialogue.zh: 美術館策展人在導覽中特別提到，這位藝術家是在城市化劇烈轉型的動盪時期創作此作品的。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: Knowing that context transforms chaotic splatters into a poignant commentary on modern isolation and vitality.
dialogue.zh: 了解了時代背景之後，眼前看似混亂的顏料潑灑，瞬間昇華為對現代孤獨與生命力深刻的哲學詰問。

dialogue.speaker: Natalie
dialogue.en: Art broadens our intellectual horizons by challenging us to embrace ambiguity rather than demanding immediate answers.
dialogue.zh: 藝術之所以能開拓我們的心靈視野，正是因為它引導我們擁抱曖昧與留白，而非急於索求唯一的標準答案。

vocabulary.zh: 並置、把……並列以形成對比
vocabulary.example: The exhibition juxtaposes classical sculptures with modern neon lights.

vocabulary.zh: 令人著迷的、引人入勝的
vocabulary.example: Her mesmerizing performance captivated the entire auditorium.

vocabulary.zh: 深刻感人的、令人心酸震撼的
vocabulary.example: The documentary ended with a poignant reflection on world peace.

dailyPhrase.zh: 開闊眼界、拓展視野。

cultureTip: 欣賞當代藝術（Contemporary Art）講求「Open Interpretation（開放式詮釋）」。不同於古典寫實畫派，現代藝術著重激發觀者的情感觸動與哲學思辨，提供超越語言的視角碰撞。

topic.en: Friendly Badminton Match After School: Energetic Rally
topic.zh: 放學後的友誼羽球賽：揮灑汗水與歡笑的激烈對打

situation: 春日放學後，Ryan 和 Jenny 來到活動中心羽球場，進行一場活力充沛的友誼單打對抗。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Jenny, are you ready for our three-set badminton match? I have my favorite carbon racket!
dialogue.zh: Jenny，準備好我們的三局羽球賽了嗎？我帶了我最喜歡的碳纖維球拍喔！

dialogue.speaker: Jenny
dialogue.en: You bet! Let me serve first. Watch out for my high backhand serve!
dialogue.zh: 當然囉！由我先發球。小心我又高又深的反手發球！

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Nice hit! Here comes a quick smash right over the net!
dialogue.zh: 擊得好！看我越過球網的迅猛扣殺！

dialogue.speaker: Jenny
dialogue.en: Got it! Wow, that was an intense twenty-shot rally! My heart is pounding with excitement.
dialogue.zh: 接到了！哇，這波二十球來回對打太激烈了！我的心臟興奮得撲通撲通狂跳。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Exercising with good friends after school is the absolute best way to stay healthy and energetic.
dialogue.zh: 放學後跟好朋友一起盡情運動，絕對是維持健康與滿滿活力的最棒方式。

vocabulary.example: He re-strung his tennis racket before the tournament.
Her winning smash landed right on the baseline.
Spectators gasped at the breathtaking thirty-shot rally.

dailyPhrase.zh: 那是當然！/ 一點也沒錯！

cultureTip: 羽毛球（Badminton）起源於英國伯明頓莊園，在亞洲尤其是台灣非常普及。羽毛球運動能同時訓練眼手協調、敏捷度與心肺耐力，是最受歡迎的全民運動之一。

topic.en: Spring Night Sky: Identifying the Big Dipper and Arcturus
topic.zh: 春季夜空觀星指南：尋找北斗七星與大角星的璀璨軌跡

situation: 春末晴朗無雲的涼爽夜晚，Tony 和 Clara 坐在學校操場看台上，拿著星圖認辨春季大三角與星座。

dialogue.speaker: Tony
dialogue.en: Look up, Clara! The night sky is crystal clear tonight without a single cloud obstructing our view.
dialogue.zh: Clara，抬頭看！今晚的夜空澄澈如水晶，連一朵遮擋視野的烏雲都沒有呢。

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: High overhead, the seven bright stars of the Big Dipper form a distinctive gigantic ladle shape.
dialogue.zh: 在頭頂正上方，北斗七星的七顆明亮恆星排列成一個醒目的巨大湯杓形狀。

dialogue.speaker: Tony
dialogue.en: Do you know how to find the Spring Great Arc? Follow the graceful curve of the ladle handle outwards.
dialogue.zh: 你知道怎麼找『春季大曲線』嗎？順著勺柄那條優雅的弧線向外延伸。

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: Oh, it leads straight to that blazing orange-red star! That must be Arcturus in Boötes!
dialogue.zh: 哇，弧線筆直指引到那顆閃耀著橙紅色光芒的亮星！那一定就是牧夫座的大角星！

dialogue.speaker: Tony
dialogue.en: Bingo! Continue the arc further down, and you will hit Spica, the blue-white diamond star in Virgo.
dialogue.zh: 答對了！順著弧線繼續往下延伸，你就會看見室女座如藍白鑽石般閃爍的角宿一星。

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: Tracing cosmic patterns in the celestial expanse makes our worldly troubles feel so insignificant.
dialogue.zh: 在浩瀚無垠的星空中描繪宇宙的軌跡，真的會讓我們平時世俗的煩惱顯得微不足道。

vocabulary.example: The Big Dipper resembles a cosmic celestial ladle.

vocabulary.zh: 天體的、天空的、宇宙神聖的
vocabulary.example: Astronomers study celestial bodies through optical telescopes.

vocabulary.zh: 微不足道的、無關緊要的
vocabulary.example: Our personal worries seemed insignificant under the vast galaxy.

dailyPhrase.zh: 如水晶般澄澈剔透、一清二楚。

cultureTip: 春季星空的代表就是「春季大曲線（Spring Great Arc）」：從北斗七星（Big Dipper）勺柄延伸，依序經過牧夫座「大角星（Arcturus）」與室女座「角宿一（Spica）」，再連到烏鴉座，是初學者必學的觀星口訣。

topic.en: Saying Goodbye to April: Welcoming the Vitality of May
topic.zh: 告別四月：迎向充滿生機與初夏微熱的五月

situation: 四月份的最後一天放學時刻，Eric 和 Mia 站在校門口的大榕樹下，回顧四月的收穫並期待初夏五月。

dialogue.speaker: Eric
dialogue.en: Can you believe today is already the last day of April, Mia? Time really flies!
dialogue.zh: Mia，你能相信今天已經是四月的最後一天了嗎？時間過得真飛快！

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: It certainly does! We weathered our midterm exams and had so many fun outdoor adventures.
dialogue.zh: 真的！我們順利挺過了期中考試，也經歷了許多有趣的戶外冒險探索。

dialogue.speaker: Eric
dialogue.en: The air already feels noticeably warmer, and cicadas will soon start singing in the trees.
dialogue.zh: 空氣已經能明顯感覺到溫暖微熱了，樹上的蟬鳴很快也要響起了呢。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: May will bring Mother's Day, vibrant dragon boat races preparations, and early summer vibes.
dialogue.zh: 五月將帶來溫馨的母親節、熱鬧的端午龍舟賽籌備，還有初夏明朗的氣息。

dialogue.speaker: Eric
dialogue.en: Farewell, gentle April! Let's greet sunny May with open arms and big smiles!
dialogue.zh: 再見了，溫柔的四月！讓我們張開雙臂與燦爛笑容，迎接陽光普照的五月吧！

vocabulary.zh: 經受住、平安度過（考驗或風浪）
vocabulary.example: The resilient community weathered the fierce storm successfully.
Loud buzzing cicadas signaled the arrival of hot summer.
They bade a fond farewell to their exchange students.

dailyPhrase.zh: 熱情地、竭誠歡迎地。

cultureTip: 英語格言常說「April showers bring May flowers（四月微雨催開五月繁花）」，寓意暫時的困難與耕耘必將迎來美好豐碩的成果。四月終曲象徵暮春落幕與初夏起點。

topic.en: Labor Day: Honoring Campus & Community Workers
topic.zh: 五一勞動節：感謝校園與社區默默奉獻的工作者

situation: 5月1日勞動節早晨，Justin 和 Bella 在校門口向警衛叔叔和清潔阿姨親切問好並送上感謝卡片。

dialogue.speaker: Justin
dialogue.en: Good morning, Bella! Did you remember to bring our handmade thank-you cards today?
dialogue.zh: 早安，Bella！你今天有記得帶我們親手做的感謝卡片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Bella
dialogue.en: Yes! Today is International Labor Day, a wonderful occasion to honor essential workers.
dialogue.zh: 有呀！今天是國際勞動節，正是向所有辛勞付出基層工作者致敬的最好節日。

dialogue.speaker: Justin
dialogue.en: Mr. Lin, our campus security guard, greets every student with a cheerful smile regardless of rainy or scorching weather.
dialogue.zh: 我們學校的警衛林叔叔，不論颳風下雨還是烈日當空，總是帶著溫暖親切的微笑迎接每位同學。

dialogue.speaker: Bella
dialogue.en: And the janitors work tirelessly to keep our hallways and restrooms clean and hygienic.
dialogue.zh: 還有清潔阿姨們不知疲倦地辛勤打掃，維持走廊與洗手間的乾淨衛生。

dialogue.speaker: Justin
dialogue.en: Saying a sincere thank you and sorting our trash properly is the best way to show our deep appreciation.
dialogue.zh: 發自內心向他們說聲謝謝，並且在日常做好垃圾分類，就是表達我們真摯感謝的最好方式。

vocabulary.zh: 不知疲倦地、孜孜不倦地
vocabulary.example: Volunteers worked tirelessly through the night after the earthquake.
Food must be prepared in clean, hygienic conditions.
We rested under a shady gazebo during the scorching noon heat.

dailyPhrase.zh: 不管……、無論……情況如何。

cultureTip: 5月1日是國際勞動節（International Workers' Day），源自1886年美國芝加哥勞工爭取每日八小時工作制的奮鬥。全世界許多國家都在這天向各行各業默默付出的勞動者表達敬意。

topic.en: Summer Wardrobe Switch: Short Sleeves & Breathable Cotton
topic.zh: 初夏衣櫥整理：換上涼爽舒適的純棉短袖

situation: 五月初氣溫明顯上升，Leo 和 Mia 正在整理抽屜，把冬天的厚毛衣收好，換上輕便的短袖衣服。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Mia, feel the sunshine today! It is definitely warm enough to wear short sleeves.
dialogue.zh: Mia，感受一下今天的陽光！天氣絕對暖和到可以穿短袖囉。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: I agree! I packed away my heavy knitted sweaters in storage boxes yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 我贊成！我昨天已經把厚重的針織毛衣通通收進收納箱裡了。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: I love soft cotton T-shirts. They are lightweight and soak up sweat easily.
dialogue.zh: 我最喜歡柔軟的純棉 T 恤了。又輕便而且很容易吸汗。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: Don't forget to put on a wide-brim hat when we play outdoors at noon.
dialogue.zh: 中午在戶外操場玩耍時，也別忘了戴上一頂寬邊遮陽帽喔。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Sunscreen and water bottles are packed too. Summer vibes are here!
dialogue.zh: 防曬乳和水壺也都帶齊了。初夏的活力氣息真的來了！

vocabulary.example: Pack a lightweight jacket for the summer evening breeze.
Apply sunscreen generously before heading to the beach.
Cotton towels soak up water quickly.

dailyPhrase.zh: 收拾整理妥當並收納儲藏。

cultureTip: 初夏換季被稱為「Seasonal wardrobe switch」。在日照增強的五月，選擇透氣純棉（breathable cotton）材質、隨身攜帶水壺與防曬乳（sunscreen），是維持夏日活力的健康必修課。

topic.en: Planning a Weekend Cycling Picnic: Homemade Cold Brew Lemon Tea
topic.zh: 初夏單車野餐趣：親手沖調冰鎮薄荷檸檬紅茶

situation: 週五放學時，David 和 Chloe 相約週六沿著水岸綠道騎車野餐，並分工準備野餐便當與冷飲。

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.en: The weather forecast predicts clear blue skies with moderate humidity tomorrow. Perfect for our riverside cycling tour!
dialogue.zh: 氣象預報說明天會是晴空萬里且濕度適中。正是我們水岸單車之旅的絕佳好日子！

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Fantastic! I am prepping a large insulated flask filled with homemade cold brew black tea, fresh lemon slices, and garden mint.
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！我正打算準備一大個保溫瓶，裝滿親手做的冷萃紅茶，再丟幾片新鮮檸檬薄片與現摘薄荷葉。

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.en: That sounds incredibly refreshing. I will bring whole-wheat turkey sandwiches and crunchy apple slices.
dialogue.zh: 那聽起來絕對消暑解渴極了。我會準備全麥火雞肉三明治和香脆的現切蘋果片。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Let's spread our picnic mat under the big banyan tree by the lake around eleven thirty.
dialogue.zh: 那我們大約十一點半在湖畔那棵大榕樹下的蔭涼處鋪開野餐墊吧。

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.en: Remember to strap a portable Bluetooth speaker onto your handlebar so we can enjoy some acoustic tunes.
dialogue.zh: 記得在你的龍頭把手上固定一台便攜藍牙喇叭，這樣沿路就能聽點輕快的木吉他音樂了。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Cycling and good music in early summer breeze—it doesn't get much better than that!
dialogue.zh: 在初夏微風中騎單車伴隨好音樂——人生最愜意的事莫過於此了！

vocabulary.example: The insulated travel mug kept the coffee steaming hot.

vocabulary.zh: 清涼解渴的、令人神清氣爽的
vocabulary.example: A cold shower was immensely refreshing after rugby practice.
Keep both hands firmly on the handlebar while riding downhill.

dailyPhrase.en: It doesn't get much better than this.
dailyPhrase.zh: 再好也不過如此了 / 沒有比這更棒的了。

cultureTip: 自製冷萃茶（Cold Brew Tea）以常溫或冷水浸泡茶葉數小時，能萃取出茶葉的清甜芳香，同時大幅降低苦澀味與單寧酸釋出，是夏日健康解熱的低卡新風尚。

topic.en: Star Wars Day: May the Fourth Be with You & Inspiring Creativity
topic.zh: 星際大戰日：願原力與你同在！激發無窮想像力

situation: 5月4日「星際大戰日」，Kevin 和 Emma 在美勞角用紙筒和玻璃紙製作彩色光劍道具。

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: May the Fourth be with you, Emma! Today is the unofficial worldwide Star Wars Day!
dialogue.zh: Emma，願原力與你同在！今天可是全球非官方的星際大戰日喔！

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: May the Force be with you too! That pun based on 'May fourth' and 'May the Force' is pure genius.
dialogue.zh: 願原力也與你同在！那個用『五月四號』和『願原力』諧音做成的雙關語真是太天才了。

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: Look at my DIY lightsaber. I used a sturdy cardboard tube wrapped in shiny silver foil and blue paper.
dialogue.zh: 你看我的自製光劍。我用了一根結實的紙筒，外面裹上閃亮的銀色錫箔紙與藍色紙。

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: Mine has a bright green crystal core, just like Master Yoda's weapon.
dialogue.zh: 我的光劍則配有翠綠色的能量水晶核心，就像尤達大師的武器一樣帥氣。

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: Science fiction movies make us wonder about space travel and the mysteries of deep galaxies.
dialogue.zh: 科幻電影真的總能激發我們對太空旅行和遙遠銀河奧秘的無窮好奇心。

vocabulary.example: Dad loves telling cheesy puns that make everyone groan.
The Jedi ignited his glowing lightsaber in the dark hall.
The Hubble telescope captured images of distant spiral galaxies.

dailyPhrase.en: May the Force be with you.
dailyPhrase.zh: 願原力與你同在。（經典祝福與激勵語句）

cultureTip: 每年5月4日是全球知名的「Star Wars Day（星際大戰日）」，源自電影名言「May the Force be with you（願原力與你同在）」與「May the Fourth be with you（五月四日伴隨你）」的趣味英式諧音雙關。

topic.en: Lixia Solar Term: Welcoming Summer, Savoring Green Beans & Beating the Heat
topic.zh: 立夏節氣：告別春天、迎接初夏熱情與綠豆消暑

situation: 時逢二十四節氣中的「立夏」，Ethan 和 Grace 在烹飪教室談論傳統立夏習俗與初夏生理保養。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: Grace, today on the lunar calendar is Lixia, the Start of Summer! Spring has officially passed the baton.
dialogue.zh: Grace，今天是農曆節氣中的『立夏』！春天已經正式把接力棒交給夏天了。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Indeed. 'Li' means commencement; crops will grow with vigorous speed fueled by abundant sunshine and rainfall.
dialogue.zh: 確實。『立』代表開始；農作物在充足的陽光與雨水滋潤下，將以旺盛的速度拔節生長。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: In ancient lore, people held 'weighing ceremonies' on Lixia to monitor health and ward off summer illness.
dialogue.zh: 古代民間在立夏這天有『秤人』的傳統，透過記錄體重來祈求整個夏季平安健朗、不消瘦。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: My family also simmers a pot of mung bean soup with barley to soothe internal heat and stay hydrated.
dialogue.zh: 我們家立夏也會熬一鍋綠豆薏仁湯，用來清熱降火解毒，讓身體隨時補足水分。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: Traditional Chinese medicine emphasizes that summer is associated with the heart, making calm emotional balance crucial.
dialogue.zh: 中醫也強調『夏氣與心氣相通』，所以在初夏炎熱之際保持內心寧靜平和格外重要。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Staying cool-headed when temperatures rise is ancient wisdom that never loses its relevance.
dialogue.zh: 當氣溫節節攀升時保持冷靜從容，這份古老智慧在現代依然歷久彌新。

vocabulary.example: The solar term marks the commencement of the hot agricultural season.

vocabulary.zh: 充滿活力的、強健有力的
vocabulary.example: Young plants display vigorous growth under bright daylight.

vocabulary.zh: 沉著冷靜的、不慌不亂的
vocabulary.example: A good captain stays cool-headed during a maritime crisis.

dailyPhrase.zh: 交棒、交接傳承責任或時序。

cultureTip: 立夏是夏季的第一個節氣，意味著春天的結束與盛夏的啟程。江南傳統有「立夏嘗三鮮、立夏秤人」的習俗，飲食上強調清熱健脾，多食綠豆（mung beans）、苦瓜等清涼食材。

topic.en: Morning Jog Around the Campus Track: Energizing the Day
topic.zh: 晨光運動：操場晨跑與呼吸微熱的新鮮空氣

situation: 早自習前，Lucas 和 Lily 繫緊鞋帶，在學校紅色 PU 跑道上輕鬆慢跑兩圈，喚醒身心。

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.en: Good morning, Lily! Let's jog two laps around the running track before homeroom.
dialogue.zh: 早安，Lily！在早自習開始前，我們去操場慢跑兩圈吧。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: Great idea! Morning air in May feels crisp, and dew is still sparkling on the grass.
dialogue.zh: 好點子！五月的晨風很清爽，草地上還閃爍著晶瑩的露珠呢。

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.en: Keep a steady pace. Breathe in through your nose and breathe out through your mouth.
dialogue.zh: 保持穩定的步伐。用鼻子深吸氣，再用嘴巴緩慢吐氣。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: Running makes my heart pump faster and shakes away all my morning sleepiness.
dialogue.zh: 跑步讓我的心臟更有力地跳動，把早上的睏意全趕跑了。

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.en: We crossed the finish line! Now my brain is wide awake and ready for classes.
dialogue.zh: 我們跑過終點線了！現在我的大腦完全清醒，準備好迎接今天的課堂了。

vocabulary.example: He ran three laps around the school oval every morning.
Morning dew gleamed like diamonds on spiderwebs.

vocabulary.zh: 完全清醒的、毫無睡意的
vocabulary.example: A cold washcloth left him wide awake.

dailyPhrase.zh: 完全清醒、精神奕奕。

cultureTip: 運動生理學證實，早晨進行 10~15 分鐘的中低強度有氧慢跑（aerobic jog），能刺激多巴胺與血清素釋放，提升全天的注意力集中度與學習情緒。

topic.en: Digital Discipline & Overcoming Post-Exam Slump: Restoring Focus
topic.zh: 數位自律與專注力重構：克服考後鬆懈倦怠與維持步調

situation: 期中考放榜兩週後，高二學生 Ryan 和 Claire 討論許多同學陷入怠惰拖延的現象，並分享如何重建專注節奏。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Claire, have you noticed that classroom energy has hit an alarming slump now that midterm grades are finalized?
dialogue.zh: Claire，你有注意到期中考成績結算後，班上整體學習氛圍出現了令人擔憂的集體低迷嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: Definitely. It is the classic post-exam psychological valley—the relief of finishing causes students to indulge in frictionless smartphone scrolling.
dialogue.zh: 確實如此。這是典型的考後心理低谷期——考完後的解脫感讓人容易放縱在無摩擦的手機短影音刷屏中。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Short-form content hijack our prefrontal cortex through intermittent reinforcement, making deep reading feel unbearable.
dialogue.zh: 短影音透過間歇性獎勵機制劫持我們的前額葉皮質，讓耗費心力的深度閱讀變得難以忍受。

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: To counter that, I instituted a mandatory 'device-free zone' from eight to ten in the evening at my study desk.
dialogue.zh: 為了對抗這種情況，我給自己設立了硬性規定：每晚八點到十點在書桌實施『無電子設備區』。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Physical isolation of temptation is infinitely more reliable than relying on raw, depleting willpower alone.
dialogue.zh: 把誘惑在物理空間上隔絕開來，比起單純依賴容易消耗殆盡的個人意志力，要可靠幾百倍。

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: Consistent incremental progress beats frantic cramming every time. We need to stay anchored for finals.
dialogue.zh: 持之以恆的每日漸進累積，永遠勝過考前抱佛腳的臨時抱佛腳。我們必須為六月的期末考穩住陣腳。

vocabulary.zh: 無摩擦阻力的、毫不費力的
vocabulary.example: Algorithmic apps are engineered for frictionless continuous consumption.
Wearing safety helmets is mandatory by local law.
Small incremental habits accumulate into extraordinary outcomes.

dailyPhrase.zh: 陷入低谷、陷入低潮倦怠期。

cultureTip: 行為心理學中著名的「Friction Design（摩擦力設計）」指出：要戒除壞習慣，只需增加其行動難度（例如將手機放在不同房間）；要建立好習慣，則減少其摩擦力（如桌上只放當前要讀的課本）。

topic.en: Handmade Clay Carnations: Forever Blooms for Mom
topic.zh: 母親節前夕的手工花藝：用輕黏土製作永不凋謝的粉色康乃馨

situation: 母親節前夕的美術課上，Ben 和 Ruby 用超輕黏土捏製精緻的花瓣，做一朵獻給媽媽的康乃馨。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Ruby, look at my soft pink lightweight clay. It is so easy to knead and mold!
dialogue.zh: Ruby，看我的粉紅色超輕黏土。捏起來好柔軟好塑形呀！

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.en: Pinch the edges with a clay tool to make frilly flower petals like a real carnation.
dialogue.zh: 用黏土雕刻工具把邊緣捏出褶皺，這樣花瓣看起來就像真正的康乃馨了。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: I layered eight little petals around a green floral wire stem.
dialogue.zh: 我在一根綠色花藝鐵絲花莖周圍，一層層疊上了八片小花瓣。

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.en: Tie a silky purple bow at the bottom. Real flowers wilt, but our clay flowers last forever!
dialogue.zh: 在底部繫上一條優雅的紫色絲帶。鮮花會枯萎，但我們的黏土花永遠不會凋謝！

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: My mom will love putting this on her bedside nightstand.
dialogue.zh: 我媽媽一定會非常喜歡把它擺在她床頭櫃上的。

vocabulary.example: Carnation petals have delicate frilly borders.
Without regular watering, the flowers wilted rapidly.
She placed an alarm clock on her wooden nightstand.

dailyPhrase.zh: 歷久彌新、永遠長存不衰。

cultureTip: 康乃馨（Carnation）的花瓣邊緣帶有天然的鋸齒波紋（frilly edges）。手作永生花（forever blooms）因蘊含孩子親手雕塑的時間與心意，已成為母親節極受家長珍藏的禮物。

topic.en: Mother's Day Eve: Secretly Preparing a Hearty Breakfast Menu
topic.zh: 母親節前夕秘密大作戰：全家人策劃暖心早餐菜單

situation: 週六傍晚，Nathan 和 Zoe 關上房門，悄悄核對明天清晨為媽媽準備「驚喜早餐床頭端送」的食材清單。

dialogue.speaker: Nathan
dialogue.en: Keep your voice down, Zoe! Mom is reading in the living room. Let's finalize tomorrow's Mother's Day breakfast plan.
dialogue.zh: 聲音小聲點，Zoe！媽媽正在客廳看書。我們趕快把明天的母親節早餐計畫定案下來吧。

dialogue.speaker: Zoe
dialogue.en: All right. Dad agreed to wake up at six thirty to brew hazelnut coffee and fry crispy bacon.
dialogue.zh: 好的。爸爸已經同意早上六點半起床煮香濃榛果咖啡，並煎香脆培根。

dialogue.speaker: Nathan
dialogue.en: I will handle the scrambled eggs with creamy melted cheddar and chopped scallions.
dialogue.zh: 那我就負責炒滑嫩的美式嫩蛋，裡面加濃郁切達起司和切碎的青蔥。

dialogue.speaker: Zoe
dialogue.en: And I will toast golden sourdough bread and arrange strawberries into a cute heart shape on the plate.
dialogue.zh: 我負責烤金黃酥脆的酸種麵包，並把新鮮草莓在盤子裡排成一顆可愛的愛心形狀。

dialogue.speaker: Nathan
dialogue.en: We will serve everything on a wooden tray with our handmade card before Mom even steps out of bed.
dialogue.zh: 在媽媽還沒起床下床前，我們就用木質托盤端著早餐與手寫卡片送進她房間！

dialogue.speaker: Zoe
dialogue.en: Breakfast in bed will give Mom the royal pampering she genuinely deserves after working so hard all year.
dialogue.zh: 『床上享用愛心早餐』能讓媽媽享受皇后般的尊榮寵愛，她整年辛苦付出絕對值得這樣的待遇。

vocabulary.example: Garnish the steamed fish with finely sliced scallions.
Mom enjoyed a day of spa pampering on her milestone birthday.
The committee met to finalize the graduation schedule.

dailyPhrase.zh: 床上早餐（西方家庭給母親或壽星的經典貼心驚喜禮遇）。

cultureTip: 在美加文化中，「Breakfast in bed（在床上端送早餐）」是母親節最經典的家庭傳統，孩子與伴侶負責包辦廚房所有烹調與洗碗工作，讓母親徹底放鬆睡到自然醒。

topic.en: Happy Mother's Day! Thank You for Your Endless Love and Hugs
topic.zh: 母親節快樂！媽媽，謝謝您無微不至的愛與溫暖擁抱

situation: 母親節早晨，Tyler 拿著卡片和康乃馨走進媽媽房間，給媽媽一個大大的擁抱並大聲說出愛。

dialogue.speaker: Tyler
dialogue.en: Happy Mother's Day, Mom! Here is a lovely bouquet of pink carnations for you!
dialogue.zh: 媽媽，母親節快樂！這一束美麗的粉紅色康乃馨是送給您的！

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: Oh Tyler, they are gorgeous! Come here and let me give you a giant warm hug.
dialogue.zh: 噢 Tyler，它們太漂亮了！快過來讓媽媽給你一個大大的溫暖擁抱。

dialogue.speaker: Tyler
dialogue.en: I wrote a poem inside this card thanking you for packing my lunch and cheering at my soccer games.
dialogue.zh: 我在卡片裡寫了一首小詩，感謝您每天為我做愛心便當，還在足球比賽時為我大聲加油。

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: Seeing you grow kind, curious, and healthy is the greatest happiness a mom could ever ask for.
dialogue.zh: 看著你健康、善良、充滿好奇心地茁壯長大，就是媽媽能期盼的最大幸福了。

dialogue.speaker: Tyler
dialogue.en: Today you don't have to lift a finger. Sit back and let us take care of everything!
dialogue.zh: 今天您完全不用動手做家事。好好坐著休息，一切交給我們全包了！

vocabulary.example: The sunset over the ocean looked absolutely gorgeous.

vocabulary.zh: 充滿好奇心的、好學求知的
vocabulary.example: Curious students ask thoughtful questions during class.
He ordered a vibrant bouquet of fresh spring blossoms.

dailyPhrase.zh: 什麼家事都不必動手、好好歇著享福。

cultureTip: 每年五月的第二個星期日是國際母親節。一句溫暖的「You don't have to lift a finger today（今天您什麼家事都不用動手）」是孩子表達孝心與體貼最常說的英文暖心佳句。

topic.en: Observing Summer Insects: Rhinoceros Beetles & Stag Beetles
topic.zh: 初夏昆蟲記：光臘樹上的獨角仙與鍬形蟲覓食

situation: 校園生態池後方的光臘樹旁，Sam 和 Olivia 拿著放大鏡，觀察樹幹上正在吸食樹汁的獨角仙。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Olivia, check out the ash tree bark! A shiny dark brown rhinoceros beetle is crawling upward.
dialogue.zh: Olivia，快看光臘樹的樹皮！一隻油亮黑褐色的獨角仙正在往上爬呢。

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.en: Wow, look at its magnificent Y-shaped horn! It looks like a brave miniature samurai knight.
dialogue.zh: 哇，看它雄偉壯觀的 Y 字型大角！簡直像一位英勇無畏的迷你武士盔甲騎士。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Right beside it, a stag beetle with giant pincer-like jaws is sipping sweet tree sap.
dialogue.zh: 就在它旁邊，還有一隻長著巨大鉗狀大顎的鍬形蟲，正津津有味吸食甜甜的樹汁呢。

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.en: Remember our teacher's guideline: observe them gently with our eyes and never capture or hurt them.
dialogue.zh: 要記得老師提醒我們的生態守則：用眼睛溫柔觀察就好，絕對不要捕捉或傷害它們。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Definitely! Protecting their natural habitat lets these amazing armored creatures flourish every summer.
dialogue.zh: 當然！保護好它們的天然棲地，才能讓這些披著堅固盔甲的神奇小精靈年年夏天生生不息。

vocabulary.example: The snow-capped mountains presented a magnificent sight.
Crabs defend themselves with sharp pincers.
Beetles have tough armored exoskeletons.

dailyPhrase.zh: 瞧瞧、查看一下……。

cultureTip: 獨角仙（Rhinoceros Beetle）與鍬形蟲（Stag Beetle）是夏日最具代表性的昆蟲。台灣光臘樹（Griffith's Ash）分泌的汁液是牠們的最愛。推廣「只觀察不捕捉（Catch and release / Observation only）」是現代環境保育的核心素養。

topic.en: International Nurses Day: Honoring the Compassion of Healthcare Workers
topic.zh: 國際護理師節：向白衣天使致敬與同理醫護奉獻

situation: 5月12日國際護師節，高三醫學社社長 Julian 和社員 Hannah 共同策劃校內醫護職業座談與感恩特展。

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: Hannah, today is International Nurses Day, commemorating Florence Nightingale's revolutionary founding of modern professional nursing.
dialogue.zh: Hannah，今天是國際護理師節，紀念南丁格爾開創現代專業護理體系的革命性貢獻。

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: Her legacy transcends statistics and sanitization. Nursing embodies the rare intersection of rigorous clinical expertise and radical human empathy.
dialogue.zh: 她的遺產遠超越衛生統計數字。護理專業體現了嚴謹臨床醫學專長與極致人文同理心的罕見交會。

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: Yet society frequently romanticizes their sacrifice as mere 'angels' while turning a blind eye to chronic understaffing and burnout.
dialogue.zh: 然而社會往往將他們的奉獻過度浪漫化為純粹的『白衣天使』，卻常常忽視了護理體系長期的缺工過勞與身心倦怠。

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: True gratitude necessitates advocating for equitable nurse-to-patient ratios and providing institutional psychological support.
dialogue.zh: 真正的感謝必須落實在制度保障上：積極倡議合理護病比，並提供體制內的心理諮商與支持資源。

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: When a patient faces agonizing uncertainty in an intensive care unit, a nurse's soothing voice is often the steady beacon of hope.
dialogue.zh: 當病患在加護病房面對病痛與未知恐懼時，護理師溫和堅定的聲音往往是支撐生命希望的最穩燈塔。

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: Let our exhibition illuminate both the immense dignity of this profession and the urgent systemic reforms it deserves.
dialogue.zh: 希望我們的展覽既能展現這份職業崇高無比的尊嚴，也能喚起大眾對改善護理勞動環境體制改革的重視。

vocabulary.example: Great works of art transcend national boundaries and time.
Workplace burnout among frontline nurses requires systemic reform.
The lighthouse stood as a beacon of safety for stormy vessels.

dailyPhrase.zh: 視而不見、對問題故意閉上眼睛。

cultureTip: 5月12日是現代護理學先驅「提燈天使」佛羅倫斯·南丁格爾（Florence Nightingale）的誕辰，定為「國際護師節（International Nurses Day）」，推動改善護理執業環境與保障護理人員尊嚴。

topic.en: Water Balloon Fun: Cool Splashes & Laughter on a Sunny Afternoon
topic.zh: 初夏水球大作戰：清涼水花與陽光下的歡笑聲

situation: 炎熱的週三下午，Daniel 和 Chloe 在自家後院草坪灌滿了五彩繽紛的小水球，準備展開一場清涼的水戰遊戲。

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.en: Chloe, I attached the garden hose to this filler nozzle and made thirty water balloons in two minutes!
dialogue.zh: Chloe，我把花園水管接上快速注水噴頭，兩分鐘就灌好了三十顆小水球！

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: They look like squishy colorful eggs floating in the bucket. Ready, aim, splash!
dialogue.zh: 它們看起來就像泡在水桶裡軟綿綿的彩色蛋。預備，瞄準，潑水！

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.en: Direct hit on my shirt! Wow, that cold water feels so refreshing under the blazing sun!
dialogue.zh: 直接命中我的上衣！哇，在火辣辣的太陽下，這冰涼的水花感覺太舒暢了！

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Here comes another yellow balloon arching through the air. Catch it if you can!
dialogue.zh: 又有一顆黃色水球在空中劃過一道弧線飛過去囉。能抓到的話就接住吧！

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.en: After our water fight, let's pick up every broken rubber piece so the birds won't eat them.
dialogue.zh: 打完水球仗之後，我們要把地上的每一片破氣球橡膠皮撿乾淨，以免小鳥誤食。

vocabulary.example: The ripe peach was deliciously sweet and squishy.
The athletes jogged despite the blazing afternoon heat.
Twist the nozzle to adjust the water spray pattern.

dailyPhrase.zh: 預備，瞄準，發射水花！

cultureTip: 水球大戰（Water Balloon Fight）是美式文化中夏日派對的經典活動。遊戲後主動撿拾氣球碎片（broken rubber pieces）避免野生動物誤食，是戶外活動重要的環保責任。

topic.en: Campus Mosquito Prevention Poster: Keeping Classrooms Safe & Tidy
topic.zh: 校園防蚊大作戰：宣導清除積水容器與登革熱防護

situation: 夏初氣溫攀升梅雨季前夕，衛生股長 Jason 和副衛生股長 Maya 繪製宣傳海報，教導大家杜絕病媒蚊滋生。

dialogue.speaker: Jason
dialogue.en: Maya, our teacher asked us to design a colorful safety poster about preventing dengue fever.
dialogue.zh: Maya，老師請我們設計一張色彩鮮艷的宣導海報，宣導預防登革熱病媒蚊。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Great project. As summer approaches, mosquitoes multiply rapidly in stagnant puddles and discarded cups.
dialogue.zh: 很棒的任務。隨著夏季來臨，蚊子會在積水水窪與廢棄紙杯中大量繁殖。

dialogue.speaker: Jason
dialogue.en: Let's highlight the golden four-step rule: inspecting, flipping, clearing, and brushing containers.
dialogue.zh: 我們把關鍵的『巡、倒、清、刷』四步驟做成醒目的大圖示標記出來吧。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I will draw a cross over flowerpot saucers holding murky rainwater to show potential breeding sites.
dialogue.zh: 我會在積滿混濁雨水的花盆底盤上打一個大大的紅叉，提醒大家那是潛在的蚊卵孳生溫床。

dialogue.speaker: Jason
dialogue.en: A clean campus protects every student from itchy bites and infectious diseases.
dialogue.zh: 乾淨清爽的校園環境能保護每一位同學免於發癢叮咬與傳染病威脅。

vocabulary.zh: 停滯不動的、死水汙濁的
vocabulary.example: Mosquito larvae thrive in stagnant ditch water.
Empty standing water from flowerpot saucers weekly.
Washing hands reduces the transmission of infectious viruses.

dailyPhrase.zh: 快速繁殖、成倍倍增。

cultureTip: 登革熱（Dengue fever）由埃及斑蚊與白線斑蚊傳播。台灣衛福部疾管署推廣的「巡、倒、清、刷（inspect, empty, clean, scrub）」是國際公認杜絕病媒蚊孳生源最有效且低成本的防護方法。

topic.en: International Day of Families: Meaningful Dinner Conversations Across Generations
topic.zh: 國際家庭日：放下手機，重拾圍坐餐桌的深層交流

situation: 5月15日國際家庭日當晚，Leo 和 Jessica 討論各自家庭推行的「晚餐免手機專注時刻」。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Jessica, today is the United Nations International Day of Families. Did your household do anything special?
dialogue.zh: Jessica，今天是聯合國國際家庭日。你們家有做什麼特別的安排嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Jessica
dialogue.en: Yes! We initiated a 'phone basket' ritual before dinner—everyone deposits their gadgets in a wicker basket until dessert finishes.
dialogue.zh: 有呀！我們在開飯前啟動了『手機籃儀式』——每個人都把手機放進編織竹籃裡，直到吃完甜點前都不准拿。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: That is admirable. So often family members sit at the same table yet stare blankly at their respective screens.
dialogue.zh: 太令人佩服了。常常看見家人雖然圍坐同張餐桌，眼神卻各自茫然盯著自己的發光螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: Jessica
dialogue.en: Without notifications chiming, we actually listened to my grandfather recount anecdotes from his childhood fishing village.
dialogue.zh: 沒有了叮咚響的通訊推播干擾，我們認真聽了爺爺講述他小時候在漁村長大的童年冒險趣事。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Shared storytelling builds deep empathy and strengthens emotional bonds across generations far more than texting.
dialogue.zh: 共同分享回憶故事所凝聚的同理心與代際情感連結，遠遠勝過冰冷的文字傳訊。

dialogue.speaker: Jessica
dialogue.en: Quality presence is truly the rarest and most precious gift we can offer our loved ones.
dialogue.zh: 專注而真誠的陪伴，確實是我們能給予至親至愛最罕見也最珍貴的無價禮物。

vocabulary.example: Uncle Joe delighted the dinner guests with funny travel anecdotes.
Students returned quietly to their respective homerooms.
Your supportive presence meant the world to her during the audition.

dailyPhrase.zh: 跨越世代、兩代或三代之間。

cultureTip: 5月15日是聯合國訂定的「國際家庭日（International Day of Families）」。近年家庭教育專家大力倡導「Unplugged Dinner（無插電餐桌時光）」，藉由收起智慧型裝置，讓家人重新凝視彼此的雙眼與對話。

topic.en: Visiting the Local Farmers' Market: Fresh Summer Watermelons & Mangoes
topic.zh: 初夏農夫市集尋寶：品嘗在地香甜西瓜與金黃愛文芒果

situation: 週六上午，Eric 和 Mia 陪媽媽來到社區農夫市集，空氣中飄散著熟成熱帶水果的濃郁果香。

dialogue.speaker: Eric
dialogue.en: Mia, smell that incredible sweet aroma in the air! Summer tropical fruits have arrived!
dialogue.zh: Mia，聞聞空氣中那股令人垂涎的香甜果香！夏天的熱帶水果正式登場了！

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: Look at these pyramids of ripe Irwin mangoes! Their skin is a blend of ruby red and sunset gold.
dialogue.zh: 看這些堆成金字塔般的小山愛文芒果！果皮呈現紅寶石與夕陽金黃交織的色澤呢。

dialogue.speaker: Eric
dialogue.en: The friendly farmer tapped a giant striped watermelon with his knuckles. It produced a deep hollow thump.
dialogue.zh: 親切的果農阿伯用指節輕敲一顆巨大的條紋西瓜，發出低沉渾厚的咚咚聲。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: That sound means it is bursting with crisp red flesh and sweet cold juice.
dialogue.zh: 那種沉沉的聲音代表裡面的紅果肉飽滿爽脆、多汁香甜！

dialogue.speaker: Eric
dialogue.en: Buying produce directly from local farmers reduces food miles and guarantees unmatched freshness.
dialogue.zh: 直接向在地小農購買當季蔬果，既能大幅減少食物里程，又能享受到無可比擬的新鮮美味。

vocabulary.example: He rapped gently on the wooden door with his knuckles.
A ripe watermelon makes a resonant, hollow sound when tapped.
Shopping locally shortens food miles and cuts carbon emissions.

dailyPhrase.zh: 充滿、洋溢著……。

cultureTip: 挑選西瓜時以指節敲擊（tapping with knuckles），若聲音如拍打胸膛般沉渾有彈性（hollow sound），表示水份充盈熟度適中。購買在地當季水果（local seasonal produce）能大幅縮短食物里程（food miles）。

topic.en: World Telecommunication Day: Data Privacy & Digital Literacy in the AI Era
topic.zh: 世界電信與資訊社會日：AI 時代的數據隱私與數位素養

situation: 5月17日世界電信日，高二電腦資訊研究社社員 Alex 和 Brenda 正在辯論演算法推送與大數據隱私外洩風險。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Brenda, on this World Telecommunication Day, global networks have evolved from simple telephone cables into hyper-connected AI systems.
dialogue.zh: Brenda，在世界電信日這天回顧，全球網路已從早期的銅線電話線路，演進為無所不在的高度互聯 AI 智慧系統。

dialogue.speaker: Brenda
dialogue.en: The technological leap is breathtaking, yet many young netizens blithely surrender biometric and behavioral data for temporary digital convenience.
dialogue.zh: 科技的躍進固然令人讚嘆，但許多青年網友卻為了短暫的數位便利，毫無戒心就交出自己的生物辨識與行為軌跡隱私。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: When a cloud service or recommendation app is seemingly free, the user's personal attention and predictive data profile is invariably the true product.
dialogue.zh: 當一項雲端服務或推薦演算法看似完全免費時，使用者的個人專注力與預測性行為輪廓，無疑才是被明碼標價的真正商品。

dialogue.speaker: Brenda
dialogue.en: Digital literacy today extends beyond basic coding; it encompasses critical skepticism toward algorithmic bias and deepfake synthetic media.
dialogue.zh: 當今的數位素養早已超越了基礎寫程式；它更涵蓋對演算法偏見以及深偽（Deepfake）合成多媒體保持批判性的審視意識。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Enabling two-factor authentication and auditing app tracking permissions are non-negotiable hygiene habits in cyberspace.
dialogue.zh: 開啟雙重身分驗證（2FA）並定期審視應用程式的追蹤授權，是每個人在虛擬網路空間不可或缺的基本安全衛生習慣。

dialogue.speaker: Brenda
dialogue.en: Technological sovereignty starts with conscious autonomy. We must be conscious curators of our digital lives, not passive data batteries.
dialogue.zh: 科技自主權始於清醒的自我意志。我們必須成為自身數位生活清醒的策展人，而不是被動提供數據養分的電池。

vocabulary.zh: 無憂無慮地、漫不經心地、盲目地
vocabulary.example: He walked blithely past warning signs toward the crumbling cliff.

vocabulary.zh: 總是、不變地、無一例外地
vocabulary.example: Punctual people invariably arrive five minutes ahead of schedule.
Individuals must maintain sovereignty over their personal identifiable data.

dailyPhrase.zh: 不容商榷的、必須遵守的底線原則。

cultureTip: 5月17日是世界電信和資訊社會日（World Telecommunication and Information Society Day）。矽谷名言「If you are not paying for the product, you are the product（如果你沒為產品付費，你本身就是商品）」深刻揭示了現代免費大數據演算法背後的隱私代價。

topic.en: International Museum Day: How Immersive Technology Transforms Heritage Preservation
topic.zh: 國際博物館日：沉浸式科技如何重新定義文化遺產參訪體驗？

situation: 5月18日國際博物館日，Victor 和 Irene 參觀結合虛擬實境與全息投影的歷史特展後走出展廳。

dialogue.speaker: Victor
dialogue.en: Irene, walking through that digitally reconstructed Tang Dynasty palace was mind-bending. The architectural details felt so palpable!
dialogue.zh: Irene，漫步在數位全息重建的唐代宮殿光影中，太震撼了。那些木構建築細節逼真得彷彿觸手可及！

dialogue.speaker: Irene
dialogue.en: It marks a paradigm shift for International Museum Day. Museums are no longer dusty mausoleums of static artifacts behind glass.
dialogue.zh: 這標誌著國際博物館日的一次典範轉移。博物館不再只是把靜態古物冰冷陳列在玻璃櫥窗後的古老陵墓了。

dialogue.speaker: Victor
dialogue.en: Interactive haptic exhibits allow visitors to touch virtual three-dimensional scans of delicate bronze vessels without causing deterioration.
dialogue.zh: 互動觸覺感應展覽讓參觀者能夠『撫摸』脆弱青銅古文物的虛擬 3D 掃描模型，卻不會造成任何實體磨損裂化。

dialogue.speaker: Irene
dialogue.en: However, we must ensure flashy multimedia doesn't eclipse historical authenticity or trivialise profound civilizational narratives.
dialogue.zh: 然而，我們也必須警惕：過度炫目的多媒體聲光效果，絕不能掩蓋歷史本真的沉靜力量，或將深刻的文明敘事扁平娛樂化。

dialogue.speaker: Victor
dialogue.en: Well observed. Technology serves as a bridge, inviting contemporary audiences to converse with ancestors across millennia.
dialogue.zh: 觀察很深刻。科技應當是一座引路橋樑，引導當代觀眾跨越數千年時空，與古老先哲展開深層靈魂對話。

dialogue.speaker: Irene
dialogue.en: When ancient relics evoke empathetic resonance, history stops being cold facts and transforms into living collective memory.
dialogue.zh: 當千年古文物喚醒內心深處的同理共鳴時，歷史便不再是冰冷枯燥的課本考題，而是化為鮮活流動的集體記憶。

vocabulary.zh: 可感知的、易察覺的、觸手可及的
vocabulary.example: The tension in the debate hall was almost palpable.

vocabulary.zh: 陵墓、沉悶幽閉的大建築
vocabulary.example: The historic monument looked solemn like an imperial mausoleum.
Proper humidity control prevents parchment deterioration.

dailyPhrase.zh: 思維範式轉移、根本性的觀念革新。

cultureTip: 每年5月18日是由國際博物館協會（ICOM）發起的世界博物館日（International Museum Day）。近年主題聚焦於「科技賦能博物館（Museums, Technology & Innovation）」，透過 VR 與元宇宙技術讓沉睡的文化瑰寶活起來。

topic.en: Summer Afternoon Thunderstorm: Splashing Drops & the Brilliant Rainbow
topic.zh: 初夏午後雷陣雨：豆大雨點與雨後放晴的大彩虹

situation: 午後三點天空突然烏雲密布，傾盆雷雨過後放晴，Mason 和 Ella 跑到教室走廊欄杆旁看天邊的彩虹。

dialogue.speaker: Mason
dialogue.en: Ella, listen to that loud thunder rolling across the dark clouds! Boom!
dialogue.zh: Ella，聽滾滾烏雲間傳來隆隆的打雷聲！轟隆！

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: Big raindrops are splashing loudly on the glass windows like popcorn popping.
dialogue.zh: 豆大的雨滴劈劈啪啪打在玻璃窗上，好像爆米花在鍋裡跳動一樣。

dialogue.speaker: Mason
dialogue.en: Summer afternoon thundershowers always come quickly and leave just as fast.
dialogue.zh: 初夏的午後西北雨總是來得快，走得也一樣匆匆。

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: Look outside now! The sun broke through, and a double rainbow is arching across the sky!
dialogue.zh: 現在看窗外！太陽穿透雲層照射出來了，天空掛著一道壯觀的雙彩虹呢！

dialogue.speaker: Mason
dialogue.en: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet! The rain cooled down the heat completely.
dialogue.zh: 紅橙黃綠藍靛紫！這場雨把夏日的悶熱完全沖刷得清涼舒適了。

vocabulary.example: A sudden thundershower caught pedestrians without umbrellas.
Indigo dye gives denim jeans their iconic dark shade.
The innermost band of a rainbow shines in soft violet.

dailyPhrase.zh: 降溫、冷卻涼爽下來。

cultureTip: 初夏台灣常見俗稱「西北雨」的午後對流雷陣雨（convective thundershowers），通常持續不到一小時，雨過天青後因空氣中水氣豐沛，常在東方天際形成鮮豔奪目的彩虹（Rainbow）甚至霓虹（Double rainbow）。

topic.en: The '520' Phenomenon: Expressing Gratitude and Appreciation to Friends & Family
topic.zh: 「520」諧音文化：向身邊珍視的同儕與家人大方表達感激與愛

situation: 5月20日午後，Oliver 和 Maya 在圖書館自習室互傳小便利貼，探討數字諧音背後的暖心文化。

dialogue.speaker: Oliver
dialogue.en: Maya, check out social media today. People are posting cute cards and messages with the number 520 everywhere.
dialogue.zh: Maya，你看今天的社群動態。大家到處都在轉發寫著數字 520 的可愛卡片和文字呢。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: That is because the Mandarin pronunciation of 'five-two-zero' sounds just like 'I love you'!
dialogue.zh: 那是因為中文裡『五二零』的發音，聽起來就跟『我愛你』非常像呀！

dialogue.speaker: Oliver
dialogue.en: Number homophones are fascinating in modern pop culture, like 1314 meaning 'forever and ever.'
dialogue.zh: 現代流行文化裡的數字諧音真的很巧妙，就像 1314 代表『一生一世』一樣。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Beyond romantic relationships, today is an uplifting excuse to voice gratitude to supportive best friends and parents.
dialogue.zh: 除了情侶之間，今天其實也是向一路力挺自己的摯友和爸媽大方表達感謝的絕佳契機。

dialogue.speaker: Oliver
dialogue.en: Many people find saying 'I love you' awkward in everyday life, so a playful digital pun softens the barrier.
dialogue.zh: 很多人平時當面說『我愛你』會覺得難為情，這種俏皮好玩的數字雙關語剛好降低了開口的尷尬防線。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Never hesitate to tell the people who uplift you how much you truly cherish them!
dialogue.zh: 永遠別吝嗇向那些支持鼓勵你的人說出：你有多麼珍視有他們相伴的日子！

vocabulary.example: 'Flour' and 'flower' are classic English homophones.
I will forever cherish our golden middle school memories.

vocabulary.zh: 令人振奮的、激勵人心的
vocabulary.example: Her uplifting speech motivated the entire graduating class.

dailyPhrase.zh: 絕不要猶豫去……、大方勇敢地去……。

cultureTip: 華語網路文化發展出獨特的「數字諧音文化（numerical wordplay）」，如 520（我愛你）、1314（一生一世）、88（拜拜）。5月20日被年輕世代視為「網路情人節」與感恩互道溫暖的非官方佳節。

topic.en: Xiaoman Solar Term: Grain Buds, Nature's Abundance & the Philosophy of Moderation
topic.zh: 小滿節氣：麥粒漸滿、萬物繁茂的謙遜與「小得盈滿」哲學

situation: 二十四節氣迎來「小滿」，Ethan 和 Natalie 在校園花園長椅探討節氣背後蘊含的東方中庸之道哲理。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: Natalie, today is Xiaoman, or 'Grain Buds,' the eighth solar term in the twenty-four solar terms cycle.
dialogue.zh: Natalie，今天正是『小滿』，二十四節氣當中的第八個節氣。

dialogue.speaker: Natalie
dialogue.en: The name refers to grain seeds beginning to plump up and swell, though they are not completely ripe yet.
dialogue.zh: 這個名字代表田裡的穀物種子已經開始日漸飽滿鼓起，不過尚未到達完全熟透的金黃階段。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: Did you notice that while we have Lesser Cold and Greater Cold, or Minor Heat and Major Heat, there is no 'Daman' or 'Major Fullness'?
dialogue.zh: 你有發現二十四節氣中有小寒大寒、小暑大暑，卻唯獨只有『小滿』，從來沒有『大滿』嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Natalie
dialogue.en: Yes! Ancient philosophy holds that when the moon is full, it begins to wane; when water overflows, it spills.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯！古代東方哲學認為『月滿則虧，水滿則溢』，物極必反。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: So 'Xiaoman'—being slightly plump but leaving room for modest growth—is considered the ideal state in life.
dialogue.zh: 因此『小滿』——也就是將滿未滿、保有適度謙遜進步餘裕的狀態，被視為人生最圓滿安定的至高境界。

dialogue.speaker: Natalie
dialogue.en: Cultivating contentment with what we have while striving for self-improvement is timeless wisdom.
dialogue.zh: 對眼前擁有的知足感恩，同時又保有一顆踏實追求自我進步的心，這正是歷久彌新的智慧。

vocabulary.example: The blueberries plumped up sweetly after recent rain.
Public enthusiasm for the trend began to wane.
True contentment comes from meaningful connections, not material riches.

dailyPhrase.zh: 為……預留彈性與進步空間。

cultureTip: 小滿（Grain Buds）在二十四節氣中獨具哲思。古人講求「小得盈滿，大滿則溢」。「二十四節氣唯有小滿，無大滿」體現了中華文化追求中庸（moderation）與謙遜知足的最高處世美學。

topic.en: International Day for Biological Diversity: Safeguarding Endemic Species & Coral Reefs
topic.zh: 國際生物多樣性日：守護珊瑚礁與台灣特有種生態網絡

situation: 5月22日國際生物多樣性日，生物研習社社長 Kevin 和副社長 Audrey 正在整理墾丁珊瑚礁與台灣黑熊保育調查報告。

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: Audrey, today marks the International Day for Biological Diversity. Our island boasts astonishing biodiversity despite covering merely zero point zero two percent of Earth's landmass.
dialogue.zh: Audrey，今天是國際生物多樣性日。我們這座島嶼雖然僅占全球陸地面積的萬分之二，卻孕育了令人驚嘆的生物多樣性密度。

dialogue.speaker: Audrey
dialogue.en: From the subtropical lowlands to high alpine peaks, our endemic species like the Formosan black bear and Mikado pheasant are global ecological treasures.
dialogue.zh: 從亞熱帶平原一路延伸到三千公尺高山苔原，台灣黑熊與帝雉等特有種是全球矚目的生態寶藏。

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: However, ocean warming caused widespread coral bleaching off the southern coast, threatening marine nurseries.
dialogue.zh: 然而近年海水持續異常升溫，導致南海岸爆發大規模珊瑚白化危機，重創了海洋生物最核心的育苗庇護所。

dialogue.speaker: Audrey
dialogue.en: Coral reefs support a quarter of all marine life. When symbiotic algae detach due to thermal stress, entire trophic cascades collapse.
dialogue.zh: 珊瑚礁支撐著全球四分之一的海洋生物。當共生藻因熱壓力而脫離時，整個食物鏈營養級連鎖反應都會崩解。

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: Biodiversity isn't merely scenic wallpaper; it is our planetary life-support system purifying water, cycling carbon, and pollinating agriculture.
dialogue.zh: 生物多樣性絕非僅是風景桌布；它實質上是為我們淨化水源、循環碳素、為農業授粉的地球核心維生系統。

dialogue.speaker: Audrey
dialogue.en: Preserving nature's intricate web requires designating marine protected areas and eliminating habitat fragmentation before it is irreversibly severed.
dialogue.zh: 守護自然這張錯綜複雜的生命之網，迫切需要劃設海洋保護區並終止棲地破碎化，免得生態鏈遭受不可逆的斷裂。

vocabulary.zh: 特有的、地方特產的（生物）
vocabulary.example: The Formosan blue magpie is endemic to the mountain forests of Taiwan.
Marine biologists recorded severe coral bleaching across the reef.
Road construction causes severe habitat fragmentation for wildlife.

dailyPhrase.zh: 支撐了……的四分之一（比例）。

cultureTip: 5月22日是聯合國「國際生物多樣性日（International Day for Biological Diversity）」。台灣因地形垂直高差近四千公尺，單位面積物種豐富度居全球前茅，擁有超過千種特有種生物（Endemic species）。

topic.en: World Turtle Day: Ditching Plastic Straws to Protect Marine Giants
topic.zh: 世界海龜日：拒絕一次性塑膠吸管，守護海龜悠游

situation: 5月23日世界海龜日，Sammy 和 Noah 在自然走廊張貼小琉球綠蠵龜的照片，呼籲大家自備不鏽鋼吸管。

dialogue.speaker: Sammy
dialogue.en: Noah, today is World Turtle Day! Look at this breathtaking underwater photo of a green sea turtle gliding through waves.
dialogue.zh: Noah，今天是世界海龜日！看這張令人屏息的水下攝影：一隻綠蠵龜正優雅滑翔在碧藍波浪中。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Sea turtles have roamed Earth's oceans for over a hundred million years, surviving the age of dinosaurs!
dialogue.zh: 海龜漫遊在地球海洋已經超過一億年了，連恐龍時代的大滅絕牠們都挺過來了！

dialogue.speaker: Sammy
dialogue.en: Yet discarded plastic bags floating in water look dangerously identical to delicious jellyfish, their favorite snack.
dialogue.zh: 但漂浮在海水裡的廢棄塑膠袋，看起來危險地酷似美味的水母，而水母偏偏是牠們最愛的點心。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Plastic debris can block their digestive tracts or trap their flippers, making it impossible to swim or surface for air.
dialogue.zh: 塑膠垃圾會堵塞牠們的消化道，甚至纏住牠們的鰭狀肢，導致海龜無法游泳或浮上海面呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: Sammy
dialogue.en: By carrying our own reusable straws and cloth bags, we give these gentle ocean voyagers a cleaner, safer home.
dialogue.zh: 只要我們自備環保環保吸管與環保布袋，就能為這些溫柔的海洋旅人提供一個更乾淨安全的家園。

vocabulary.example: Sea turtles are legendary voyagers traversing vast oceans.
Volunteers collected plastic debris along the sandy shoreline.

vocabulary.zh: 完全相同的、極其相似的
vocabulary.example: The two twins wore identical yellow raincoats.

dailyPhrase.zh: 浮上水面呼吸空氣。

cultureTip: 5月23日是「世界海龜日（World Turtle Day）」，旨在喚醒大眾對海龜與陸龜生存危機的關注。台灣的小琉球是全球著名的綠蠵龜重要棲地，拒絕使用一次性塑膠袋與吸管是守護海龜的關鍵日常行動。

topic.en: Building a Living Room Blanket Fort: A Cozy Reading Nook
topic.zh: 假日的秘密基地：在客廳動手搭棉被城堡帳篷

situation: 炎熱的週日午後，Ryan 和 Jenny 把客廳沙發、椅子和薄毯子搭成一個舒適的小小秘密帳篷基地。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Jenny, pull that soft blue fleece blanket across between the armchair and the sofa!
dialogue.zh: Jenny，把那條柔軟的藍色毛毯拉平，跨在扶手椅和沙發中間！

dialogue.speaker: Jenny
dialogue.en: I secured both corners with two wooden clothes pins so the roof won't collapse.
dialogue.zh: 我用兩個木質曬衣夾把兩邊角落牢牢夾住了，這樣城堡屋頂就不會塌下來啦。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Toss in three fluffy pillows and our favorite illustrated fantasy storybooks.
dialogue.zh: 再丟進三個蓬鬆的抱枕，還有我們最喜歡的奇幻童話繪本。

dialogue.speaker: Jenny
dialogue.en: Turn on this warm fairy light string! It feels like our own magical glowing cave.
dialogue.zh: 打開這串溫暖的星光小燈串！感覺就像我們專屬的發光夢幻小山洞一樣。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Crawling inside our secret fort to read on a hot Sunday afternoon is pure fun.
dialogue.zh: 在炎熱的週日午後鑽進秘密基地裡看書，真是單純又無比快樂的享受。

vocabulary.example: The makeshift cardboard tent collapsed in the breeze.
Wrap yourself in a warm fleece throw during movie night.
She created a cozy reading nook beside the bedroom window.

dailyPhrase.zh: 純粹的樂趣、單純快樂的享受。

cultureTip: 搭棉被城堡帳篷（Building a Blanket Fort）是英美家庭極具代表性的童年室內創意遊戲。利用沙發靠墊（cushions）、床單與抱枕搭建秘密基地（secret fort），能激發孩子的空間想像力與動手能力。

topic.en: School Flood & Typhoon Safety Drill: Emergency Preparedness Steps
topic.zh: 校園防汛防颱演練：熟記汛期防災避難黃金步驟

situation: 梅雨與颱風季節即將到來，Tony 和 Clara 參加學校舉辦的防汛疏散演練，檢視防災緊急避難包。

dialogue.speaker: Tony
dialogue.en: Clara, our school is conducting a typhoon and flood drill today ahead of the plum rain season.
dialogue.zh: Clara，在梅雨季來臨前，我們學校今天正在舉行防颱防汛疏散演練呢。

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: It is so important. When heavy torrential downpours strike, urban drainage systems can easily get overwhelmed.
dialogue.zh: 這太重要了。當暴雨狂瀉襲來時，城市的排水系統很容易會難以負荷。

dialogue.speaker: Tony
dialogue.en: The fire department demonstrated how stacking sandbags in an interlocking herringbone pattern prevents basement flooding.
dialogue.zh: 消防隊員向我們示範了如何用『人字形交錯法』堆疊沙包，這樣能最有效地阻擋雨水灌入地下室。

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: Did your family check your emergency 'go-bag' with fresh drinking water, batteries, and first-aid gauze?
dialogue.zh: 你們家有檢查過防災避難包嗎？裡面要有瓶裝飲用水、備用乾電池以及急救紗布喔。

dialogue.speaker: Tony
dialogue.en: Being prepared beforehand ensures we stay calm and secure when intense tropical storms roll in.
dialogue.zh: 事前做好萬全準備，才能在強烈熱帶風暴來臨時保持沉著鎮定、化險為夷。

vocabulary.zh: 如傾盆大雨的、狂瀉暴雨的
vocabulary.example: Torrential rain triggered sudden flash floods in the valley.
City crews cleared clogged grates to improve street drainage.
Volunteers stacked heavy sandbags along the river bank.

dailyPhrase.zh: 在……之前、提前做好準備。

cultureTip: 每年五月至六月是東亞特有的「梅雨季（Plum Rain Season）」，隨後進入夏秋颱風季。消防與防災機構倡導家家戶戶備妥「緊急避難包（Emergency Go-Bag）」並熟知沙包堆疊與防汛避難指引。

topic.en: Dragon Boat Team Training: Finding the Drumming Rhythm & Sync
topic.zh: 端午龍舟隊備戰集訓：鼓點節奏與全員同心的默契划槳

situation: 距離端午節不到一個月，校園龍舟隊的 Dylan 和 Chloe 在河道碼頭練習划槳配合，領會鼓手的核心指揮作用。

dialogue.speaker: Dylan
dialogue.en: Phew, that two-kilometer training sprint was exhausting! My forearms are burning from paddling against the current.
dialogue.zh: 呼，剛剛那兩公里的衝刺訓練太拼了！逆水划槳讓我的小臂肌肉痠痛得像在燃燒一樣。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: You did great, Dylan! In our second run, all twenty paddlers finally synchronized our strokes perfectly with the drumbeats.
dialogue.zh: 你划得超棒，Dylan！在第二趟衝刺中，我們二十位划手終於把划槳動作與鼓聲節奏完美同步了。

dialogue.speaker: Dylan
dialogue.en: The drummer really dictates the soul of the dragon boat. When the rhythm accelerates, everyone digs their blades deeper simultaneously.
dialogue.zh: 鼓手真的掌握了整艘龍舟的靈魂。當鼓點節奏一加快，所有人同時把槳葉深深扎進水裡發力。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Individual strength matters, but flawless cohesion and timing propel the boat across the finish line fastest.
dialogue.zh: 個人臂力固然重要，但天衣無縫的團隊凝聚力與節奏一致性，才是推動龍舟最快衝過終點線的關鍵。

dialogue.speaker: Dylan
dialogue.en: The steersman also shouted commands to keep our narrow keel tracking dead straight without wobbling.
dialogue.zh: 站在船尾的舵手也一直在大聲喊口令，確保我們修長狹窄的龍舟龍骨筆直平穩破浪，不產生搖晃。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: One boat, one beat, one unified heartbeat. We are definitely bringing home the championship trophy next month!
dialogue.zh: 同舟共濟，同一鼓點，同一顆心。下個月我們一定能把冠軍獎盃抱回家！

vocabulary.example: Swimmers synchronized their graceful arm movements.
Team cohesion was the decisive factor in their championship win.
Powerful strokes propelled the sleek canoe across the finish line.

dailyPhrase.zh: 同頻共振、同舟共濟的團結精神。

cultureTip: 端午龍舟競渡（Dragon Boat Racing）強調高度的團隊協作（team cohesion）。船首鼓手（drummer）掌控航速節奏，划手（paddlers）需做到零秒差的「整齊劃一（synchronized strokes）」，象徵同舟共濟的力量。

topic.en: Homemade Summer Treat: Hand-washing Wild Aiyu Jelly with Fresh Lemon
topic.zh: 廚房消暑甜品：動手做手洗天然檸檬愛玉凍

situation: 初夏午後廚房裡，Ben 和 Lily 圍在裝滿冷開水的水盆旁，一起揉搓布袋裡的愛玉子製作晶瑩果凍。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Lily, I put tiny dried aiyu seeds into this clean cotton filter pouch.
dialogue.zh: Lily，我已經把乾燥的小愛玉子裝進這個乾淨的純棉濾袋裡了。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: Submerge it into the bowl of mineral water and knead it gently with clean hands.
dialogue.zh: 把它浸入裝滿礦泉水的水盆裡，然後用洗乾淨的雙手輕柔地搓揉它。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Look! The water is turning golden and slimy. The natural plant pectin is coming out!
dialogue.zh: 你看！水慢慢變成金黃色而且滑滑的了。天然的植物果膠跑出來了！

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: Chill it in the refrigerator for thirty minutes until it sets into a wobbly jelly.
dialogue.zh: 放進冰箱冷藏三十分鐘，它就會凝結成 Q 彈晃動的果凍囉。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Top it with fresh lemon juice and honey drizzle. It is the ultimate cool summer dessert!
dialogue.zh: 最後淋上新鮮檸檬汁和少許香醇蜂蜜。這簡直是夏日終極消暑甜點！

vocabulary.example: Submerge the eggs into boiling water for six minutes.

vocabulary.zh: 果膠（天然植物凝固成分）
vocabulary.example: Apples are rich in natural pectin used for making jam.
The gelatine pudding was delicious and delightfully wobbly.

dailyPhrase.zh: 在頂部淋上……或撒上配料。

cultureTip: 愛玉（Aiyu Jelly）是台灣特有的天然消暑甜品，由愛玉子（aiyu seeds）在含有鈣鎂礦物質的涼水中搓洗釋放果膠凝結而成。搭配現擠檸檬汁與蜂蜜（lemon & honey），熱量低且清涼潤喉。

topic.en: Summer Reading List: Picking Thrilling Adventure Books from the Library
topic.zh: 挑選暑前閱讀書單：在圖書館遇見冒險與科普好書

situation: 五月底放學後，Nathan 和 Zoe 來到市立圖書館，在書架前討論挑選即將到來的夏日閱讀清單。

dialogue.speaker: Nathan
dialogue.en: Zoe, the librarian just put up the 'Summer Reading Quest' showcase near the entrance!
dialogue.zh: Zoe，圖書館館員剛剛在門口附近佈置好了『夏日閱讀探索任務』的精選特展呢！

dialogue.speaker: Zoe
dialogue.en: Awesome! I am looking for exciting mystery adventure novels with puzzles and secret codes.
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！我正在尋找充滿謎題與解密暗號的精彩懸疑冒險小說。

dialogue.speaker: Nathan
dialogue.en: I picked out an illustrated encyclopedia about deep-sea marine exploration and sunken shipwrecks.
dialogue.zh: 我挑了一本關於深海深潛探索與古老沉船探秘的彩色圖解百科全書。

dialogue.speaker: Zoe
dialogue.en: Our library card allows us to borrow up to ten books for a month at a time.
dialogue.zh: 我們的借書證一次可以借多達十本書，而且能借整整一個月呢。

dialogue.speaker: Nathan
dialogue.en: Diving into thrilling stories during lazy summer afternoons is like traveling across galaxies for free.
dialogue.zh: 在悠閒的夏日午後沉浸在扣人心弦的故事裡，就像不用花半毛錢就能暢遊不同星系一樣。

vocabulary.example: Divers explored the coral-encrusted shipwreck on the ocean floor.
The astronomy encyclopedia contains detailed planetary maps.
The science museum created a showcase of renewable energy models.

dailyPhrase.zh: 沉浸在書本的精彩世界裡。

cultureTip: 歐美公共圖書館每年夏初都會舉辦「Summer Reading Challenge（夏日閱讀挑戰）」，設計閱讀集章卡與徽章獎勵，鼓勵孩子在長假期間維持閱讀習慣（prevent summer slide）。

topic.en: Sunset Jogging along the Embankment: Night Market Snacks & Summer Vibes
topic.zh: 傍晚河堤慢跑與夜市偶遇：晚風中的青春活力與消暑小吃

situation: 初夏傍晚微風徐徐，Julian 和 Hannah 沿著河堤慢跑結束後，順道走進夜市點了清爽的綜合豆花。

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: The twilight sky over the river looks like a watercolor painting blending violet and apricot hues.
dialogue.zh: 河面上的暮色天空看起來就像一幅水彩畫，交融著紫羅蘭與杏黃色的夢幻色調。

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: That five-kilometer jog felt so liberating with the evening river breeze cooling our foreheads.
dialogue.zh: 那趟五公里的慢跑感覺好舒暢自由，傍晚的河畔晚風把我們額頭上的熱汗都吹涼了。

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: Listen to the distant cheerful chatter. The weekend night market across the pedestrian bridge is buzzing!
dialogue.zh: 聽聽遠處熱鬧歡樂的喧鬧聲。人行景觀橋另一端的週末夜市已經人聲鼎沸了！

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: How about grabbing a bowl of iced tofu pudding topped with chewy taro balls and boba pearls?
dialogue.zh: 不如我們去吃一碗冰豆花吧，上面加 Q 彈的芋圓和黑糖珍珠粉圓怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: Count me in! A splash of sweet brown sugar syrup over crushed shaved ice is heaven after a good workout.
dialogue.zh: 算我一份！在滿滿的碎剉冰上淋上一勺香甜黑糖糖水，在暢快運動後簡直就是天堂般的享受。

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: Exercising hard and then enjoying delicious local street food with great friends embodies summer youth.
dialogue.zh: 盡情揮灑汗水運動，再跟好朋友一起品嘗在地街頭美食，這正是夏日青春最純粹的寫照。

vocabulary.example: Streetlights flickered on as twilight settled over the city.
Chewy purple taro balls are a favorite Taiwanese dessert topping.
The pedestrian bridge offers a safe route across the busy avenue.

dailyPhrase.zh: 充滿生機活力、熱鬧沸騰。

cultureTip: 夜市（Night Market）與河濱慢跑道是台灣初夏極具活力的生活縮影。運動後享用一碗冰鎮黑糖豆花（Iced Tofu Pudding with Taro Balls），是結合在地美食與休閒運動的經典消暑日常。

topic.en: Bridging May and June: Preparing for Final Exams and Graduation Reflections
topic.zh: 告別五月、迎向六月：期末考衝刺倒數與畢業季的青春省思

situation: 五月倒數第二天傍晚，高二學生 Sean 和 Melody 走在林蔭大道上，回顧五月的充實並為即將到來的六月期末考與學長姐畢業季做準備。

dialogue.speaker: Sean
dialogue.en: Melody, tomorrow will be the final day of May. The golden shower trees on campus are already bursting into yellow blossoms.
dialogue.zh: Melody，明天就是五月的最後一天了。校園裡的阿勃勒樹已經開滿了一串串如黃金雨般的繁花呢。

dialogue.speaker: Melody
dialogue.en: Those vibrant yellow cascades signal the bittersweet arrival of June—the season of senior graduations and comprehensive final exams.
dialogue.zh: 那耀眼的金黃花瀑標誌著六月的到來——這是一個既欣喜又帶著感傷的季節：高三學長姐即將畢業，而我們也即將面臨期末總複習考驗。

dialogue.speaker: Sean
dialogue.en: Watching the seniors rehearse their commencement ceremony reminds me that our high school journey is hurtling forward at breakneck speed.
dialogue.zh: 看著學長姐排練畢業典禮，提醒了我：我們的高中時光也正以飛快的速度向前奔馳。

dialogue.speaker: Melody
dialogue.en: That makes living intentionally even more imperative. We cannot afford to drift aimlessly through these formative years.
dialogue.zh: 這讓帶著自覺與目標生活顯得更加迫切。在這些奠定人生基礎的關鍵塑造期，我們絕不能漫無目的地隨波逐流。

dialogue.speaker: Sean
dialogue.en: Let's structure our final exam review timetable tonight, leaving ample cushion for challenging physics and literature modules.
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚就先把期末考的複習行事曆排定好，為難度較高的物理與文學單元預留充裕的時間緩衝。

dialogue.speaker: Melody
dialogue.en: Step into June with clear focus and courage. Finish this semester on an unforgettably triumphant note!
dialogue.zh: 懷抱清晰的專注力與勇氣邁入六月吧。讓我們用無懈可擊的亮麗成果，為這個學期畫下最精彩的句點！

vocabulary.zh: 苦樂參半的、喜憂交集的
vocabulary.example: Graduation is a bittersweet milestone filled with nostalgia and anticipation.

vocabulary.zh: 形成期的、具有決定性塑造影響的
vocabulary.example: High school represents a formative phase for personality and values.

vocabulary.zh: 勝利的、凱旋而歸的、成功的
vocabulary.example: The orchestra concluded the symphony on a triumphant final chord.

dailyPhrase.zh: 以極快的速度、飛快狂飆。

cultureTip: 每年五月底至六月初，台灣校園常見的「阿勃勒（Golden Shower Tree）」盛開金黃花串，隨風飄落被稱為「黃金雨」，與鳳凰花一同象徵畢業季（Graduation season）與學期總結的到來。

topic.en: World No Tobacco Day: Youth Resistance to Vaping & Promoting Respiratory Health
topic.zh: 世界無菸日：拒絕電子煙誘惑，擁抱清新純淨肺部與健康人生

situation: 5月31日世界無菸日，校園春暉健康社幹部 Kevin 和 Audrey 在朝會宣導電子煙防制與呼吸系統健康科學。

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: Audrey, today marks World No Tobacco Day. The World Health Organization is warning about insidious marketing targeting youth.
dialogue.zh: Audrey，今天是世界無菸日。世界衛生組織正嚴正警告菸草與電子煙產業針對青少年暗中開展的包裝行銷伎倆。

dialogue.speaker: Audrey
dialogue.en: Indeed. E-cigarette manufacturers aggressively promote sleek devices disguised as high-tech USB drives with fruity flavorings.
dialogue.zh: 確實如此。電子煙製造商極具侵略性地推廣偽裝成高科技隨身碟的時尚裝置，並加入水果香甜口味來降低戒心。

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: Many teens fallaciously assume vapor is merely harmless water mist, ignoring toxic heavy metals, formaldehyde, and addictive nicotine.
dialogue.zh: 許多青少年錯誤地以為煙霧只是無害的水蒸氣，卻全然無視其中深藏的重金屬毒素、甲醛以及具強烈成癮性的高濃度尼古丁。

dialogue.speaker: Audrey
dialogue.en: Pulmonary specialists have demonstrated that inhaling these heated aerosolized chemicals causes severe lung inflammation and irreversible scarring.
dialogue.zh: 胸腔科專科醫師已證實，吸入這些加熱霧化的化學成分會導致嚴重的急性肺部發炎與不可逆的肺纖維化疤痕。

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: True rebellion is not succumbing to manipulative commercial addiction; it is having the independent intellect to say no.
dialogue.zh: 真正的青春叛逆與酷，絕不是屈服於商業操弄的成癮陷阱；而是擁有獨立自主的思辨力，堅定大聲說不。

dialogue.speaker: Audrey
dialogue.en: Protect our lungs and breathe clean air freely. Clean breathing is the absolute foundation of lifelong athletic vitality and clear cognition.
dialogue.zh: 捍衛我們的肺部健康，自由呼吸純淨的空氣。清新呼吸正是終身充沛運動活力與敏銳思維認知的最根本基石。

vocabulary.zh: 潛伏暗藏的、不知不覺間為害的
vocabulary.example: High blood pressure is an insidious condition with few early warning signs.
He fallaciously assumed online rumors were verified facts.
Regular aerobic jogging enhances cardiovascular and pulmonary capacity.

dailyPhrase.zh: 堅定對……說不、拒絕……的誘惑。

cultureTip: 每年5月31日是世界衛生組織（WHO）設立的「世界無菸日（World No Tobacco Day）」。近年重點鎖定防制「電子煙（Vaping/E-cigarettes）」對青少年的毒害與成癮陷阱，推廣拒菸無菸校園環境。

topic.en: Welcoming June: Cicada Songs & Blooming Flame Trees
topic.zh: 迎接六月：初夏蟬鳴與校園鳳凰花開

situation: 六月第一天早晨，Leo 和 Mia 走進校門，看見校園角落的鳳凰木開滿了火紅的花朵。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Mia, look up at the tall flame trees by the school gate! They are covered in fiery orange blossoms!
dialogue.zh: Mia，抬頭看校門口高大的鳳凰木！上面開滿了一簇簇如火焰般鮮紅的繁花！

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: And listen! The loud, buzzing cicadas in the branches are singing together like a summer choir.
dialogue.zh: 而且你聽！樹枝間響亮鳴叫的蟬兒正齊聲合唱，就像一支夏日合唱團一樣熱鬧。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: June is officially here. It brings warm sunshine, juicy watermelons, and the countdown to summer break.
dialogue.zh: 六月正式來臨囉。它帶來溫暖明亮的陽光、多汁清甜的西瓜，還有暑假倒數的興奮心情。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: Before vacation begins, we still have our final exams and graduation farewells to prepare for.
dialogue.zh: 在放暑假之前，我們還有期末考複習和畢業歡送會要好好準備呢。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Let's work hard and make every sunny day in June count!
dialogue.zh: 讓我們全力以赴，把六月的每一個晴朗日子都過得充實精彩！

vocabulary.example: The sunset painted the evening clouds a fiery crimson.
The school choir sang melodious hymns during morning assembly.
The exciting countdown to the rocket launch began.

dailyPhrase.zh: 讓每一天都過得充實有意義、不虛度光陰。

cultureTip: 在台灣，鳳凰木（Royal Poinciana / Flame Tree）火紅綻放與初夏第一聲蟬鳴（cicada songs），正是六月畢業季（graduation season）與盛夏到來的標誌性自然象徵。

topic.en: Making Teru Teru Bozu Dolls: Wishing for Sunny Recess
topic.zh: 動手做晴天娃娃：祈禱梅雨放晴與戶外體育課

situation: 連綿陰雨的午後，Kevin 和 Emma 在美勞角用紙巾和毛線製作白色的晴天娃娃掛在窗前。

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: It has been drizzling non-stop for three days, Emma. Our soccer practice was cancelled again!
dialogue.zh: Emma，這細雨已經連綿不絕地下了三天了。我們的足球練習又被迫取消了！

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: Let's craft Japanese Teru Teru Bozu dolls out of soft white tissues and hang them by the window!
dialogue.zh: 那我們用柔軟的白面紙來做幾個日本晴天娃娃，把它們懸掛在窗邊祈求放晴吧！

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: How do we make them? Roll a tissue into a tight round ball for the head, right?
dialogue.zh: 要怎麼做呢？先把一張紙巾揉成一顆結實的圓球當作頭部，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: Exactly! Wrap another flat tissue over it, tie the neck securely with red yarn, and draw a huge smiling face.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯！外面再覆蓋一張平整的紙巾，用紅毛線把頸部綁緊，然後畫上大大的笑臉。

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: Look at him swinging in the gentle breeze! May tomorrow bring blue skies and radiant sunshine.
dialogue.zh: 看他在微風中輕輕擺動！希望明天就能迎來蔚藍的天空與明媚燦爛的陽光。

vocabulary.example: A persistent drizzle forced everyone indoors.
Grandmother knitted cozy wool mittens with colorful yarn.

vocabulary.zh: 容光煥發的、明亮燦爛的
vocabulary.example: The bride wore a radiant smile on her wedding day.

dailyPhrase.zh: 連續不斷地、馬不停蹄地。

cultureTip: 「Teru Teru Bozu（晴天娃娃）」是日本傳統手作祈晴人偶，常用白布或紙巾捏成光頭和尚造型掛在屋簷下，祈求雨過天晴、戶外活動平安順遂。

topic.en: Dragon Boat Festival Eve: Traditional Sticky Rice Dumplings
topic.zh: 端午節前夕：跟長輩學包南部粽與北部粽的傳統工藝

situation: 端午節即將到來，David 和 Chloe 在廚房跟長輩一起摺竹葉、填糯米，探討南部粽與北部粽的風味差異。

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.en: Chloe, the aroma of boiled bamboo leaves and braised pork belly in this kitchen is making my mouth water!
dialogue.zh: Chloe，廚房裡飄著煮透的竹葉清香與燉滷五花肉的香味，真讓我口水直流！

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Folding two wide bamboo leaves into a leak-proof cone shape takes real finesse. Watch Grandma's agile hands!
dialogue.zh: 把兩片寬竹葉摺成不漏米的漏斗形錐形，真的需要純熟手藝。你看奶奶敏捷俐落的手法！

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.en: Our family prefers southern-style zongzi, wrapping raw glutinous rice and boiling it until soft and chewy.
dialogue.zh: 我們家偏愛南部粽，把生糯米與餡料包好後放進大鍋沸水慢煮，口感特別軟糯香黏。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: My dad grew up with northern-style zongzi, where sticky rice is stir-fried with fragrant shallot oil before steaming.
dialogue.zh: 我爸爸則習慣吃北部粽，糯米會先用香蔥油炒香半熟，再包進竹葉放進蒸籠蒸熟，粒粒分明。

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.en: Regardless of the culinary style, tucking in salted egg yolk, shiitake mushrooms, and chestnuts is non-negotiable!
dialogue.zh: 不論料理手法如何不同，塞進金黃鹹蛋黃、香菇和香甜栗子，絕對是不可或缺的靈魂配料！

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Binding each dumpling tightly with cotton twine ensures they keep their perfect pyramid shape in the pot.
dialogue.zh: 用棉繩緊緊綁好每一顆粽子，能確保它們在滾水中依然維持完美的立體四角錐形。

vocabulary.example: Decorating wedding cakes requires immense patience and artistic finesse.
Glutinous rice is the foundational ingredient for festive dumplings.
Secure the parcel with sturdy brown postal twine.

dailyPhrase.zh: 令人垂涎三尺、食指大動。

cultureTip: 台灣端午粽有「南煮北蒸」的文化特色：南部粽（Southern Zongzi）包生米水煮，口感軟糯黏稠；北部粽（Northern Zongzi）先將米與醬汁炒香再蒸，口感粒粒分明Q彈。

topic.en: Dragon Boat Fun: Standing an Egg at Solar Noon
topic.zh: 端午節趣味習俗：正午立蛋大挑戰

situation: 端午節當天中午十二點整，Tyler 和 Amy 蹲在客廳磁磚地板上，小心翼翼嘗試讓生雞蛋直立不倒。

dialogue.speaker: Tyler
dialogue.en: Amy, the clock just struck twelve noon! Bring out the raw eggs from the kitchen!
dialogue.zh: Amy，時鐘剛剛敲響正午十二點整！快把廚房裡的生雞蛋拿出來！

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: Here is one with a slightly rough shell. It helps balance on flat tile floors.
dialogue.zh: 這一顆蛋殼表面稍微有點粗糙。在平整的磁磚地板上比較容易找到平衡點喔。

dialogue.speaker: Tyler
dialogue.en: Hold your breath and keep your fingertips steady. Don't shake!
dialogue.zh: 屏住呼吸，指尖保持平穩。千萬別抖手喔！

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: Look, I slowly let go... and it is standing upright all on its own!
dialogue.zh: 你看，我慢慢把手放開了……它居然自己穩穩地立在地面上直立不倒耶！

dialogue.speaker: Tyler
dialogue.en: Hooray! Tradition says standing an egg at noon brings good luck for the whole year!
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！民俗傳說在端午正午立蛋成功，能帶來整整一整年的好運氣呢！

vocabulary.example: Keep the delicate glass bottles upright during transit.
Gymnasts learn to balance skillfully on narrow beams.
Crack the egg shell gently on the rim of the bowl.

dailyPhrase.zh: 屏住呼吸（形容緊張專注的時刻）。

cultureTip: 端午節民間傳說在五月初五正午（solar noon），太陽引力與地心引力形成特殊平衡，此時將生雞蛋直立在地面（egg standing）代表迎來一整年的鴻運當頭。

topic.en: World Environment Day: Combating Microplastics in Marine Ecosystems
topic.zh: 世界環境日：循環經濟與對抗微塑膠海洋污染思辨

situation: 6月5日世界環境日，高二環保社社長 Ryan 和 Claire 主持校園論壇，深入探討微塑膠顆粒進入全球食物鏈的嚴峻危機。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Claire, today is United Nations World Environment Day. The global theme calls for accelerating the end of plastic pollution.
dialogue.zh: Claire，今天是聯合國世界環境日。今年的全球倡議主題呼籲全人類加速終結塑膠污染危機。

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: The crisis extends far beyond visible trash floating on shores. Microplastics—particles smaller than five millimeters—have infiltrated polar ice, deep trenches, and human bloodstreams.
dialogue.zh: 這場危機遠超越海岸邊肉眼可見的漂浮垃圾。小於五毫米的微塑膠顆粒，早已滲透進極地冰川、萬米海溝甚至人類血液循環系統中。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Synthetic fibers shed during laundry wash cycles and degrading vehicle tires are ubiquitous primary sources.
dialogue.zh: 洗衣機洗滌過程中脫落的合成人造纖維，以及磨損分解的汽車輪胎微粒，正是無所不在的主要污染來源。

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: Because plastics adsorb toxic chemical pollutants, zooplankton ingest them, biomagnifying toxins as they move up the trophic pyramid.
dialogue.zh: 由於塑膠表面極易吸附有毒化學污染物，浮游動物誤食後，毒素便會隨著食物鏈金字塔層層生物累積放大。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Downstream recycling is inherently inadequate. We must mandate extended producer responsibility and redesign circular biodegradable packaging at the source.
dialogue.zh: 下游單純依賴垃圾回收在本質上是治標不治本。我們必須立法推行生產者延伸責任（EPR），並從源頭全面重構循環可生物分解包裝。

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: Protecting our shared biosphere requires structural legal mandates paired with personal refusal of single-use convenience.
dialogue.zh: 捍衛我們共同棲居的地球生物圈，既需要嚴格的法規體制約束，也離不開每個人主動拒絕一次性塑膠便利的自覺行動。

vocabulary.example: Chemical runoff infiltrated the subterranean aquifer.

vocabulary.zh: 無所不在的、普遍存在的
vocabulary.example: Smartphones have become ubiquitous across modern society.

vocabulary.zh: 可生物分解的、環保易降解的
vocabulary.example: Cornstarch utensils are fully biodegradable and compostable.

dailyPhrase.zh: 遠遠超越……的範圍或界線。

cultureTip: 6月5日是聯合國世界環境日（World Environment Day）。當代環境科學重點聚焦「微塑膠（Microplastics）」與「生物放大效應（Biomagnification）」，倡導推動源頭減量與生產者延伸責任制度。

topic.en: Crafting Fragrant Herbal Pouches: Driving Away Mosquitoes
topic.zh: 縫製艾草香包：天然草本驅蚊與端午祈福

situation: 端午節的勞作課上，Justin 和 Bella 正在用五彩絲線縫合錦囊香包，裝滿天然艾草與石菖蒲粉末。

dialogue.speaker: Justin
dialogue.en: Bella, smell this mixture of dried mugwort, calamus, and lavender. It smells earthy and refreshing!
dialogue.zh: Bella，聞聞這份混合了乾燥艾草、石菖蒲與薰衣草的草本粉末。散發著天然質樸又舒爽的香氣！

dialogue.speaker: Bella
dialogue.en: Those traditional herbs contain natural essential oils that repel buzzing mosquitoes and gnats.
dialogue.zh: 那些傳統中草藥富含天然植物精油，能自然驅趕惱人的嗡嗡蚊蟲與小黑蚊。

dialogue.speaker: Justin
dialogue.en: I folded this embroidered silk pouch into a cute miniature triangular zongzi shape.
dialogue.zh: 我把這個繡花絲綢小香囊縫折成一個可愛的小巧三角粽形狀呢。

dialogue.speaker: Bella
dialogue.en: Thread this braided five-color cord through the top loop. The five colors symbolize harmony and good health.
dialogue.zh: 把這條編織好的五彩絲線穿過頂端的繩圈。五行五色象徵著陰陽調和與四季平安健康。

dialogue.speaker: Justin
dialogue.en: I will pin this fragrant sachet to my school backpack to ward off summer bugs all season long!
dialogue.zh: 我要把這個芬芳的小香包別在我的書包上，讓它整整個夏季都替我驅趕小蟲害！

vocabulary.example: Mugwort leaves are traditionally hung beside doorways during festivals.
She tied her hair with a colorful braided ribbon.
Lavender sachets keep wardrobe closets smelling fresh and pleasant.

dailyPhrase.zh: 驅趕蟲害、抵禦蚊蟲滋擾。

cultureTip: 端午節配戴「艾草香包（herbal sachets）」源於古代避五毒、防暑驅疫的習俗。香囊內填裝艾草、菖蒲等辛香草藥，搭配象徵五行的五彩繩（five-color cord），是華人兼具防蚊實用與祝福的美麗工藝。

topic.en: Dragon Boat Championship Finals: Snatching the Victory Flag
topic.zh: 端午龍舟總決賽現場：歡呼聲中奪標手飛身奪旗的榮耀瞬間

situation: 河濱公園碼頭觀禮看台上，Julian 和 Hannah 正屏息注視即將衝過終點線的校際龍舟冠亞軍總決賽。

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: Hannah, look at lane three and lane four! Both dragon boats are dead even as they approach the five-hundred-meter mark!
dialogue.zh: Hannah，看第三水道和第四水道！兩艘龍舟在逼近最後五百公尺標竿時幾乎完全並駕齊驅！

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: The thunderous roar of the war drums is vibrating through our chest bones! The spectators along the bank are going wild!
dialogue.zh: 戰鼓如雷鳴般的震撼轟響直撼胸膛！河岸兩旁擠滿的加油群眾全都熱血沸騰、瘋狂吶喊！

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: Our school's flag-catcher is already leaning far forward over the ornate carved dragon head, extending his right arm.
dialogue.zh: 我們學校的奪標手已經飛身跨在雕刻精美的龍頭正上方向前延伸，全力伸展右臂！

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: One final burst of rapid strokes... and he snatched the red victory flag right out of the buoy buoy!
dialogue.zh: 最後一波急促破浪的全力划槳……接到了！他從浮標上瞬間一把奪下了象徵勝利的鮮紅冠軍錦旗！

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: We won by a fraction of a second! The paddlers are splashing river water in pure jubilation!
dialogue.zh: 我們以不到半秒的微幅差距贏得勝利！所有划手興奮得在大河中狂潑水花、狂歡慶祝！

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: All those grueling sunrise training sessions paid off magnificently. What an unforgettable final!
dialogue.zh: 那些清晨頂著晨曦刻苦集訓的汗水，終於得到了最耀眼的回報。這真是一場永生難忘的精彩總決賽！

vocabulary.example: Cheering spectators packed the grandstands alongside the track.
The stadium erupted in jubilation when the home team scored.

vocabulary.zh: 極其艱辛磨人的、考驗意志的
vocabulary.example: Marathon runners endured a grueling climb up the steep hill.

dailyPhrase.zh: 付出得到極其耀眼豐碩的成果與回報。

cultureTip: 台灣的龍舟競賽有一項獨步全球的驚險刺激傳統——「奪標（Flag Snatching）」。每艘龍舟最前方設有「奪標手（Flag-catcher）」，在衝線瞬間需趴伏在龍頭上伸臂精準抓取水面浮標上的錦旗，決定勝負。

topic.en: World Oceans Day: Deep-Sea Hydrothermal Vents & Sustainable Fishing
topic.zh: 世界海洋日：守護深海熱泉生態與終結毀滅性過度捕撈

situation: 6月8日世界海洋日，海洋科學研究社的 Ethan 和 Natalie 正在討論公海保護條約與台灣黑潮海洋生態系。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: Natalie, today marks World Oceans Day. The ocean covers over seventy percent of Earth's surface and produces half of our oxygen.
dialogue.zh: Natalie，今天是世界海洋日。浩瀚海洋覆蓋了地球超過百分之七十的表面，更製造了我們呼吸所需一半以上的氧氣。

dialogue.speaker: Natalie
dialogue.en: Yet anthropogenic impacts are pushing marine biomes to tipping points—ocean acidification, bottom trawling, and illegal unmonitored fishing.
dialogue.zh: 然而人為破壞正將海洋生物圈推向崩潰臨界點——海水酸化、毀滅性底拖網捕撈以及非法未受監管的過度濫捕。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: Off our eastern coast, the warm Kuroshio Current carries rich pelagic biodiversity, from majestic humpback whales to migratory pelagic fish.
dialogue.zh: 在我們東部外海，溫暖澎湃的黑潮洋流孕育了豐富的大洋生態系，從壯麗的座頭鯨到各類迴游性大洋魚類皆賴以生存。

dialogue.speaker: Natalie
dialogue.en: Furthermore, deep-sea hydrothermal vent systems harbor chemosynthetic organisms that might illuminate the very origin of primordial life.
dialogue.zh: 不僅如此，龜山島附近的深海熱泉噴口系統孕育著化學合成微生物與怪蟹，甚至可能揭示地球原始生命的起源奧秘。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: The newly ratified High Seas Treaty establishing protected corridors is a momentous diplomatic breakthrough for international waters.
dialogue.zh: 近期剛獲批準建立公海保護區走廊的《公海條約》，正是國際水域保育史上極具里程碑意義的重大外交突破。

dialogue.speaker: Natalie
dialogue.en: We must treat the ocean not as an inexhaustible dumpster or pantry, but as the pulsating blue heart of our living planet.
dialogue.zh: 我們絕不能再把海洋視為取之不盡的天然倉庫或垃圾桶，而應當把它視為這顆藍色星球生生不息、跳動的心臟。

vocabulary.zh: 酸化（海水 pH 值下降）
vocabulary.example: Ocean acidification impairs shellfish ability to build calcified shells.
Tuna and swordfish are renowned pelagic migratory species.
Natural resources are fragile, not inexhaustible treasures.

dailyPhrase.zh: 臨界點、不可逆轉的質變點。

cultureTip: 6月8日為聯合國「世界海洋日（World Oceans Day）」。地球大氣中每兩口呼吸就有一口來自海洋浮游植物（Phytoplankton）的光合作用。台灣推廣「海洋永續海鮮指引」，引導消費者支持友善捕撈漁法。

topic.en: Beat the Summer Heat: Homemade Watermelon & Kiwi Popsicles
topic.zh: 炎炎夏日的救星：自製天然西瓜奇異果冰棒

situation: 初夏炎熱的週日午後，Ben 和 Lily 在廚房動手把新鮮水果泥倒進冰棒模具裡，做健康的雙色水果冰棒。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Phew, the thermometer on the wall reads thirty-three degrees Celsius! Let's make fruit popsicles!
dialogue.zh: 呼，牆上的溫度計顯示已經三十三度了！我們來動手做天然水果冰棒吧！

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: Yay! I blended fresh sweet watermelon chunks into rich red juice.
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！我剛剛把新鮮香甜的西瓜切塊打成了濃濃的鮮紅果汁。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Fill each plastic popsicle mold halfway with the red puree, and freeze it for one hour.
dialogue.zh: 把塑膠冰棒模具倒進半滿的西瓜果泥，然後放進冷凍庫冰一小時。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: Then we add a layer of blended green kiwi fruit on top to make it look like a watermelon slice with a green rind!
dialogue.zh: 接著我們在上面倒入一層打碎的綠色奇異果泥，這樣做出來就像帶有綠色西瓜皮的可愛切片冰棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Stick in wooden handles. Homemade fruit popsicles have zero artificial colors and taste delicious!
dialogue.zh: 插上小木棍。親手做的水果冰棒零人工色素，天然又超級美味！

vocabulary.example: Children enjoyed chilling homemade strawberry popsicles.
Blend the steamed carrots into a smooth baby puree.
Don't discard the watermelon rind; it can be pickled.
