dailyPhrase.zh: 消暑解熱、戰勝盛夏高溫。

cultureTip: 自製水果冰棒（DIY Fruit Popsicles）是美式家庭在夏日消暑的健康首選。運用西瓜的紅（flesh）搭配奇異果的綠（rind），不加精緻糖即可做出視覺口感雙全的純天然冰品。

topic.en: Mangzhong Solar Term: Grain in Ear & the Summer Solstice Transition
topic.zh: 芒種節氣：晚稻播種與芒刺穀物的初夏農事耕作

situation: 時逢二十四節氣中的「芒種」，Tony 和 Clara 走在校園生態田埂旁，討論農人搶種與氣候轉折特點。

dialogue.speaker: Tony
dialogue.en: Clara, today is Mangzhong, literally meaning 'Grain in Ear,' the ninth solar term of the year.
dialogue.zh: Clara，今天正是『芒種』，字面意思是『有芒的穀物可收穫，有芒的作物該播種』，是一年中的第九個節氣。

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: The name refers to awned cereal crops like barley and wheat ripening, while summer rice seedlings must be planted swiftly.
dialogue.zh: 這個名稱指的是大麥、小麥等帶有芒刺的麥穗已經成熟，而夏作水稻幼苗則必須搶時間趕緊插秧播種。

dialogue.speaker: Tony
dialogue.en: There is an ancient folk proverb: 'If you don't plant during Mangzhong, planting later will be in vain.'
dialogue.zh: 古代農諺常說：『芒種芒種，樣樣都種；芒種不種，過後落空』，強調搶抓農時的重要性。

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: It is also known as the busiest farming period. High temperatures paired with relentless rainfall accelerate crop growth.
dialogue.zh: 這也被公認為農民整年中最忙碌的時節。高溫搭配豐沛降雨，極大加速了作物的生長節奏。

dialogue.speaker: Tony
dialogue.en: Just like farmers seizing the critical seasonal window, we must seize this month to consolidate our school studies before finals.
dialogue.zh: 就像農夫緊抓關鍵農時節令一樣，我們也必須把握六月的寶貴光陰，在期末考前紮實鞏固學科知識。

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: Hard work invested during this busy season will guarantee a fruitful autumn harvest.
dialogue.zh: 在這忙碌播種的時節所投入的每一分辛勤汗水，必將迎來金秋沉甸甸的豐碩收成。

vocabulary.example: Wheat and barley are essential cereal crops.
All their rescue efforts were in vain against the storm.
Reviewing notes nightly helps consolidate memory.

dailyPhrase.zh: 把握關鍵時間窗口、搶抓良機。

cultureTip: 芒種（Grain in Ear）是農曆夏季的重要節氣。「芒」指帶芒刺的麥類成熟收割，「種」指水稻等作物插秧播種。民諺「芒種忙，忙著種」，體現了天地時節催人奮發的農耕哲學。

topic.en: Campus Graduation Interview: Documenting Cherished Memories
topic.zh: 校園畢業特刊採訪：記錄學長姐的珍貴回憶與感激心聲

situation: 身為校刊小記者的 Sammy 和 Noah，拿著錄音筆和記事本在走廊採訪即將畢業的六年級學長姐。

dialogue.speaker: Sammy
dialogue.en: Noah, check your microphone batteries. We are interviewing sixth graders for our graduation issue today!
dialogue.zh: Noah，檢查一下你的麥克風電池。我們今天要為校刊畢業特輯採訪六年級的學長姐囉！

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: All set! Here comes Leo, the captain of our school basketball team. Let's ask him our first question.
dialogue.zh: 準備就緒！我們學校籃球隊隊長 Leo 正好走過來了。我們來向他提第一個問題吧。

dialogue.speaker: Sammy
dialogue.en: Leo, looking back at six wonderful elementary years, what memory stands out as the most unforgettable?
dialogue.zh: Leo 學長，回顧這六年中學生活，哪一段回憶讓您覺得最刻骨銘心、最難忘呢？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: He said winning the citywide tournament after trailing by ten points was pure magic, thanks to his teammates' grit.
dialogue.zh: 他說在落後十分的絕境下逆轉奪得全市冠軍最夢幻，這全都要感謝隊友們永不放棄的堅毅鬥志。

dialogue.speaker: Sammy
dialogue.en: Documenting these heartfelt personal narratives in our school gazette preserves precious history for our campus.
dialogue.zh: 把這些真摯動人的個人故事記錄在校刊特輯中，為我們校園留存了最珍貴的集體青春記憶。

vocabulary.example: Success requires not just raw talent, but tireless grit.
Her autobiography is a compelling personal narrative.
The monthly school gazette published student poetry.

dailyPhrase.zh: 引人注目、脫穎而出、最為鮮明突出。

cultureTip: 畢業季期間，校園記者團（School Newspaper / Gazette）常製作「Graduation Issue（畢業專刊）」，透過採訪畢業生代表與回顧經典賽事，凝聚校園向心力與傳承校風精神。

topic.en: Drafting the Valedictorian Address: Embracing the Horizon
topic.zh: 撰寫畢業生致詞講稿：在告別的感傷中勇敢迎向廣闊未知

situation: 畢業典禮前夕，高三畢業生代表 Kevin 和 Audrey 在空蕩的禮堂講台前反覆推敲畢業演說講稿。

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: Audrey, I have rewritten this valedictory opening four times. Balancing nostalgic tribute with forward-looking inspiration is daunting.
dialogue.zh: Audrey，我把這篇畢業代表致詞的開場白重寫了四次。要同時兼顧對過往回憶的感恩與對未來未知的激勵，著實令人戰戰兢兢。

dialogue.speaker: Audrey
dialogue.en: Avoid well-worn clichés about 'spreading our wings.' Ground your speech in concrete communal milestones our cohort endured together.
dialogue.zh: 避開那些陳腔濫調的『展翅高飛』吧。把演說錨定在我們這一屆同學共同經歷過、真切共患難的具體里程碑上。

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: Like how we navigated remote learning black screens during pandemics, and then revitalized sports day with fierce passion.
dialogue.zh: 就像我們曾在疫情中面對黑屏遠距教學的孤寂摸索，隨後又在校運會上用無比的熱情重新點燃整個校園。

dialogue.speaker: Audrey
dialogue.en: Precisely. Resilience is our generational defining trait. Commencement is not a final destination, but an inflection point toward greater autonomy.
dialogue.zh: 正是如此。強韌抗壓正是我們這一代人最鮮明的印記。畢業典禮從來不是句點，而是邁向自主成人道路的重要轉折點。

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: I will conclude with a call to remain intellectually curious and fundamentally empathetic in an increasingly polarized world.
dialogue.zh: 我打算在結尾呼籲大家：在日益兩極化喧囂的世界中，永遠保持心智的好奇探求，並堅守最純粹的慈悲與同理。

dialogue.speaker: Audrey
dialogue.en: Deliver that with conviction. When words emanate from raw authenticity, they resonate powerfully in every listener's heart.
dialogue.zh: 帶著堅定的信念說出這番話吧。當言辭源於未經雕飾的真誠，它必將在每位聆聽者心間激起強烈而悠長的回響。

vocabulary.example: She delivered an eloquent valedictory address to the graduating class.
The commencement speaker avoided tired motivational clichés.
He spoke with passionate moral conviction.

dailyPhrase.zh: 轉折點、重大轉捩點。

cultureTip: 西方畢業典禮中，成績最頂尖或具代表性的學生稱為「Valedictorian（畢業生致辭代表）」，致詞（Valedictory address）通常著重在感謝師長、回顧集體奮鬥歷程，並激勵同儕勇敢承擔社會責任。

topic.en: Graduation Autograph Books: Signatures on School Uniforms
topic.zh: 畢業紀念冊與校服簽名：青春不散場的儀式感

situation: 國三畢業典禮前最後一個下課，Dylan 和 Chloe 拿著油性奇異筆在白色制服上互相簽名寫下祝福。

dialogue.speaker: Dylan
dialogue.en: Chloe, pass me that black permanent marker, please! Everyone is signing the backs of our white school shirts!
dialogue.zh: Chloe，請把那支黑色油性簽字筆遞給我！大家都在我們白色制服襯衫背後簽名留念呢！

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Turn around, Dylan! I am writing 'Friends Forever' across your left shoulder with a smiley doodle.
dialogue.zh: 轉過身去，Dylan！我在你左肩膀那邊簽上『友情長存』，還畫了一個可愛的笑臉塗鴉。

dialogue.speaker: Dylan
dialogue.en: My shirt is already covered in colorful autographs, funny nicknames, and quotes from our homeroom teacher.
dialogue.zh: 我的制服已經密密麻麻寫滿了五顏六色的簽名、搞笑綽號，還有班導師寫給我的勉勵名言。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Don't forget to fill out my graduation autograph album too. There are prompts for favorite memories and future dreams.
dialogue.zh: 也別忘了幫我的畢業紀念留言本填寫一頁喔。裡面有最難忘回憶和未來夢想的問答欄位。

dialogue.speaker: Dylan
dialogue.en: Even when we head to different high schools next semester, this signed shirt will be a priceless relic of our youth.
dialogue.zh: 即使下學期我們各自升上不同的高中，這件簽滿名字的校服也將成為我們青春最無價的紀念品。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Distance will never dilute true camaraderie. Let's promise to keep in touch and support each other always!
dialogue.zh: 空間距離永遠沖淡不了真摯的友誼。讓我們打勾勾約定好：常保聯絡，永遠做彼此最堅實的後盾！

vocabulary.example: Fans lined up eagerly to get the author's autograph.
Years of shared struggle forged deep camaraderie among teammates.
Her grandmother gave her a priceless antique pendant.

dailyPhrase.zh: 保持聯絡、互通音訊。

cultureTip: 在台灣與東亞校園中，畢業生在白色制服（School uniform）上互簽姓名與祝福留言，是一項極具象徵意義的告別儀式，封存純真年華的珍貴回憶。

topic.en: Farewell Song Under the Flame Tree: Heartfelt Blessings for Seniors
topic.zh: 鳳凰花開的驪歌：給畢業學長姐的真摯祝福

situation: 畢業典禮當天上午，Leo 和 Ruby 佩戴胸花站在走廊，歡送即將步出校園的六年級學長姐。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Ruby, the school auditorium is packed with parents and teachers holding colorful bouquets!
dialogue.zh: Ruby，學校大禮堂裡擠滿了家長和老師，手裡都拿著美麗繽紛的花束呢！

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.en: The seniors look so tall and mature with red ribbon corsages pinned to their chests.
dialogue.zh: 六年級的學長姐胸前別著紅色鍛帶胸花，看起來好高大又好成熟懂事呀。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: When the school choir began singing the farewell melody, several students wiped away happy tears.
dialogue.zh: 當合唱團唱起悠揚溫柔的驪歌旋律時，好幾位大哥哥大姐姐都忍不住悄悄擦拭眼角的淚水。

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.en: We clapped our hands loudly as they walked through the balloon arch into the sunny courtyard.
dialogue.zh: 當他們走過氣球拱門踏入灑滿陽光的中庭時，我們大家用最熱烈的掌聲為他們喝采。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Congratulations to all the graduates! We wish them smooth sailing in junior high school!
dialogue.zh: 恭喜所有的畢業生！祝他們在國中新生活裡一帆風順、鵬程萬里！

vocabulary.example: Graduates pinned red carnation corsages to their jackets.
He handled the difficult decision with a mature attitude.
The gentle flute melody echoed softly through the chapel.

dailyPhrase.zh: 一帆風顺、順遂無阻。

cultureTip: 在台灣國小畢業典禮上，在校生通常會唱驪歌送別畢業生，並排列在「氣球拱門（balloon arch）」兩側列隊鼓掌歡送，祝福學長姐在全新求學階段「Smooth sailing（一帆風順）」

topic.en: Final Exam Countdown: Organizing the Comprehensive Review Timetable
topic.zh: 期末考倒數一週：制定全科統整衝刺清單與時間表

situation: 畢業典禮過後，五六年級在校生迎來期末總考倒數，Max 和 Grace 在教室討論如何有系統地複習一整學期的課本內容。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: Grace, only seven days remain until our spring semester final exams begin!
dialogue.zh: Grace，距離我們下學期期末考只剩下最後七天倒數了！

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Unlike midterms, final exams cover all units taught across the entire semester, so we need a systematic plan.
dialogue.zh: 跟期中考不同，期末考涵蓋了一整學期學過的所有單元，所以我們非常需要系統化的複習計畫。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: I divided my review into three daily sessions: math word problems before dinner, English grammar at night, and social studies in the morning.
dialogue.zh: 我把每天的複習分成三個時段：晚餐前算數學應用題、晚間讀英語文法，早晨頭腦清醒時背社會科。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Don't forget to review our previous quizzes and midterms. Re-solving our past mistakes saves the most time.
dialogue.zh: 也別忘了翻翻看之前的隨堂小考和期中考卷。重新做一遍以前錯過的題目最省時間且成效最好。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: Great strategy. Let's finish strong and earn ourselves a completely guilt-free summer holiday!
dialogue.zh: 好策略。讓我們全力衝刺有始有終，為自己贏得一個毫無罪惡感、暢快痛快的暑假！

vocabulary.example: She conducted a systematic investigation of the laboratory data.
We scheduled a productive two-hour study session.
Pacing yourself is the winning strategy in long-distance running.

dailyPhrase.zh: 全力衝刺到底、善始善終完成最後階段。

cultureTip: 教育學常用「Finish strong」勉勵學生在學期尾聲（final stretch）堅持到底，不因暑假將至而心浮氣躁，用條理分明的計畫（systematic plan）迎接期末評量。

topic.en: The Feynman Technique: Solidifying Complex Physics and Chemistry
topic.zh: 費曼學習法實踐：用極簡語言向他人講解，檢驗深度理解

situation: 高中期末考倒數週，自習室裡 Ryan 和 Claire 運用諾貝爾物理獎得主費曼倡導的學習法，互相抽考電磁學概念。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Claire, I thought I mastered Faraday's Law of electromagnetic induction, but when I attempted the past exam problems, I stalled completely.
dialogue.zh: Claire，我原本以為自己已經搞懂了法拉第電磁感應定律，但剛剛一試著做歷屆考題，整個人就完全卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: That reveals the classic 'illusion of explanatory depth.' You recognized the equations passively, but hadn't internalized the underlying physics.
dialogue.zh: 這正揭露了典型的『解釋深度假象』。你只是被動地認得那些數學方程式，卻尚未真正內化底層的物理本質。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: How does the famous Feynman Technique bridge that gap between superficial recognition and true mastery?
dialogue.zh: 那著名的費曼學習法究竟是如何彌補表面認得與真正精通之間的鴻溝呢？

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: Explain the concept out loud using plain, jargon-free analogies as if teaching an intelligent twelve-year-old.
dialogue.zh: 大聲把這個概念用最通俗直白、毫無專業術語的生動比喻解釋出來，就像是在教一位聰明的十二歲孩子一樣。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: The moment you resort to complicated textbook jargon, you pinpoint the exact boundary of your conceptual ignorance.
dialogue.zh: 每當你詞窮、不得不訴諸課本那些複雜拗口的行話術語時，你就能精準定位出自己概念模糊的知識盲區了。

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: Exactly. Teaching is the ultimate form of active retrieval. Once you can articulate it simply, it becomes permanently etched in your mind.
dialogue.zh: 完全沒錯。教學就是最高階的主動提取形式。一旦你能用最簡單的話語講明白，它就會永久烙印在你的思維框架中了。

vocabulary.example: Through practice, musicians internalize the rhythm effortlessly.
She articulated her scientific thesis with remarkable clarity.
Diagnostic testing helped pinpoint the software error.

dailyPhrase.zh: 彌補鴻溝、拉近兩者差距。

cultureTip: 物理學家理查·費曼（Richard Feynman）倡導「費曼學習法（Feynman Technique）」四步驟：選擇概念、教給外行、發現盲點反覆重查、簡化類比。被譽為全世界最高效的終身學習心法。

topic.en: Navigating Tricky Math Formulas & Avoiding Calculation Pitfalls
topic.zh: 數學與理化考前刷題：避開粗心計算與單位換算陷阱

situation: 國二晚自習時間，Julian 和 Hannah 對照期末考理化與數學模擬試題，互相提醒容易失分的細節。

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: Hannah, I just lost eight points on this physics mock exam purely because I forgot to convert kilometers per hour into meters per second!
dialogue.zh: Hannah，我剛剛在這份理化模擬考卷上丟了整整八分，純粹只是因為我忘了把時速公里換算成每秒公尺！

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: Unit conversions are notorious traps set by exam writers. Always circle units in the question prompt with a red pen.
dialogue.zh: 單位換算向來是出題老師最愛設的經典陷阱。讀題目時一定要用紅筆把題目裡的單位大圈起來。

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: And in quadratic equations, forgetting to account for negative root solutions threw off my entire final calculation.
dialogue.zh: 而且在解一元二次方程式時，漏掉了負根的解，導致我最後整道大題的計算全軍覆沒。

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: Before submitting your exam paper, allocate the final ten minutes exclusively for reverse auditing your calculations.
dialogue.zh: 在交卷前，一定要留出最後十分鐘，專門用來逆向驗算你的計算過程。

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: Checking your work backwards really catches careless sign slips and arithmetic blunders.
dialogue.zh: 逆向回推檢查真的能及時揪出正負號寫錯和粗心計算的失誤。

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: Meticulous execution under time pressure is what separates average marks from top-tier scores.
dialogue.zh: 在有限的時間壓力下依然能做到嚴謹細緻，正是平庸分數與頂尖高分之間真正的差距。

vocabulary.zh: 惡名昭彰的、出名的（多用於貶義或難纏）
vocabulary.example: That intersection is notorious for traffic congestion.

vocabulary.zh: 一絲不苟的、嚴謹細緻的
vocabulary.example: The watchmaker performed meticulous repairs under a magnifying glass.
Mental arithmetic exercises keep cognitive skills sharp.

dailyPhrase.zh: 擾亂、使……出錯偏差。

cultureTip: 應考策略中強調「Reverse Auditing（逆向驗算）」，例如用答案回代檢驗方程式、反向推導單位維度（Dimensional analysis），是避免「Careless mistakes（粗心失分）」的最有效習慣。

topic.en: Clearing Study Desks & Sharpening Pencils for Finals
topic.zh: 整理乾淨書桌與削鉛筆：桌面整潔帶來平靜專注的心

situation: 期末考前夕，Lucas 和 Lily 在各自的書桌前整理抽屜、削好鉛筆，並收納不需要的玩具。

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.en: Lily, I just sharpened five 2B pencils with my crank sharpener. Look how pointy they are!
dialogue.zh: Lily，我剛用手搖削鉛筆機削好了五支 2B 鉛筆。你看筆尖多麼尖整呀！

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: Good job! I cleared away all the scattered comic books and plastic figurines from my desk.
dialogue.zh: 做得好！我也把我書桌上散落的漫畫書和小公仔塑膠模型全都收乾淨了。

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.en: A tidy, clutter-free desk really helps our eyes focus only on the study notebook.
dialogue.zh: 乾淨整齊、沒有雜物的書桌，真的能讓我們的眼睛專注在眼前要複習的課本筆記上。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: I put my ruler, clean eraser, and transparent pencil pouch right in front of me.
dialogue.zh: 我把直尺、乾淨的橡皮擦和透明筆袋端端正正擺在我的正前方。

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.en: Clean workspace, clear mind! We are fully prepared for tomorrow's exams.
dialogue.zh: 桌面乾乾淨淨，思緒清清爽爽！我們已經為明天的考試做好萬全準備了。

vocabulary.example: Be careful with the pointy end of the compass.

vocabulary.zh: 整潔無雜物的、清爽乾淨的
vocabulary.example: A clutter-free bedroom promotes deeper, more restful sleep.
Autumn leaves lay scattered across the stone steps.

dailyPhrase.zh: 環境整潔，思緒澄明。

cultureTip: 心理學家指出「Visual clutter（視覺雜亂）」會不自覺消耗大腦的認知資源。在考試前清理書桌（Desk decluttering）、備齊文具，能有效建立儀式感並減輕考試焦慮。

topic.en: Pomodoro Technique at the Library: Staying Laser-Focused
topic.zh: 圖書館專注學習：體驗番茄鐘時間管理法

situation: 期末考前最後一個週末，Sam 和 Olivia 在圖書館自習，運用番茄鐘（Pomodoro）維持高效專注力。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Olivia, I set my desk timer for twenty-five minutes. Our first Pomodoro study session begins now!
dialogue.zh: Olivia，我把書桌計時器設定好二十五分鐘了。我們第一個番茄鐘專注時段現在開始！

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.en: Remember the golden rule: zero distractions during these twenty-five minutes—no talking, no checking phones.
dialogue.zh: 記住黃金守則：在這二十五分鐘裡完全零干擾——不說話、不查看手機通知。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Ding! The gentle vibration just went off. That twenty-five minutes flew by so quickly!
dialogue.zh: 叮！計時器的輕柔震動剛剛響起了。那二十五分鐘過得未免也太飛快了吧！

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.en: Now we earn a strict five-minute break. Stand up, stretch your back, and drink a glass of water.
dialogue.zh: 現在我們贏得了紮實的五分鐘休息時間。站起來舒展一下背部筋骨，喝杯水休息一下眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Studying in short sprint intervals prevents brain fatigue and makes reviewing thick chapters feel totally manageable.
dialogue.zh: 用短時間衝刺間隔的方式讀書，能徹底防止大腦疲勞，讓複習厚厚的大單元變得輕鬆可控！

vocabulary.example: Turn off social media alerts to eliminate study distractions.

vocabulary.zh: 易控制處理的、可駕馭的
vocabulary.example: Breaking the project into small tasks made it manageable.
Trains arrive at regular fifteen-minute intervals.

dailyPhrase.zh: 如雷射般高度聚焦專注、全神貫注。

cultureTip: 「番茄鐘工作法（Pomodoro Technique）」由義大利人弗朗西斯科·齊里洛（Francesco Cirillo）創立，透過「專注25分鐘 + 休息5分鐘」的節奏循環，大幅提升工作效率並消除拖延症。

topic.en: World Refugee Day: Climate Displacement & Global Humanitarian Empathy
topic.zh: 世界難民日：全球氣候難民危機與跨越國界的人道關懷

situation: 6月20日世界難民日，模擬聯合國社團的 Alex 和 Brenda 在演講廳探討氣候變遷引發的全球難民流離失所難題。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Brenda, today is World Refugee Day. According to the UN Refugee Agency, over one hundred and twenty million individuals are forcibly displaced worldwide.
dialogue.zh: Brenda，今天是世界難民日。根據聯合國難民署統計，全球已有超過一億兩千萬人被迫流離失所。

dialogue.speaker: Brenda
dialogue.en: That staggering figure represents human souls, not mere statistics. Beyond armed conflict, climate catastrophes are increasingly driving mass migration.
dialogue.zh: 那個令人震撼的數字代表著一個個活生生的人類靈魂，而非冰冷數字。除了武裝衝突，極端氣候災難正日益成為大規模人口被迫遷徙的推手。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Rising sea levels threatening low-lying Pacific island nations create 'climate refugees' who possess no legal status under the 1951 Refugee Convention.
dialogue.zh: 海平面上升威脅著低窪太平洋島國的生存，製造了在 1951 年《難民公約》現行法律框架下缺乏正式地位的『氣候難民』。

dialogue.speaker: Brenda
dialogue.en: International legal definitions must evolve proactively. When drought and salinization destroy subsistence farming, flight becomes an existential necessity.
dialogue.zh: 國際法定義必須積極與時俱進。當乾旱與土地鹽鹼化徹底摧毀自給自足的農業，逃離家園就成了生存唯一的迫不得已選擇。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Refugee integration is an asset rather than a burden; displaced people bring rich cultural diversity, entrepreneurial spirit, and resilience.
dialogue.zh: 接納難民融入社會其實是一項寶貴資產而非單純負擔；離鄉背井的人們帶來了豐富的文化多樣性、創業家精神與強韌毅力。

dialogue.speaker: Brenda
dialogue.en: Empathy requires recognizing that in a volatile interconnected biosphere, any of us could one day find ourselves seeking refuge.
dialogue.zh: 真正的同理心源於深刻認知：在動盪脆弱、休戚與共的地球生物圈中，我們任何人都可能在未來的某一天，成為尋求庇護的一方。

vocabulary.zh: 令人震驚的、難以置信的龐大
vocabulary.example: The disaster caused a staggering amount of infrastructural damage.

vocabulary.zh: 關乎生存的、生死存亡的
vocabulary.example: Climate disruption poses an existential challenge to island habitats.

vocabulary.zh: 不穩定的、易動盪多變的
vocabulary.example: Commodity markets remained volatile throughout the trade embargo.

dailyPhrase.zh: 尋求庇護、避難尋求安身立命之所。

cultureTip: 6月20日是聯合國「世界難民日（World Refugee Day）」。現代社會學倡導將難民議題從單純的邊境管制提升至「氣候正義（Climate Justice）」與人道尊嚴的高度，強調沒有人會甘願拋棄故鄉，除非故鄉已成為險境。

topic.en: Summer Solstice: The Longest Day of the Year & Sundial Shadows
topic.zh: 夏至節氣：一年中白晝最長的一天與日晷倒影觀測

situation: 二十四節氣迎來「夏至」，地理科學社的 Tony 和 Clara 在校園日晷台旁測量正午時分一年中最短的影子。

dialogue.speaker: Tony
dialogue.en: Clara, look at the brass sundial at noon today! The shadow cast by the gnomon is shorter than on any other day of the entire year!
dialogue.zh: Clara，看今天正午的黃銅日晷！日晷針投射出的影子比整整一年中任何一天都要短得多！

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: That is because today is the Summer Solstice! The sun shines directly over the Tropic of Cancer at twenty-three point five degrees north.
dialogue.zh: 那是因為今天正是『夏至』！太陽直射在北緯二十三點五度的北回歸線上。

dialogue.speaker: Tony
dialogue.en: In the Northern Hemisphere, today has the longest daylight hours and the briefest night of the entire year.
dialogue.zh: 在北半球，今天擁有全年度最漫長的白晝日光照射時數，以及最短暫的黑夜。

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: In Chiayi and Hualien along the Tropic of Cancer, if you stand outdoors at solar noon, your shadow completely disappears under your shoes!
dialogue.zh: 在嘉義與花蓮的北回歸線標線處，如果在正午時分站在戶外，你的影子甚至會完全隱沒在鞋底之下、『立竿無影』呢！

dialogue.speaker: Tony
dialogue.en: Folk wisdom advises: 'Eating noodles on Summer Solstice cools the body.' Let's grab some cold sesame noodles after school!
dialogue.zh: 民間俗話說：『冬至餃子夏至麵』。放學後我們一起去吃碗清涼開胃的麻醬涼麵消消暑吧！

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: Count me in! Celebrating seasonal astronomical shifts with tasty traditional food is my favorite pastime.
dialogue.zh: 算我一份！用美味的傳統應景美食來慶祝季節天文節氣的轉折，是我最喜歡的樂趣了。

vocabulary.example: The winter solstice brings the longest night of the year.
The angled gnomon casts a solar shadow across the hour dial.
Ancient monuments aligned with extraordinary astronomical precision.

dailyPhrase.zh: 立竿無影、影子完全隱沒在腳底。

cultureTip: 「夏至（Summer Solstice）」是北半球白晝最長的一天。北回歸線（Tropic of Cancer）正好橫貫台灣嘉義與花蓮，夏至正午太陽直射頭頂，會出現特殊的「立竿無影」奇景。傳統飲食習慣有「冬至湯圓夏至麵（Eating cold noodles）」之說。

topic.en: First Day of Finals: Taking a Deep Breath and Reading Carefully
topic.zh: 期末考首日：冷靜沉著、細心讀題作答

situation: 期末考第一天第一節考試鐘聲即將敲響，教室裡 Leo 和 Ruby 坐在各自座位上，互相微笑道加油。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Ruby, the teacher is handing out the Mandarin exam papers now. My heart is beating a little fast.
dialogue.zh: Ruby，老師正在分發國語科期末考卷了。我的心跳稍微有點加快呢。

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.en: Take three slow deep breaths with me, Leo. Inhale calm, exhale worry.
dialogue.zh: 跟我一起慢慢深呼吸三次，Leo。吸入冷靜，吐出擔憂。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Phew, that really helps relax my shoulders. I will read each question twice before picking an answer.
dialogue.zh: 呼，這真的讓我的肩膀放鬆下來了。在選答案前我一定會把每個題目看兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.en: And write your stroke order neatly so the teacher can grade smoothly.
dialogue.zh: 還有國字筆畫筆順要寫得工整端正，這樣老師批改起來一目了然。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: We reviewed diligently all week. Let's do our personal best. Good luck!
dialogue.zh: 我們這整週都複習得非常勤奮。發揮出自己的最佳實力吧。祝我們考試順利！

vocabulary.example: Inhale deeply through your nose during meditation.
Students studied diligently throughout the exam week.
She arranged her notebooks neatly inside the backpack.

dailyPhrase.zh: 發揮出自己的最佳實力。

cultureTip: 教育心理學提倡「Inhale calm, exhale worry（吸進平靜，吐出擔憂）」的腹式深呼吸技巧，能迅速降低臨場考試交感神經亢奮，讓思維重回理性澄澈狀態。

topic.en: Wrapping Up Science & Social Studies: Looking Forward Calmly
topic.zh: 考完自然與社會科：放下成績焦慮，專注迎戰明天的最終局

situation: 期末考第一天結束放學前，Max 和 Grace 走出考場，談論如何不被已經考完的科目牽絆情緒。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: Grace, day one of finals is officially behind us! That science question on circuit boards was quite intricate.
dialogue.zh: Grace，期末考第一天終於正式結束了！自然科考卷上那題電路串並聯題目真的挺複雜精細的。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: I paused on that one too, but remember: once you turn in the test paper, dwell no more on the score.
dialogue.zh: 我也在那題停頓想了很久，但記住：考卷一交出去，就別再去糾結分數了。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: Some students are frantically cross-checking answers in the hallway and getting anxious.
dialogue.zh: 走廊上已經有一些同學在急切地對答案，結果越對越焦慮煩躁。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Worrying about past answers won't add a single mark, but it will sap your mental energy for tomorrow's math and English.
dialogue.zh: 為已經交卷的答案煩惱不會多加任何一分，只會白白消耗你用來準備明天數學與英文的寶貴精力。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: Wise advice. Let's go home, enjoy a nutritious dinner, get plenty of sleep, and finish tomorrow with a triumphant smile!
dialogue.zh: 充滿智慧的建議。我們回家好好吃一頓營養的晚餐、睡個好覺，明天帶著自信勝利的微笑迎接最後一戰！

vocabulary.example: The maze had an intricate pattern of dead ends.

vocabulary.zh: 消耗、逐漸削弱（精力或元氣）
vocabulary.example: Constant anxiety sapped his physical stamina.
Scientists cross-check experimental readings to ensure accuracy.

dailyPhrase.zh: 不再糾結於……、不再反覆掛懷。

cultureTip: 教育心理學者指出「Post-exam rumination（考後反芻焦慮）」會嚴重損害認知功能。考完立即對答案無助於成績改變，將專注力迅速移轉至即將面臨的下一個挑戰才是成熟學習者的強韌心態。

topic.en: Finals Are Over! Unwinding, Cheering & Infinite Relief
topic.zh: 期末考試交卷那一刻！如釋重負的歡呼與大口喝珍奶

situation: 最後一堂期末考鐘聲悠長敲響，Dylan 和 Chloe 踏出考場長廊，感受整學期課業壓力煙消雲散的無比暢快。

dialogue.speaker: Dylan
dialogue.en: Listen to that final bell chiming, Chloe! Pencils down! The semester exams are officially over!
dialogue.zh: Chloe，聽聽那最後一聲鐘聲敲響！放下鉛筆！這個學期的期末考正式宣告結束囉！

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: I feel an incredible surge of liberation! It feels as though a hundred-pound boulder evaporated off my chest.
dialogue.zh: 我感到一股前所未有的無比解脫！感覺好像胸口上一塊百斤重的巨石瞬間蒸發了一樣輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: Dylan
dialogue.en: Those sleepless nights reviewing geometry proofs and periodic tables are finally behind us.
dialogue.zh: 那些熬夜複習幾何證明題和化學元素週期表的夜晚，終於都成為過去式了。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Let's celebrate immediately! How about walking over to the bubble tea shop for brown sugar boba milk with extra ice?
dialogue.zh: 我們現在馬上就去慶祝！不如走到街角的珍珠奶茶店，買杯加滿碎冰的黑糖珍珠鮮奶怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: Dylan
dialogue.en: Yes! And tonight I am playing cooperative video games with my squad until midnight without a shred of guilt!
dialogue.zh: 太贊成了！而且今晚我要跟戰隊隊友連線打協力電玩打到午夜，毫無一絲一毫的罪惡感！

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: We fought hard and saw this semester through to the end. Cheers to freedom and the approaching summer vacation!
dialogue.zh: 我們堅持拚搏，並有始有終走完了這個學期。為自由與即將到來的盛夏假期乾杯！

vocabulary.example: Finishing her dissertation gave her a profound sense of liberation.
Morning fog evaporated quickly under the blazing summer sun.
Hikers navigated around giant granite boulders along the path.

dailyPhrase.zh: 毫無一絲一毫的愧疚感。

cultureTip: 學生在考完期末考那一刻常高喊「Pencils down! Exams are over!」，適度犒賞自己享用最愛的美食甜點或盡情放鬆，有助於身心從高度緊繃的備考狀態平穩過渡。

topic.en: Semester-End Self-Audit: Mentally Preparing for Senior High Year Three
topic.zh: 學期總結與自我審計：從高二升上高三的心理調適與長遠規劃

situation: 高中期末考後，高二即將升上高三的 Sean 和 Melody 坐在校園林蔭石桌旁，認真復盤高二一整年的學習與課外活動累積。

dialogue.speaker: Sean
dialogue.en: Melody, now that our tenth and eleventh grades are fully complete, the looming reality of being high school seniors is setting in.
dialogue.zh: Melody，高一和高二課業現在已經全數畫下句點，即將升上高三頂峰的現實感油然而生。

dialogue.speaker: Melody
dialogue.en: It is a profound transitional juncture. Before diving impulsively into summer break, conducting a holistic self-audit is indispensable.
dialogue.zh: 這是一個深刻的重要轉折節點。在貿然放鬆投入暑假前，為自己做一場全方位的深度自我復盤是不可或缺的。

dialogue.speaker: Sean
dialogue.en: Looking back over this past academic year, my club leadership and science fair project developed real-world problem-solving abilities.
dialogue.zh: 回顧過去這一學年，社團幹部歷練與科展專案確實磨礪了我解決真實世界複雜問題的能力。

dialogue.speaker: Melody
dialogue.en: However, standardized college entrance examinations demand rigorous foundational consistency across literature, math, and foreign languages.
dialogue.zh: 然而，大學升學大考需要的是在國英數等核心學科上極其嚴謹穩固的底層基礎與持久一致性。

dialogue.speaker: Sean
dialogue.en: I plan to utilize the upcoming two-month summer vacation to systematically review all first- and second-year core curricula.
dialogue.zh: 我打算善用即將到來的兩個月暑假，把高一高二的核心課綱教材完整、系統化地全面地毯式複習一遍。

dialogue.speaker: Melody
dialogue.en: He who prepares early triumphs with serenity. Let's enter our final high school chapter with unflinching resolve and clarity of purpose.
dialogue.zh: 凡事預則立，早做準備者方能篤定從容。讓我們懷抱堅定不移的決心與清晰目標，邁向高中最後的輝煌篇章！

vocabulary.zh: 特定時刻、重要關頭、轉折點
vocabulary.example: At this critical juncture, the board decided to revise the company strategy.

vocabulary.zh: 堅定不移的、毫不退縮畏懼的
vocabulary.example: Her unflinching courage inspired the entire emergency rescue squad.
She maintained inner serenity amidst the chaotic courtroom proceedings.

dailyPhrase.zh: 目標明確清晰、心無旁騖。

cultureTip: 高中升三年級前的暑假被視為升學備考的「黃金分水嶺（Golden Watershed）」。進行「Self-Audit（個人學習審計復盤）」，誠實盤點學科強弱項，能讓暑期複習計畫精準對焦、事半功倍。

topic.en: End-of-Semester Classroom Clean-Up: Scrubbing Desks & Emptying Lockers
topic.zh: 教室大掃除與整理儲物櫃：乾乾淨淨放暑假

situation: 考完後的週四下午，全班齊心協力進行學期末大掃除，Ben 和 Ruby 拿著抹布和掃帚分工清潔教室。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Ruby, dip this cleaning sponge into the soapy water bucket and squeeze it out.
dialogue.zh: Ruby，把這塊清潔海綿浸進肥皂水桶裡，然後用力擰乾。

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.en: I am scrubbing away pencil smudges and tape residues from our wooden desks.
dialogue.zh: 我正在把木課桌上的鉛筆黑污痕跡和透明膠帶殘膠用力擦洗乾淨呢。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Look at our personal lockers! I emptied out all old test papers, craft projects, and my spare gym shoes.
dialogue.zh: 你看我們的置物櫃！我把所有舊考卷、美術作品還有備用運動鞋全清空整理好了。

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.en: The classroom floor looks sparkling clean after sweeping and mopping!
dialogue.zh: 掃地拖地之後，整間教室的地板看起來亮晶晶、一塵不染！

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Leaving our classroom neat and tidy is the best way to conclude our school year.
dialogue.zh: 把教室整理得乾淨整潔，就是為我們這一學年畫上最棒句點的方式。

vocabulary.example: Wipe away the black pencil smudge with a damp cloth.
Rubbing alcohol effectively removes sticky sticker residue.
She mopped the kitchen floor with pine-scented cleaner.

dailyPhrase.zh: 整齊乾淨、井井有條。

cultureTip: 學期末大掃除（End-of-semester clean-up）是校園生活的重要傳統。徹底清空個人儲物櫃（lockers）並將桌椅洗刷一新，培養孩子對公共環境的責任感與惜物美德。

topic.en: Receiving Report Cards & Certificates of Merit: Celebrating Growth
topic.zh: 領取成績單與榮譽獎狀：肯定一學期的辛勤耕耘與進步

situation: 結業式前夕，班導師頒發期末成績單與進步獎狀，Eric 和 Mia 坐在座位上開心地互相分享評語。

dialogue.speaker: Eric
dialogue.en: Mia, our teacher just handed us our sealed semester report cards!
dialogue.zh: Mia，老師剛剛把密封好的學期成績單發到我們手上了！

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: Open it gently! Look at your math grade—you jumped from eighty to ninety-five points!
dialogue.zh: 輕輕拆開來看看！看你的數學成績——你從八十分大幅躍升到了九十五分呢！

dialogue.speaker: Eric
dialogue.en: And look at your certificate of merit for outstanding peer support and English excellence!
dialogue.zh: 還有看你拿到的這張榮譽獎狀：熱心助人模範與英語傑出表現獎！

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: The teacher's written remarks said: 'Mia consistently demonstrates curiosity and empathy in team activities.'
dialogue.zh: 老師在評語欄寫著：『Mia 在團隊活動中始終展現旺盛的好奇心與同理心。』

dialogue.speaker: Eric
dialogue.en: Scores are important, but witnessing how much wiser and kinder we have grown this semester is the truest prize.
dialogue.zh: 分數固然重要，但見證我們這學期變得多麼懂事、多麼善良有愛，才是最貨真價實的獎賞。

vocabulary.example: He proudly framed his academic achievement certificate.

vocabulary.zh: 優點、功績、值得讚賞之處
vocabulary.example: Students received awards based on academic and moral merit.
The teacher wrote encouraging remarks on her essay.

dailyPhrase.zh: 榮譽獎狀、表現優異獎。

cultureTip: 現代教育強調「Growth Mindset（成長型思維）」，成績單（Report Card）上的「Teacher's Remarks（導師評語）」與多元評量榮譽狀，著重肯定孩子的學習態度、同理心與進步幅度，而非單一排名。

topic.en: Crafting an Inspiring Summer Bucket List: Reading, Sports & New Skills
topic.zh: 擬定充實的暑假心願清單：運動、自主閱讀與解鎖一門新技能

situation: 暑假前最後一個週五下午，David 和 Chloe 在咖啡館各自攤開手帳，認真寫下今年夏天的個人探索清單。

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.en: Chloe, let's establish our official summer bucket lists right now so we don't squander two months in mindless scrolling.
dialogue.zh: Chloe，我們現在就來把正式的暑假心願清單列好，免得這兩個月在漫無目的滑手機中被白白浪費掉。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: I completely agree! My top goal is reading eight classic fiction novels and finishing a Python coding basics course online.
dialogue.zh: 我完全同意！我的第一目標是閱讀八本經典文學小說，並在線上修完一套 Python 程式設計基礎課程。

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.en: Awesome. My fitness goal is swimming one kilometer three times a week and learning how to play acoustic guitar fingerstyle.
dialogue.zh: 太酷了。我的體能目標是每週游三次一千公尺，並且學會木吉他指彈演奏技巧。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Let's also schedule a weekend hiking expedition to the high mountain trails with our families in mid-July.
dialogue.zh: 我們七月中旬也跟家人安排一趟週末高山登山步道探險之旅吧。

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.en: Setting concrete milestones and maintaining mutual accountability guarantees our vacation remains vibrant.
dialogue.zh: 設定具體目標節點並互相監督提醒，能確保我們的長假過得充實精彩、活力滿滿。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Summer is the canvas, and we are the artists. Let's make this vacation our masterpiece!
dialogue.zh: 夏天就像一張純白的畫布，而我們就是揮毫的畫家。讓我們把這個暑假創造成屬於自己的傑作吧！

vocabulary.zh: 浪費、揮霍、虛度（時間或金錢）
vocabulary.example: Don't squander precious holiday mornings sleeping past noon.
The scientific expedition explored untouched rainforest caves.
The painting is celebrated worldwide as an artistic masterpiece.

dailyPhrase.zh: 暑假心願清單、暑期必做計畫。

cultureTip: 「Bucket List（願望清單）」源於英文俚語。在歐美學生文化中，放暑假前擬定「Summer Bucket List」，將學習、運動、志工、旅行平衡規劃，是培養自主自律（Self-directed learning）的極佳工具。

topic.en: Closing Ceremony of the Semester: Hello Summer Vacation!
topic.zh: 結業式！收拾書包，暑假我們來囉！

situation: 六月倒數第二天結業式放學鐘聲響起，Tyler 和 Amy 背起書包衝出校門，迎接期待已久的兩個月暑假。

dialogue.speaker: Tyler
dialogue.en: Amy, the principal just announced the official dismissal! Summer vacation has begun!
dialogue.zh: Amy，校長剛剛宣布結業式圓滿結束！暑假正式開始啦！

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: Hooray! No early alarm clocks tomorrow morning! I can wake up naturally to birds singing!
dialogue.zh: 萬歲！明天早上再也不用設早起鬧鐘了！我可以聽著小鳥叫聲睡到自然醒！

dialogue.speaker: Tyler
dialogue.en: My dad bought tickets for the water park wave pool this coming weekend.
dialogue.zh: 我爸爸已經買好了這週末水上樂園造浪池的門票了呢。

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: I am going to my grandparents' farm to pick sweet peaches and watch fireflies at night.
dialogue.zh: 我要去爺爺奶奶的農場採水蜜桃，晚上還要在院子裡看螢火蟲。

dialogue.speaker: Tyler
dialogue.en: Goodbye textbooks, hello sunshine and swimming pools! Have the most wonderful summer ever!
dialogue.zh: 再見課本，你好陽光與游泳池！祝我們都有一個世界上最棒的暑假！

vocabulary.example: The school courtyard buzzed with joyful laughter after dismissal.

vocabulary.zh: 自然而然地、理所當然地
vocabulary.example: She woke up naturally as morning sunlight filled the room.
Splashing in the cool swimming pool was the best summer relief.

dailyPhrase.zh: 睡到自然醒。

cultureTip: 結業式放學被稱為「Official school dismissal」。漫長的暑假正式開啟，孩子們踏出校門互道「Have a wonderful summer!」，象徵放下繁重書包、盡情擁抱陽光與探索自然的黃金假期。

topic.en: June Reflections: Looking Back at the First Half of the Year with Resolve
topic.zh: 六月終曲：回望上半年奮鬥足跡，以沉靜熱情迎接下半年

situation: 6月30日傍晚，上半年最後一天，高中自習室窗台前，Victor 和 Irene 看著天邊絢爛晚霞，總結過去六個月的成長。

dialogue.speaker: Victor
dialogue.en: Irene, as sunset glazes the horizon today, we officially cross the midpoint of 2026. Exactly half the year has elapsed.
dialogue.zh: Irene，隨著今天夕陽餘暉灑落天際，我們正式跨過了 2026 年的正中折返點。整整半年的時光已經悄然流逝。

dialogue.speaker: Irene
dialogue.en: Time accelerates asymptotically. Reflecting on January's optimistic New Year resolutions, some flourished while others withered quietly.
dialogue.zh: 時間總是以驚人的速度悄然流逝。回望一月份許下的樂觀新年新希望，有些目標已枝繁葉茂，有些則在忙碌中悄然擱置了。

dialogue.speaker: Victor
dialogue.en: Midyear shouldn't trigger regret; it is a sacred pit stop to recalibrate our trajectory and jettison non-essential baggage.
dialogue.zh: 年中的折返點不該引發焦慮懊悔；它是一個神聖的維修進站時刻，讓我們校準人生軌跡，果斷丟棄不必要的包袱雜音。

dialogue.speaker: Irene
dialogue.en: We navigated rigorous academic terms, forged resilient friendships, and learned that personal growth is rarely linear.
dialogue.zh: 我們挺過了極具挑戰的學業考驗，鍛造了堅韌的同窗友誼，也體會到個人成長從來都不是一條單調平滑的直線。

dialogue.speaker: Victor
dialogue.en: July and August offer an expansive sanctuary for deep focus, creative pursuits, and recharging our spiritual batteries.
dialogue.zh: 接下來的七月與八月，為我們提供了一處廣闊清幽的心靈庇護所，讓我們專注深耕、追求熱愛，並為精神電池充飽電量。

dialogue.speaker: Irene
dialogue.en: Farewell, eventful first half of the year. Let's greet July with courageous hearts, boundless curiosity, and relentless vitality!
dialogue.zh: 再見了，充實跌宕的上半年。讓我們懷抱勇敢的心靈、無垠的好奇心與不竭的生命力，大步迎接七月的到來！

vocabulary.example: Several months elapsed before we heard the test results.
The manager recalibrated team milestones after the quarterly review.
The botanical garden served as a peaceful sanctuary from city clamor.

dailyPhrase.zh: 年中的停歇檢修站、沉澱充電時刻。

cultureTip: 6月30日是一年365天的正中折返點（Midyear checkpoint）。歐美個人成長學家常將這天作為「Midyear Review（年中覆盤日）」，透過檢視年初目標執行率，在踏入下半年前重新校準人生的前進軌跡。

topic.en: Welcoming July: Morning Routine & Ditching Couch Potato Habits
topic.zh: 迎接七月盛夏：規劃規律作息不當沙發馬鈴薯

situation: 7月1日暑假第一天早晨，Kevin 和 Emma 在社區公園晨跑拉筋，互相約定長假不沉迷手機與電視。

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: Good morning, Emma! Welcome to the very first official day of July and summer vacation!
dialogue.zh: 早安，Emma！歡迎迎來七月份與暑假正式開跑的第一天！

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: Good morning! My mom warned me not to turn into a lazy couch potato staring at television screens all day.
dialogue.zh: 早安！我媽媽警告我，絕對不能變成整天癱在沙發上盯著電視螢幕看的懶惰沙發馬鈴薯。

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: I made a daily planner: waking up at seven thirty, reading for one hour, and playing sports in the cool afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 我做了一份每日作息計畫表：七點半起床、晨讀一小時，然後下午涼爽時出門運動鍛鍊身體。

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: That keeps your brain sharp and your body energetic throughout the two-month break.
dialogue.zh: 這樣能讓你在這兩個月的長假裡，大腦隨時保持敏銳清晰，身體也隨時充滿活力。

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.en: Let's be mutual accountability partners and check in every Monday morning!
dialogue.zh: 那我們就來當互相督促激勵的夥伴，每週一早上互相檢查執行進度吧！

vocabulary.zh: 沙發馬鈴薯、整天坐著看電視的懶人
vocabulary.example: Don't be a couch potato all summer; go outdoors and cycle.
Study groups provide peer accountability.

vocabulary.zh: 精力充沛的、活力十足的
vocabulary.example: The energetic puppy bounded across the yard.

dailyPhrase.zh: 向某人打聽近況、關心進度。

cultureTip: 「Couch potato（沙發馬鈴薯）」是美式英語中極具生動畫面的俚語，形容假期整天窩在沙發上吃零食看電視不運動的人。專家建議暑假初期訂定每日固定作息（daily routine），能有效預防「暑期退步（summer slide）」。

topic.en: Morning Swimming Lessons: Kicking & Breathing Underwater
topic.zh: 晨泳課的清涼水花：學會水中換氣與浮板打水

situation: 炎熱的早晨，Leo 和 Mia 戴好泳鏡和泳帽，跳進市立游泳池跟教練學習自由式打水技巧。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Mia, dip your toes in! The turquoise water feels so cooling on this scorching morning!
dialogue.zh: Mia，把腳趾頭伸進水裡！在這麼酷熱的早晨，這池清澈碧藍的水感覺太涼爽舒服了！

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: Remember our coach's instruction: hold the kickboard with straight arms and kick from your hips.
dialogue.zh: 要記住教練的指導動作：雙臂伸直抓穩浮板，大腿從臀部發力打水。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Splash, splash! Bubble out air gently underwater, and turn your head sideways to breathe in.
dialogue.zh: 水花四濺！在水裡用鼻子輕輕吐出泡泡，頭轉向側邊大口吸氣。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: I did it! I swam across the twenty-five-meter lane without stopping for the first time!
dialogue.zh: 我做到了！我第一次中間完全沒停下來，一口氣游完了整條二十五公尺的水道！

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: High five! Swimming is definitely the best sport to stay fit and cool during hot July.
dialogue.zh: 擊掌！在炎熱的七月天裡，游泳絕對是保持體能健康又消暑的最棒運動了。

vocabulary.example: Hold the kickboard firmly while practicing flutter kicks.

vocabulary.zh: 綠松石色的、碧藍清澈的
vocabulary.example: Tropical islands are famed for their turquoise lagoons.
Turn your head sideways to catch a breath while swimming freestyle.

dailyPhrase.zh: 把腳趾探入水中感受水溫；初次涉足嘗試。

cultureTip: 游泳（Swimming）是少數運用全身肌肉群且不傷膝蓋關節的低衝擊有氧運動。學會在水中規律吐氣換氣（bilateral breathing）與正確腿部打水，是水上安全自救的關鍵核心技能。

topic.en: Science Summer Camp: Assembling Solar-Powered Rover Cars
topic.zh: 科學夏令營：動手組裝太陽能遙控探測車

situation: 科技館夏令營創客工作坊裡，David 和 Chloe 拿著螺絲起子和光伏面板，組裝一台微型火星探測車模型。

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.en: Chloe, I just fastened the six high-traction rubber wheels onto our miniature rover chassis.
dialogue.zh: Chloe，我剛剛把六顆高抓地力的橡膠越野輪牢牢固定在我們的迷你探測車底盤上了。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Great! Now let's connect the photovoltaic solar panel to the miniature electric motor with red and black leads.
dialogue.zh: 太好了！現在我們用紅黑導線把光伏太陽能面板與微型電動馬達連接起來吧。

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.en: Make sure the solder joints are clean. Any loose contact will cause an open circuit.
dialogue.zh: 確保焊點乾淨牢固。任何接觸不良都會導致電路斷路無法運轉。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Let's carry it outside onto the sunny plaza pavement. Look, as soon as direct sun rays hit the cells, the gear spins!
dialogue.zh: 我們把它拿到外面灑滿陽光的廣場地面上試車。你看，直射陽光一照到電池晶片，齒輪立刻瘋狂旋轉起來了！

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.en: It is climbing right over that wooden ramp obstacle! Converting clean light energy directly into mechanical propulsion is awesome.
dialogue.zh: 它正直接翻越過那個木製斜坡障礙物呢！把純淨光能直接轉換為機械推進力真是太酷炫了。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Hands-on engineering demystifies abstract textbook physics and turns scientific principles into tangible wonders.
dialogue.zh: 動手實作工程徹底打破了抽象課本物理的神秘感，把科學原理化為看得見、摸得著的神奇造物。

vocabulary.example: Engineers constructed a lightweight aluminum chassis for the solar racer.
Jet engines provide immense forward propulsion.

vocabulary.zh: 使通俗易懂、揭開……的神秘面紗
vocabulary.example: Science communicators work to demystify quantum mechanics for the public.

dailyPhrase.zh: 一……就……（引導即時條件子句）。

cultureTip: 創客教育（Maker Education / STEM Camps）在暑期深受青少年喜愛。利用太陽能光伏元件（Photovoltaic cells）親手製作小型火星探測車（rover），直觀體驗可再生能源與機械工程的奧妙。

topic.en: Watermelon Seed Spitting Fun: Juicy Summer Backyard Party
topic.zh: 夏日庭院西瓜派對：比比看誰吐西瓜子吐得遠

situation: 炎熱的週六午後，Tyler 和 Amy 坐在後院涼亭長凳上吃著冰鎮西瓜，進行一場逗趣的吐西瓜子比賽。

dialogue.speaker: Tyler
dialogue.en: Amy, this cold watermelon slice is dripping with sweet, ice-cold red juice!
dialogue.zh: Amy，這片冰西瓜正滴著香甜冰涼的鮮紅西瓜汁呢！

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: Slurp! It is the best antidote to this scorching thirty-four degree afternoon heat.
dialogue.zh: 吸溜一口！這簡直是對抗這個高達三十四度酷熱午後的最佳良藥。

dialogue.speaker: Tyler
dialogue.en: Look at these slippery black seeds. Let's see who can spit a seed the farthest across the lawn!
dialogue.zh: 看這些滑溜溜的黑色西瓜子。我們來比比看誰能把西瓜子吐過草坪吐得最遠！

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: One, two, three, ptooey! Mine landed near the white daisy flowerbed!
dialogue.zh: 一、二、三，呸！我的子飛到了白色小雛菊花圃旁邊耶！

dialogue.speaker: Tyler
dialogue.en: Haha, yours flew three meters! Eating watermelon outdoors in summer is simply the best.
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，你的足足飛了三公尺遠！夏天坐在戶外大口吃西瓜真是最純粹的快樂了。

vocabulary.example: Wet bathroom tiles become extremely slippery.
Colorful marigolds blossomed in the circular flowerbed.

vocabulary.zh: 解毒劑、消除不適的良藥
vocabulary.example: Laughter is celebrated as the best antidote to stress.

dailyPhrase.zh: 簡直是最棒的、無與倫比。

cultureTip: 吐西瓜子比賽（Watermelon seed spitting contest）是歐美鄉村夏季園遊會的經典傳統趣味活動，參賽者比拼肺活量與角度技巧，既消暑又充滿歡笑。

topic.en: Chilling at the Community Library: Free AC and Good Books
topic.zh: 社區圖書館的消暑時光：享受免費涼爽冷氣與探索知識寶庫

situation: 正午熱浪滾滾，Sam 和 Olivia 帶著環保水壺走進社區圖書館，在安靜清涼的少兒閱讀區閱讀漫畫與科普書。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Ah, stepping through the library glass door feels like walking into an oasis of cool air!
dialogue.zh: 啊，推開圖書館玻璃門的那一刻，簡直就像走進了一座清涼宜人的沙漠綠洲！

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.en: The outside pavement was literally radiating heat waves off the tarmac.
dialogue.zh: 外面的柏油馬路剛剛真的熱到像是都在散發陣陣滾燙的熱浪呢。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Instead of blasting expensive electricity at home, studying here is environmentally friendly and cozy.
dialogue.zh: 與其在家裡整天狂開昂貴的冷氣浪費電，來這裡安靜看書既節能環保又舒服愜意。

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.en: I found a brand new series of illustrated national geographic magazines about polar wildlife.
dialogue.zh: 我找到了最新一期關於極地野生動物的全彩國家地理雜誌呢。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Let's read quietly until five in the afternoon, when the sun begins sinking toward the hills.
dialogue.zh: 那我們就安靜閱讀到下午五點，等烈日漸漸西斜落到山後再回家吧。

vocabulary.zh: 綠洲、令人舒適安寧的避風港
vocabulary.example: The shaded courtyard was a peaceful oasis amid the bustling city.
Heat shimmered visibly above the airport tarmac.

vocabulary.zh: 猛力開動、狂吹（冷氣或音響）
vocabulary.example: Don't blast the air conditioner at full blast all day.

dailyPhrase.zh: 踏入綠洲、進入清涼愜意之所。

cultureTip: 公共圖書館在許多城市被指定為「Cooling Center（避暑中心）」，為社區民眾與學生在極端熱浪期間提供免費冷氣、乾淨飲用水與豐富文化資源，兼具公共衛生與環保節能意義。

topic.en: Dreaming of Cycling Around Taiwan: Route Planning & Gear
topic.zh: 盛夏單車環島夢想：規劃環島路線、裝備清單與安全防護

situation: 國二升國三的暑假，Julian 和 Hannah 在單車店看著台灣全島地圖，興奮討論未來的單車環島成年禮計畫。

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: Hannah, look at this Cycling Route 1 map looping around the entire island for nine hundred kilometers!
dialogue.zh: Hannah，你看這張環繞全島整整九百公里的『單車環島 1 號線』路線地圖！

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: Cycling around Taiwan is a classic rite of passage for Taiwanese youths. Completing it takes immense physical stamina and mental determination.
dialogue.zh: 單車環島是台灣年輕人最經典的成年禮之一。要完成它需要無比充沛的體能耐力與強大的心理毅力。

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: Traveling counter-clockwise is smartest because you ride on the seaward side of coastal highways, keeping ocean vistas right beside you.
dialogue.zh: 採逆時針方向騎乘是最聰明的做法，因為這樣能始終騎在靠海那一側的公路邊，壯麗海景就在身旁。

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: Waterproof pannier bags, puncture repair kits, padded cycling shorts, and high-visibility reflective vests are mandatory gear.
dialogue.zh: 防水後馬鞍袋、補胎工具組、減震自行車褲以及高可見度反光背心都是絕對必備的裝備清單。

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: Pedaling along the rugged cliffs of the east coast and conquering Shouka Pass in Pingtung will test our limits.
dialogue.zh: 沿著東海岸壯麗險峻的懸崖絕壁踩踏前進，並征服屏東著名的壽卡鐵馬驛站坡道，將徹底考驗我們的極限。

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: Experiencing your homeland petal by pedal at human speed creates memories that stay etched in your heart for a lifetime.
dialogue.zh: 用雙腳踏板的速度與人性的視角一步一腳印丈量故鄉土地，所烙印在心中的記憶將會相伴一生。

vocabulary.zh: 成年禮、人生必經的重要過渡儀式
vocabulary.example: Graduating from high school is a universal rite of passage.
Runners circle around the track in a counter-clockwise direction.

vocabulary.zh: （自行車後座的）雙側掛袋、馬鞍袋
vocabulary.example: Pack the heavy camping stove at the bottom of the bicycle pannier.

dailyPhrase.zh: 人生必經的成年禮或里程碑考驗。

cultureTip: 台灣單車環島（Cycling around Taiwan）享譽國際。教育部體育署規劃的「單車環島1號線（Cycling Route 1）」全長約 968 公里，多數車友偏好「逆時針騎乘（counter-clockwise）」，享受緊鄰太平洋海景的視覺震撼。

topic.en: Xiaoshu Solar Term: Minor Heat, Cooling Foods & Herbal Traditions
topic.zh: 小暑節氣：溫風至、蟋蟀居壁與初夏消暑三伏貼

situation: 二十四節氣迎來「小暑」，Ethan 和 Grace 走在公園林蔭道下，感受盛夏熱浪帶來的悶熱暖風。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: Grace, today marks Xiaoshu, or 'Minor Heat,' the eleventh solar term. Even the gentle breeze feels warm and humid.
dialogue.zh: Grace，今天正是『小暑』，第十一個節氣。連吹過臉頰的微風都感覺帶著溫熱與濕氣呢。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Ancient texts observed three phenomena for Xiaoshu: warm winds arrive, crickets move to wall crevices, and young eagles practice hunting.
dialogue.zh: 古籍記載小暑有三候：溫風至、蟋蟀居壁、鷹始摯（幼鷹開始展翅練習搏擊獵食）。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: Although it is called 'Minor Heat,' it signals that the dog days of summer—the infamous 'Sanfu' period—are beginning.
dialogue.zh: 雖然名稱叫『小暑』，但它標誌著一年中最酷熱難耐的『三伏天』大幕已經正式拉開了。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Many people visit traditional Chinese medicine clinics during Sanfu to apply herbal patches for winter respiratory health.
dialogue.zh: 許多人會在三伏天前往中醫診所貼敷『三伏貼』，利用冬病夏治的原理調理體質、預防冬季呼吸道過敏。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: Culinary customs suggest eating lotus root and refreshing melon soup to soothe restlessness caused by sweltering temperatures.
dialogue.zh: 食俗上也推薦多吃蓮藕、冬瓜排骨湯等清淡食材，安撫因悶熱高溫引發的心神煩躁。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Harmonizing our diet and daily routine with nature's seasonal pulse keeps our spirits tranquil through the heat.
dialogue.zh: 順應大自然的季節節奏來調和飲食與作息，能讓身心在炎炎盛夏中始終保有一份寧靜安舒。

vocabulary.example: Small lizards darted into stone wall crevices.
Fans whirred tirelessly in the sweltering greenhouse.
The mountain lake was tranquil at dawn.

dailyPhrase.zh: 三伏天、一年中最悶熱難耐的盛夏時節。

cultureTip: 小暑（Minor Heat）後緊接著進入「三伏天（Dog days of summer）」，此時是一年中陽氣最旺盛的時節。中醫傳統運用「冬病夏治」理念施打「三伏貼（Sanfu herbal acupoints）」，增強呼吸系統免疫力。

topic.en: Urban Heat Island Effect: Architecture & Climate Adaptation
topic.zh: 盛夏熱浪與都市熱島效應：極端氣候下的人道建築與城市韌性

situation: 高二地理建築研究小組的 Ryan 和 Claire 站在市中心天橋上，用紅外線熱成像儀測量柏油路面與綠地溫差。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Claire, look at the thermal infrared reading. The sun-baked asphalt over there exceeds fifty-two degrees Celsius, whereas the park lawn is ten degrees cooler.
dialogue.zh: Claire，看看紅外線熱像儀的數值。那邊曝曬的柏油路面溫度居然飆破了攝氏五十二度，而公園草皮卻整整低了十度。

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: That is the Urban Heat Island effect in stark reality. Concrete canyons trap solar radiation while vehicular exhaust and air conditioner compressors spew anthropogenic heat.
dialogue.zh: 這正是都市熱島效應最赤裸殘酷的現實。鋼筋水泥大樓形成的都會峽谷困住太陽輻射，而車輛廢氣與冷氣壓縮機又持續噴吐人為廢熱。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: This is not merely an inconvenience; extreme prolonged heat waves pose severe cardiovascular health hazards, disproportionately impacting elderly and lower-income residents.
dialogue.zh: 這絕不僅僅是不舒服而已；極端持續的熱浪會引發嚴重的心血管健康危機，並對長者與弱勢基層居民造成不成比例的致命衝擊。

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: Urban planners must transition toward climate-resilient architecture: mandate green rooftop gardens, permeable pavements, and urban wind corridors.
dialogue.zh: 都市規劃者必須加速向具氣候韌性的綠建築轉型：強制推行綠色屋頂花園、透水鋪面以及打通城市導風廊道。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Reflective 'cool roofs' coated with titanium dioxide paint can reflect up to eighty percent of sunlight back into outer space.
dialogue.zh: 塗有二氧化鈦塗層的反射型『冷屋頂』，甚至能把高達百分之八十的日照熱量直接反射回外太空。

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.en: Re-integrating nature into metropolis infrastructure is our only viable safeguard against an increasingly scorching Anthropocene.
dialogue.zh: 將大自然生態重新縫合進現代大都會的基礎建設中，是我們抵抗日益灼熱的人類世環境唯一可行的自救屏障。

vocabulary.zh: 由人類活動引起的、人為的
vocabulary.example: Scientists documented anthropogenic emissions driving global heating.
Permeable brick sidewalks allow rainwater to recharge the soil.

vocabulary.zh: 人類世（地質年代新名詞）
vocabulary.example: Human dominance over planetary cycles defines the Anthropocene epoch.

dailyPhrase.zh: 殘酷的現實、歷歷在目的真相。

cultureTip: 都市熱島效應（Urban Heat Island Effect）造成市中心氣溫顯著高於郊區。現代永續都市設計倡導建立「風廊（wind corridors）」、推廣「透水鋪面（permeable pavements）」與「綠屋頂（green roofs）」，減緩極端高溫衝擊。

topic.en: Building Sandcastles at the Beach: Seashells & Moats
topic.zh: 到海灘堆沙堡：貝殼裝飾與挖防波護城河

situation: 週末的海邊沙灘上，Ben 和 Ruby 拿著黃色塑膠小鏟子和紅水桶，興高采烈地築起一座堅固的沙堡。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Ruby, pack the damp sand tightly into this castle-shaped plastic bucket!
dialogue.zh: Ruby，把濕潤的沙子緊緊壓進這個城堡形狀的塑膠桶裡！

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.en: Flip it upside down... one, two, tap tap! Wow, look at the four sturdy towers!
dialogue.zh: 把它倒扣過來……一、二，輕輕敲兩下！哇，你看那四座結實挺立的塔樓！

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: I am digging a deep moat around the walls using my yellow shovel to block approaching waves.
dialogue.zh: 我正用黃色小鏟子在城牆周圍挖一條深深的護城河，用來阻擋衝上來的小海浪。

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.en: I collected shiny spiral seashells and white coral fragments to decorate the castle gates.
dialogue.zh: 我撿了許多閃亮的螺旋小貝殼和白色珊瑚碎石，用來裝飾城堡的大門口。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Our majestic sand palace is complete! Building things with our own hands on the beach is magical.
dialogue.zh: 我們雄偉的沙灘宮殿大功告成啦！親手在海灘上建造城堡的感覺真神奇。

vocabulary.example: The medieval fortress was guarded by a deep water moat.
Children combed the shoreline for colorful seashells.
The cruise ship glided past majestic snow-capped peaks.

dailyPhrase.zh: 把它上下倒扣翻轉過來。

cultureTip: 堆沙堡（Sandcastle building）是全球海灘文化的經典童年體驗。利用略帶水分的濕沙（damp sand）才能靠水分子表面張力黏合出堅固的塔樓（towers）與護城河（moats）。

topic.en: Preventing Heatstroke: Hydration and Electrolytes in Summer
topic.zh: 夏日防中暑大作戰：補充電解質與高溫戶外安全守則

situation: 夏令營操場活動中場休息，隊輔志工 Daniel 正在提醒隊員 Emily 正確補充足量水分與電解質，預防熱衰竭。

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.en: Emily, drink some water immediately! Your cheeks are flushed bright red and you are sweating profusely.
dialogue.zh: Emily，快喝點水！你的雙頰曬得通紅，而且汗流浹背呢。

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.en: Phew, running in the midday sun really drained my stamina. My mouth feels as dry as a desert.
dialogue.zh: 呼，頂著正午烈日奔跑真的把我的體力榨乾了。我的嘴巴乾得像沙漠一樣。

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.en: Don't chug plain water too rapidly. When we sweat heavily, our bodies lose vital minerals and sodium.
dialogue.zh: 不要一口氣大口猛灌白開水。當我們大量流汗時，身體同時流失了關鍵的礦物質與鈉離子。

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.en: Right. Drinking an electrolyte sports beverage diluted with cold water restores cellular balance faster.
dialogue.zh: 對的。喝加水稀釋的電解質運動飲料，能更快速恢復細胞的體液平衡。

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.en: Let's rest in this air-conditioned shade for fifteen minutes. Never ignore early warning signals of heat exhaustion.
dialogue.zh: 我們在這個有遮蔭通風的地方休息十五分鐘吧。絕對不能輕忽熱衰竭與中暑的早期預警信號。

vocabulary.example: The marathoner was sweating profusely near the finish.
He chugged a tall glass of iced tea after gym class.
Electrolyte solutions help treat dehydration during fever.

dailyPhrase.zh: 傾聽身體發出的警訊信號。

cultureTip: 大量出汗時如果只狂灌純水，容易引發「水中毒（低血鈉症 Hyponatremia）」。運動醫學建議以「少量多次（sip slowly）」方式補充含有鈉、鉀的電解質水（electrolyte drink），並移至蔭涼處（cool shade）散熱。

topic.en: World Population Day: Global Aging & Future Labor Dynamics
topic.zh: 世界人口日：全球超高齡社會、少子化與未來勞動力結構思辨

situation: 7月11日世界人口日，公民經濟論壇上，高中生 Jason 和 Maya 就東亞少子化現象與養老金體系展開思辨。

dialogue.speaker: Jason
dialogue.en: Maya, today is United Nations World Population Day. While global population surpassed eight billion, fertility rates across East Asia have plummeted drastically.
dialogue.zh: Maya，今天是聯合國世界人口日。儘管全球總人口已突破八十億大關，但東亞各國的生育率卻面臨斷崖式驟跌。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Our society is transitioning into a 'super-aged' demographic where over twenty percent of citizens are senior citizens aged sixty-five or above.
dialogue.zh: 我們的社會正迅速步入『超高齡社會』結構：六十五歲以上的長者人口佔比正式突破總人口的百分之二十。

dialogue.speaker: Jason
dialogue.en: The economic ripple effects are monumental—a shrinking working-age demographic strains public healthcare budgets and destabilizes pension solvency.
dialogue.zh: 這所引發的經濟骨牌效應是巨大的——勞動年齡人口萎縮，將嚴重吃緊公共健保預算，並衝擊勞退年金體系的財務永續平衡。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Merely offering superficial cash subsidies fails to reverse the trend when prohibitive housing costs and intense career pressures dissuade young adults from starting families.
dialogue.zh: 當高昂房價與高壓職場文化讓年輕世代對成家卻步時，單純發放一次性生育補貼顯然難以逆轉趨勢。

dialogue.speaker: Jason
dialogue.en: Robotics automation and generative AI may bridge labor gaps in manufacturing and eldercare, but systemic institutional adaptation remains urgent.
dialogue.zh: 機器人自動化與生成式 AI 或許能填補製造業與照護領域的勞動力缺口，但體制層面的全方位變革依舊迫在眉睫。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Reimagining retirement not as passive obsolescence, but as active lifelong engagement, will reshape social cohesion for generations ahead.
dialogue.zh: 重新定義退休生活：不再將其視為被動的退出舞台，而是作為積極的終身社會參與，將重塑未來世代的凝聚力。

vocabulary.example: Birth rates plummeted to historic lows during the recession.

vocabulary.zh: 令人望而卻步的、過於高昂的（價格）
vocabulary.example: The prohibitive cost of housing discourages young buyers.
Technological advancements accelerate product obsolescence.

dailyPhrase.zh: 連鎖反應、骨牌效應。

cultureTip: 7月11日是聯合國「世界人口日（World Population Day）」。台灣預計於 2025~2026 年邁入「超高齡社會（Super-aged society）」，人口學家呼籲推動銀髮勞動力活化（Active Aging）與友善托育環境。

topic.en: Alpine Camping Experience: Pitching Tents & Milky Way Gazing
topic.zh: 高山露營初體驗：搭設雙人帳篷與仰望無光害銀河

situation: 週末在合歡山高海拔露營區，Dylan 和 Chloe 跟隨戶外社團在星空下搭好帳篷，抬頭仰望燦爛的夏季銀河。

dialogue.speaker: Dylan
dialogue.en: Chloe, hammer those aluminum tent pegs deeply into the turf at a forty-five-degree angle against the mountain wind.
dialogue.zh: Chloe，把那些鋁合金營釘以四十五度角深深敲進草皮裡，這樣才能抵禦強勁的高山陣風。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: I secured the rainfly tautly. The elevation here is over two thousand meters, so the night air feels chilly!
dialogue.zh: 我把外帳防雨布拉得緊繃牢固了。這裡海拔超過兩千公尺，夜裡的空氣真冷颼颼呀！

dialogue.speaker: Dylan
dialogue.en: Turn off your headlamp and let our eyes adapt to complete darkness for five minutes.
dialogue.zh: 關掉你的頭燈，讓我們的眼睛在完全的黑暗中適應五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Oh, wow! Look straight up! A luminous, misty river of billions of stars is spanning across the entire zenith!
dialogue.zh: 天啊，哇！直接往頭頂看！一條由億萬顆恆星組成的璀璨銀白光霧長河，橫跨在整個夜空天頂中央！

dialogue.speaker: Dylan
dialogue.en: That is the core of our Milky Way galaxy! In the city, heavy light pollution washes out all these celestial wonders.
dialogue.zh: 那就是我們銀河系的璀璨核心！在都市裡，嚴重的光害把所有這些宇宙奇觀全都抹煞遮蔽了。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Under this infinite starry canopy, you truly grasp how vast the universe is and how humble we humans are.
dialogue.zh: 在浩瀚無垠的星空穹頂之下，你才能真正深刻體會到宇宙有多麼宏大，而我們人類又是多麼謙卑渺小。

vocabulary.example: The summer sun reached its zenith directly overhead at noon.

vocabulary.zh: 發光的、夜光的、燦爛明亮的
vocabulary.example: Luminous watch hands glowed green in the dark tent.
We slept under an expansive starry canopy of clear alpine sky.

dailyPhrase.zh: 沖刷掉、掩蓋使失色淡化。

cultureTip: 合歡山暗空公園（Hehuan Mountain Dark Sky Park）是國際認證的無光害觀星勝地。夏季是觀賞銀河核心（Milky Way Galaxy Core）的最佳時機，壯麗的人馬座與天蠍座橫跨天頂（zenith）。

topic.en: Picnic in the Shade: Chilled Mango Slices & Croissants
topic.zh: 大樹蔭下的野餐：冰鎮芒果切片與香脆可頌麵包

situation: 週日下午，Lucas 和 Lily 在植物園的大樟樹下鋪開紅白格子野餐墊，享用媽媽準備的冰涼芒果和金黃可頌。

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.en: Lily, spread the red-and-white checkered picnic blanket flat under this giant camphor tree.
dialogue.zh: Lily，把這張紅白格子的野餐墊在這棵大樟樹下鋪平坦吧。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: The thick green tree canopy blocks out all harsh sun rays. It feels nice and cool here.
dialogue.zh: 茂密翠綠的樹冠把所有刺眼的陽光都擋住了。這裡感覺又涼爽又舒服。

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.en: Open our cooler bag! I packed cold Irwin mango cubes in a glass container.
dialogue.zh: 打開我們的保冷袋！我把切成方塊的冰愛文芒果裝在玻璃保鮮盒裡呢。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: The mango is so sweet and juicy! Take a buttery croissant; they are still flaky and warm.
dialogue.zh: 這芒果太甜太爆汁了！拿一個奶油可頌吧，外皮依然金黃酥脆而且微溫呢。

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.en: Eating good food with pleasant bird songs above our heads makes summer vacation pure magic.
dialogue.zh: 頭頂上有悅耳鳥鳴陪伴，一邊享用美味點心，讓暑假變得像童話一樣美妙。

vocabulary.example: She bought a vintage checkered tablecloth for outdoor dining.
A freshly baked croissant should be crisp outside and airy inside.
The French pastry crust was exceptionally buttery and flaky.

dailyPhrase.zh: 阻擋、遮蔽（陽光或噪音）。

cultureTip: 夏日野餐（Summer Picnic）講求選在有大樹遮蔽的陰涼處（in the shade）。使用保冷袋（cooler bag）保持當季切塊水果的低溫新鮮，是戶外用餐的安全美味秘訣。

topic.en: Scorpius and Antares: The Fiery Red Giant of the Summer Sky
topic.zh: 夏夜星空之王：認識天蠍座的心宿二大火星

situation: 夏夜晴朗無雲，Sam 和 Olivia 在校園天文台的屋頂平台上，拿著星圖認辨南方的天蠍座與紅巨星心宿二。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Olivia, look low toward the southern horizon! Do you see that dramatic curved hook of bright stars?
dialogue.zh: Olivia，往南方低空的地平線看！你有看到那串排列成醒目大彎鉤的明亮星星嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.en: Yes! That is Scorpius, the magnificent celestial scorpion of the summer night sky!
dialogue.zh: 看到了！那就是天蠍座，夏夜星空中最霸氣雄偉的宇宙巨蠍！

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Look right at the scorpion's heart—there is a prominent star glowing with a fierce reddish-orange hue.
dialogue.zh: 看那隻蠍子的心臟位置——有一顆顯眼的恆星正散發著炙熱的橙紅色光芒呢。

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.en: That is Antares, an enormous red supergiant star over seven hundred times larger than our Sun!
dialogue.zh: 那就是『心宿二（Antares）』，一顆體積比我們的太陽還要巨大七百倍以上的超巨星！

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Ancient Chinese astronomers called it the 'Fire Star' because its brilliant redness warned of midsummer heat.
dialogue.zh: 中國古代天文學家稱它為『大火星』，因為它璀璨奪目的紅光提醒著人們盛夏嚴熱已至。

vocabulary.example: The prominent church spire was visible for miles around.
Antares and Betelgeuse are celebrated red supergiants.
The sun dipped below the ocean horizon at dusk.

dailyPhrase.zh: 預警……的到來、提醒留意……。

cultureTip: 天蠍座（Scorpius）是夏季夜空最壯麗的星座。其心臟處的「心宿二（Antares，古希臘語意為『火星的對手』）」在中國古代稱為「大火」，《詩經》名句「七月流火」指的正是盛夏農曆七月大火星西沉、天氣將轉涼的景象。

topic.en: World Youth Skills Day: Irreplaceable Human Skills in the AI Era
topic.zh: 世界青年技能日：AI 浪潮下不可替代的人性軟實力與創造力

situation: 7月15日世界青年技能日，國際青年就業線上論壇上，高中生 Victor 和 Irene 分享科技時代青年應具備的核心競爭力。

dialogue.speaker: Victor
dialogue.en: Irene, on this World Youth Skills Day, generative AI models can synthesize code, draft essays, and analyze balance sheets in seconds.
dialogue.zh: Irene，在世界青年技能日的今天，生成式 AI 已經能在幾秒鐘內編寫程式碼、撰寫論文，甚至分析企業資產負債表。

dialogue.speaker: Irene
dialogue.en: That automated efficiency creates acute anxiety among students. If repetitive technical tasks are automated, what constitutes durable human competence?
dialogue.zh: 那種自動化的高效確實引發了廣大青年學子的焦慮。如果重複性的技術任務被機器取代，究竟什麼才是經久不衰的人類核心競爭力？

dialogue.speaker: Victor
dialogue.en: The World Economic Forum highlights critical thinking, complex collaborative negotiation, and ethical judgment as uniquely human faculties.
dialogue.zh: 世界經濟論壇特別指出：批判性思維、複雜跨界協商以及道德倫理判斷力，是唯有人類才具備的獨特心智能力。

dialogue.speaker: Irene
dialogue.en: AI mimics existing patterns; it cannot generate radical empathetic curiosity or navigate moral dilemmas where all choices carry painful trade-offs.
dialogue.zh: AI 只是在模仿既有的大數據模式；它無法產生富有同理心的人文好奇，也無法在面臨兩難抉擇時體會道德權衡的痛苦深度。

dialogue.speaker: Victor
dialogue.en: Youth must cultivate a 'T-shaped' skill profile: deep domain expertise coupled with broad adaptability across interdisciplinary boundaries.
dialogue.zh: 青年必須培養『T型人才』的技能輪廓：深耕某一特定專業領域，同時具備跨學科邊界的廣闊適應力。

dialogue.speaker: Irene
dialogue.en: Instead of racing against machines, our mission is to wield technology as an amplifier of our fundamental humanity and creativity.
dialogue.zh: 與其試圖與機器賽跑，我們新世代的使命應當是把科技化為放大鏡，放大我們最根本的人性溫度與非凡創造力。

vocabulary.example: Linguistic competence enables seamless cross-cultural diplomacy.
Bioinformatics is a vibrant interdisciplinary research field.
Education acts as a powerful amplifier of personal potential.

dailyPhrase.zh: 與機器競爭（引申為在自動化浪潮中尋找人類獨特價值）。

cultureTip: 7月15日是聯合國「世界青年技能日（World Youth Skills Day）」。在人工智慧快速發展的當下，倡導發展「T-shaped skills（T型技能）」：垂直具備深厚專業底蘊，水平具備同理心、跨域合作與思辨判斷的軟實力。

topic.en: Aquarium Ocean Tunnel: Manta Rays and Gliding Sea Turtles
topic.zh: 逛水族館海底隧道：近距離看魔鬼魚與海龜滑行

situation: 夏令營參觀國立海洋生物博物館，Tyler 和 Amy 站在透明壓克力海底隧道內，仰望巨型魟魚從頭頂悠然掠過。

dialogue.speaker: Tyler
dialogue.en: Amy, look straight above our heads through this curved glass tunnel! An enormous creature is gliding over us!
dialogue.zh: Amy，透過這條弧形玻璃隧道往我們正頭頂上看！一隻巨大的生物正在我們頭頂滑翔過去呢！

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: Wow, that is a giant manta ray! Its wide fins flap slowly like underwater bird wings.
dialogue.zh: 哇，那是一隻巨大的魔鬼氈魟魚！它寬大的胸鰭慢慢拍動，就像在水下飛翔的鳥類翅膀一樣。

dialogue.speaker: Tyler
dialogue.en: And look to your left! A gentle green sea turtle is paddling gracefully beside the coral reef.
dialogue.zh: 再看你的左邊！一隻溫柔的綠蠵龜正優雅地在珊瑚礁旁撥水前進呢。

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: Being surrounded on all sides by shimmering blue water feels like scuba diving without getting wet.
dialogue.zh: 被閃閃發光的碧藍海水全方位包圍，感覺就像沒有弄濕衣服就潛進了深海一樣。

dialogue.speaker: Tyler
dialogue.en: Let's snap a picture together with the smiling manta ray in the background!
dialogue.zh: 我們跟背景裡那隻看似在微笑的魟魚一起拍張合照紀念吧！

vocabulary.example: Manta rays filter plankton peacefully in tropical waters.
Sunlight danced on the shimmering surface of the bay.
The shark's dorsal fin sliced through the calm water.

dailyPhrase.zh: 拍張照、拍張相片留念。

cultureTip: 水族館海底隧道（Aquarium Ocean Tunnel）採用高強度厚層壓克力玻璃（acrylic glass）。走在隧道中觀察鬼蝠魟（Manta Ray）與海龜滑行，能建立孩子對海洋生態的珍視與熱愛。

topic.en: Youth Volunteering: Sorting Surplus Food at the Food Bank
topic.zh: 青年志工體驗：在社區食物銀行整理愛心惜食物資

situation: 暑期志工服務日，David 和 Chloe 在非營利食物銀行倉庫戴著棉手套，分類超市捐贈的蔬菜與罐頭食品。

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.en: Chloe, check the expiration dates on these canned black beans and whole-grain oats before boxing them.
dialogue.zh: Chloe，在把這些黑豆罐頭和全麥燕麥裝箱前，先仔細核對一下有效保存期限喔。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Will do. It is staggering to learn that over thirty percent of edible food is discarded globally while millions experience hunger.
dialogue.zh: 好的。得知全球有超過三成的可食用糧食被白白浪費丟棄，而同時卻有數百萬人面臨飢餓，真令人震驚。

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.en: Food banks rescue perfectly fresh produce with slight cosmetic blemishes that grocery stores reject.
dialogue.zh: 食物銀行及時搶救了許多只因外觀稍有微小瑕疵、而被一般超市下架淘汰的優質新鮮蔬果。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: We packed forty family relief hampers this morning containing rice, milk powder, cooking oil, and fresh carrots.
dialogue.zh: 我們今天上午已經打包好了四十份家庭救助物資箱，裡面有白米、奶粉、食用油以及新鮮紅蘿蔔。

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.en: Sweating during summer volunteer work feels infinitely more rewarding than lounging aimlessly on the couch.
dialogue.zh: 在夏天當志工揮灑汗水，感覺比無所事事癱在沙發上要有意義、有成就感幾萬倍。

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.en: Small compassionate gestures weave a stronger social safety net for vulnerable families in our neighborhood.
dialogue.zh: 微小而溫暖的善行，能為我們社區裡的弱勢弱勢家庭編織出一張更堅實溫暖的社會安全網。

vocabulary.example: Ugly produce with slight surface blemishes is equally nutritious.
Volunteers delivered food hampers to homebound seniors.

vocabulary.zh: 富有同情心的、慈悲關懷的
vocabulary.example: The social worker provided compassionate counsel to the family.

dailyPhrase.zh: 社會安全網。

cultureTip: 食物銀行（Food Bank）推動「食物零浪費（Zero food waste）」，搶救因外表不完美（ugly produce / cosmetic blemishes）但品質無虞的食材轉贈弱勢。青年參與志工服務（Community volunteering）是英美與台灣高中大學申請極重視的公共素養。

topic.en: Homemade Mango Shaved Ice: Drizzling Sweet Condensed Milk
topic.zh: 自己動手做香甜芒果雪花冰：淋上香濃煉乳與自製黑糖水

situation: 星期天下午，Eric 和 Mia 拿出家裡的電動刨冰機，親手做一碗台式芒果雪花冰招待來訪的朋友。

dialogue.speaker: Eric
dialogue.en: Mia, turn on the electric ice shaver! Fine, fluffy snowflakes are cascading into the wide ceramic bowl!
dialogue.zh: Mia，打開電動刨冰機！細緻綿密的雪白刨冰就像瀑布一樣紛紛落進寬口大瓷碗裡了！

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: Now let's generously pile these chilled golden mango cubes all over the snowy shaved ice mountain.
dialogue.zh: 現在我們把這些冰涼的金黃芒果大丁，豪邁地鋪滿整座雪白刨冰山周圍吧。

dialogue.speaker: Eric
dialogue.en: Spoon a giant scoop of creamy vanilla ice cream right onto the snowy peak.
dialogue.zh: 在雪山頂端端正放上一大球香濃細緻的香草冰淇淋。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: And the ultimate finishing touch: drizzle a generous swirl of sweet condensed milk all over!
dialogue.zh: 還有最後的終極靈魂點綴：在整座冰山淋上一圈圈香濃甜美的煉乳！

dialogue.speaker: Eric
dialogue.en: Take a big spoonful! The icy crunch melting with rich tropical sweetness is pure paradise!
dialogue.zh: 大口挖一勺送進嘴裡！冰涼爽脆的刨冰搭配濃郁的熱帶果香在舌尖融化，簡直就是人間天堂！

vocabulary.example: Shaved ice cascaded smoothly into the waiting glass.
Drizzle sweet condensed milk over shaved ice desserts.
The secluded sandy cove was a tropical beach paradise.

dailyPhrase.zh: 最後的畫龍點睛之筆。

cultureTip: 芒果刨冰（Mango Shaved Ice）被 CNN 評選為全球最佳甜品之一。金黃芒果塊（mango cubes）、香草冰淇淋（ice cream scoop）搭配甜煉乳（condensed milk），是台灣聞名全球的夏日美食代表作。

topic.en: Deep-Sea Mining Dilemma: Energy Transition vs. Marine Ecosystems
topic.zh: 深海採礦爭議：綠色能源轉型金屬需求與深海生態浩劫的兩難

situation: 高二地球科學與國際關係社團中，Sean 和 Melody 針對國際海底管理局（ISA）開放深海錳結核開採的環境倫理展開交鋒。

dialogue.speaker: Sean
dialogue.en: Melody, the debate at the International Seabed Authority is intensifying over deep-sea mining of polymetallic nodules.
dialogue.zh: Melody，國際海底管理局針對深海多金屬結核商業開採的辯論正在急劇白熱化。

dialogue.speaker: Melody
dialogue.en: Mining proponents argue these abyssal potato-sized rocks rich in cobalt, nickel, and manganese are indispensable for electric vehicle batteries and the green transition.
dialogue.zh: 開採支持者主張：這些深海深淵中富含鈷、鎳、錳等金屬如馬鈴薯般大小的結核石，是製造電動車電池與推動綠色能源轉型不可或缺的戰略原料。

dialogue.speaker: Sean
dialogue.en: Yet marine biologists warn that scraping the benthic seabed four thousand meters down will destroy pristine ecosystems that took millions of years to form.
dialogue.zh: 但海洋生物學家強烈警告：刮削四千公尺深的深海底棲層，將毀滅歷經數百萬年才演化形成的原始脆弱深海生態系。

dialogue.speaker: Melody
dialogue.en: The sediment plumes stirred up by heavy dredging machinery could choke midwater filter feeders and disrupt bioluminescent communications across vast ocean expanses.
dialogue.zh: 巨型採礦重機械攪起的龐大海底沉積物濁水羽流，會窒息中層水域的濾食性生物，並阻斷廣闊海域中深海生物發光求偶通訊。

dialogue.speaker: Sean
dialogue.en: It presents a classic planetary paradox: destroying our ocean's deepest sanctuaries in order to decarbonize terrestrial transport.
dialogue.zh: 這呈現了一個典型的地球難題悖論：為了解救陸地交通達到脫碳目標，我們卻可能親手摧毀地球最深邃神秘的海洋庇護所。

dialogue.speaker: Melody
dialogue.en: True sustainability cannot come from plundering new frontiers. Developing circular battery chemistry and recycling existing metals must precede irreversible deep-sea destruction.
dialogue.zh: 真正的永續絕不能建立在掠奪新邊疆的代價上。全力發展新型循環電池化學材料與既有金屬回收技術，必須優先於對深海造成不可逆的毀滅。

vocabulary.example: Polymetallic nodules resting on the abyssal plain contain rare minerals.
Benthic sea cucumbers feed on organic debris drifting from above.
Commercial greed plundered ancient forests beyond recovery.

dailyPhrase.zh: 地球級的難題悖論。

cultureTip: 「深海採礦（Deep-Sea Mining）」是國際地緣政治與環保最受矚目的爭議。克拉里恩-克利珀頓斷裂帶（CCZ）蘊藏豐富多金屬結核，環保團體發起「暫停開採倡議（Moratorium）」，要求優先推動電池循環回收。

topic.en: Moon Day: Apollo 11 Legacy & the Artemis Lunar Missions
topic.zh: 人類月球日：阿波羅十一號登月傳奇與重返月球的阿提米絲計畫

situation: 7月20日「國際月球日」，天文觀測社的 Tony 和 Clara 在校園天文鐘前討論人類登月歷史與未來的火星跳板計畫。

dialogue.speaker: Tony
dialogue.en: Clara, on this day in 1969, astronaut Neil Armstrong took his historic first step onto the lunar surface!
dialogue.zh: Clara，在 1969 年的這一天，太空人阿姆斯壯邁出了人類踏上月球表面的歷史性第一步！

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: His iconic immortal words still echo through history: 'That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind.'
dialogue.zh: 他那句標誌性的不朽名言至今仍在歷史中迴響：『這是我個人的一小步，卻是全人類的一大步。』

dialogue.speaker: Tony
dialogue.en: Imagine operating the lunar module with computer systems having less processing power than a basic modern pocket calculator.
dialogue.zh: 想像一下：當時駕駛登月小艇的電腦運算晶片能力，甚至比現在一具最基礎的口袋型計算機還要微弱呢。

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: Today, NASA's Artemis program is preparing to return humans to the Moon, establishing a permanent base camp near the lunar south pole.
dialogue.zh: 而今天，NASA 的阿提米絲（Artemis）計畫正準備讓人踏重返月球，並在月球南極附近建立永久基地營。

dialogue.speaker: Tony
dialogue.en: Harvesting frozen water ice trapped in permanently shadowed craters will supply drinking water and rocket propellant.
dialogue.zh: 開採深藏在月球永夜撞擊坑內的冰凍水冰，將能為太空人提供飲用水，更能分解成火箭推進燃料。

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: The Moon will serve as humanity's cosmic stepping stone toward Mars and the deeper mysteries of our solar system.
dialogue.zh: 月球將成為全人類邁向火星深處、探索太陽系更深奧秘的宇宙跳板踏腳石。

vocabulary.example: Shakespeare's plays achieved immortal cultural renown.
Telescopes clearly resolve jagged shadows inside lunar craters.
Liquid hydrogen and oxygen serve as high-efficiency rocket propellant.

dailyPhrase.zh: 邁向……的墊腳石、前進跳板。

cultureTip: 7月20日被聯合國指定為「國際月球日（International Moon Day）」，紀念 1969 年阿波羅 11 號登月。阿提米絲計畫（Artemis program）以希臘神話中阿波羅的孿生姐姐命名，象徵新世代深空探索重啟。

topic.en: Insect Museum Tour: Giant Beetles and Camouflaged Stick Insects
topic.zh: 參觀昆蟲博物館：認識世界上最大的甲蟲與偽裝大師竹節蟲

situation: 夏令營參訪昆蟲生態館，Ben 和 Ruby 透過透明玻璃展示箱，驚奇地尋找隱藏在枝葉間的竹節蟲。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Ruby, peer closely into this terrarium! Can you spot the insect hiding among the green twigs?
dialogue.zh: Ruby，貼近這個玻璃生態箱仔細瞧瞧！你能找出隱藏在綠色樹枝間的昆蟲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.en: Wait... that brown twig with tiny legs is moving! It is a giant walking stick insect!
dialogue.zh: 等等……那根長著細長小腳的褐色小樹枝正在動耶！那是一隻巨大的竹節蟲！

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Its camouflage is unbelievable! It looks one hundred percent identical to a dried tree branch.
dialogue.zh: 它的偽裝技術太不可思議了！看起來百分之百就跟一根乾枯的樹枝一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.en: And look at the next display: the Hercules beetle from the rainforest with a horn as long as my hand!
dialogue.zh: 再看隔壁展示櫃：來自雨林、長著跟我的手掌一樣長巨角的長戟大兜蟲！

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Nature has designed so many bizarre and brilliant survival adaptations.
dialogue.zh: 大自然為昆蟲設計了這麼多奇特又聰明的生存演化適應機制，真令人大開眼界。

vocabulary.example: Chameleons use color-changing camouflage to hide from predators.

vocabulary.zh: 玻璃爬蟲箱、玻璃生態缸
vocabulary.example: He planted moss and ferns inside a glass terrarium.
Deep-sea anglerfish have bizarre bioluminescent lures.

dailyPhrase.zh: 敏銳發現、看出某個隱藏事物。

cultureTip: 竹節蟲（Stick insect / Walking stick）展現了動物界極致的「擬態（MIMICRY）」與「偽裝（Camouflage）」。長戟大兜蟲（Hercules beetle）則是世界上體型最長的甲蟲，最長可達 18 公分。

topic.en: Dashu Solar Term: Major Heat, Sweet Pineapples & Summer Solace
topic.zh: 大暑節氣：一年中最炎熱的一天與吃鳳梨消暑民間習俗

situation: 時逢二十四節氣中的「大暑」，Leo 和 Jessica 坐在傳統冰果室裡，吹著電風扇享用新鮮現切的關廟金鑽鳳梨切片。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Jessica, the asphalt outside is practically shimmering in the blazing sun today. It is officially Dashu, or 'Major Heat'!
dialogue.zh: Jessica，今天外面馬路上的柏油在烈日曝曬下簡直都在發燙閃爍。今天正是『大暑』節氣！

dialogue.speaker: Jessica
dialogue.en: Dashu is the twelfth solar term and traditionally recognized as the hottest period of the entire solar calendar.
dialogue.zh: 大暑是第十二個節氣，也是農曆節氣中公認全年度氣溫最高、日照最猛烈的最酷熱時節。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Folk proverbs say: 'Eating pineapple on Dashu brings auspicious luck and cools down internal fire.'
dialogue.zh: 民間農諺常說：『大暑吃鳳梨』，不僅因為此時鳳梨最香甜多汁，更取其『旺來』祈求吉祥平順。

dialogue.speaker: Jessica
dialogue.en: Pineapples harvested around Dashu are at peak ripeness—bursting with golden sweetness without any mouth-stinging sourness.
dialogue.zh: 大暑前後採收的鳳梨熟度達到最巔峰——金黃果肉甜度極高，完全沒有咬舌頭的酸澀感。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: And in ancient times, fishermen floated miniature wooden 'Dashu boats' carrying offerings into the sea to pray for peace and epidemic prevention.
dialogue.zh: 古代沿海居民還有在『大暑送大暑船』的民俗，將滿載供品的彩繪小木船送出大海，祈求驅除暑熱疫病、闔家平安。

dialogue.speaker: Jessica
dialogue.en: When heat reaches its absolute extreme, autumn draws near. Nature always moves toward renewal and equilibrium.
dialogue.zh: 物極必反，大暑過後，秋天的腳步其實就已悄悄臨近了。大自然始終在循環中邁向新生與平衡。

vocabulary.example: Red lanterns were hung to mark the auspicious festival.
The fruits reached optimal sweetness at full ripeness.
Ecosystems maintain delicate equilibrium through biodiversity.

dailyPhrase.zh: 達到熟成的最巔峰黃金期。

cultureTip: 大暑（Major Heat）是一年中最熱的節氣。台灣民諺「大暑吃鳳梨」，此時盛產的金鑽鳳梨（Pineapple）風味最濃郁清甜；同時民間也認為大暑過後便是立秋，「大暑熱不透，大熱在秋後」。

topic.en: Stream Exploration: Catching Shrimp & Practicing Leave No Trace
topic.zh: 戶外野溪探索：觀察溪蝦與實踐無痕山林守則

situation: 週末郊外清涼溪流旁，Jason 和 Maya 捲起褲管站在淺溪鵝卵石上，拿著透明觀察箱觀察溪蝦和小溪哥魚。

dialogue.speaker: Jason
dialogue.en: Maya, step carefully on these rounded river pebbles. Some green algae rocks can be quite slippery.
dialogue.zh: Maya，踩在這些圓滾滾的溪流鵝卵石上要格外小心。有些長滿綠苔的石頭非常濕滑喔。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I am wearing non-slip felt-soled river tracing shoes! Look under that submerged flat rock—a tiny freshwater shrimp is swimming backward!
dialogue.zh: 我有穿防滑的毛氈底溯溪鞋！你看浸在水底的那塊平坦石頭下——有一隻小溪蝦正在倒退游呢！

dialogue.speaker: Jason
dialogue.en: I caught it gently in our transparent observation box. Its see-through body and long whiskers are so delicate.
dialogue.zh: 我用透明觀察箱輕輕把它撈進來了。它晶瑩剔透的透明身體和細長的觸鬚看起來好精巧脆弱。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Let's release it back into the crystal stream pool right away so it can continue thriving in its natural home.
dialogue.zh: 我們趕快把它放回這汪清澈的溪潭裡吧，讓它能繼續在天然家園裡自由自在地生活。

dialogue.speaker: Jason
dialogue.en: Take only pictures, leave only ripples, and carry every bit of trash home. That is Leave No Trace!
dialogue.zh: 只帶走相片，只留下水波漣漪，並把所有垃圾隨身帶回家。這正是無痕山林的真諦！

vocabulary.example: Smooth river pebbles lined the clear mountain creek.
The freshwater shrimp twitched its long sensory whiskers.
A dropped stone created concentric ripples on the lake.

dailyPhrase.zh: 無痕山林守則（戶外保育核心理念）。

cultureTip: 無痕山林（Leave No Trace, LNT）七大準則提倡：尊重野生動物、只留回憶不帶走生物、妥善處理垃圾。溪流戲水穿著防滑溯溪鞋（river tracing shoes），既安全又兼顧生態永續。

topic.en: Digital Nomadism: Geographical Freedom, Loneliness & Discipline
topic.zh: 數位遊牧與未來工作型態：地理自由背後的時間自律與孤獨思辨

situation: 在青年未來趨勢沙龍上，Alex 和 Brenda 就全球遠端辦公興起、數位遊牧族群（Digital Nomads）的理想與現實展開對話。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Brenda, social media constantly romanticizes digital nomadism: coding laptops on tropical beaches while traveling perpetually.
dialogue.zh: Brenda，社群媒體經常過度浪漫化數位遊牧生活：抱著筆電在熱帶海灘邊寫程式，一邊環遊世界一邊賺取高薪。

dialogue.speaker: Brenda
dialogue.en: That polished veneer obscures gritty realities. Glare makes screens unreadable in sunlight, sand destroys keyboards, and precarious Wi-Fi triggers client panics.
dialogue.zh: 那層光鮮亮麗的濾鏡掩蓋了骨感的現實。強光讓螢幕在戶外根本無法辨識，細沙會摧毀鍵盤，不穩定的網路更會引發客戶失聯危機。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: More profoundly, constant relocation severs deep communal roots. Transient friendships across hostels can precipitate chronic existential loneliness.
dialogue.zh: 更深層的問題在於，頻繁的流動遷徙會切斷穩固的在地社群歸屬。青年旅館裡萍水相逢的短暫友誼，很容易演化為慢性的存在主義孤獨感。

dialogue.speaker: Brenda
dialogue.en: True location independence demands relentless self-discipline, meticulous time-zone synchronization, and strict boundary separation between labor and leisure.
dialogue.zh: 真正的地理自由背後，需要的是鋼鐵般嚴格的自我自律、精準的跨時區協作，以及在工作勞動與休閒生活之間劃定清晰界線的能力。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Nonetheless, asynchronous distributed work is dismantling the obsolete industrial model of rigid nine-to-five commuter drudgery.
dialogue.zh: 儘管如此，非同步的分散式工作模式，確實正在瓦解傳統工業時代僵化打卡通勤、朝九晚五的枯燥模式。

dialogue.speaker: Brenda
dialogue.en: Freedom is not the absence of structure; it is the autonomy to build an intentional life architecture aligned with your core values.
dialogue.zh: 自由從來不是完全沒有架構拘束；自由是擁有自主權，去建構一套符合自己核心價值觀、帶著清晰自覺的生活建築體系。

vocabulary.zh: 虛假的外表、光鮮的飾面
vocabulary.example: Her calm smile was a thin veneer masking intense stage fright.

vocabulary.zh: 不穩定的、危險的、朝不保夕的
vocabulary.example: Freelancers often navigate precarious income fluctuations.
Automation relieved workers of repetitive data-entry drudgery.

dailyPhrase.zh: 地點獨立性、不受特定辦公地點限制的工作模式。

cultureTip: 「數位遊牧（Digital Nomadism）」隨著高速星鏈網路與遠端工作普及成為全球新興工作形態。自由工作者（freelancers）與遠距工作者透過「非同步溝通（asynchronous communication）」實現全球旅居，但極度考驗時間自律與心理韌性。

topic.en: Sudden Summer Rain: Watching Puddles Ripple from the Porch
topic.zh: 午後雷陣雨的浪漫：在騎樓下靜看雨滴在水窪泛起漣漪

situation: 盛夏午後突然下起傾盆大雨，Leo 和 Mia 站在文具店騎樓下躲雨，靜靜看著街角水窪裡一圈圈擴散的雨波。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Mia, step under the covered arcade! The sky opened up with a sudden summer downpour!
dialogue.zh: Mia，快跨進騎樓遮雨廊下！天空突然下起了傾盆的盛夏大雨！

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: Listen to the rain drumming on the tin awning! It sounds like natural percussion music.
dialogue.zh: 聽雨水劈劈啪啪打在鐵皮雨棚上的聲音！聽起來真像大自然的打擊樂演奏一樣。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Look at the big puddle on the sidewalk. Each falling raindrop creates expanding concentric rings.
dialogue.zh: 看人行道上那個大水窪。每一顆落下的雨滴都在水面上泛起一圈圈向外擴散的同心圓水波呢。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: The moist air smells so fresh and cool. It washed away all the dust and oppressive heat.
dialogue.zh: 濕潤的空氣聞起來好清新涼爽。它把空氣中所有的灰塵和令人窒息的悶熱都沖刷得一乾二淨了。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Pausing our steps to watch a summer rain shower makes you appreciate the quiet rhythm of nature.
dialogue.zh: 停下匆忙腳步靜靜看一場夏雨，真能讓人體會到大自然寧靜而美麗的韻律節奏。

vocabulary.example: Pedestrians walked comfortably sheltered beneath the street arcade.
Ripples spread outward in expanding concentric circles.

vocabulary.zh: 悶熱窒息的、令人壓抑難受的
vocabulary.example: The oppressive heat finally broke when evening thunderstorms arrived.

dailyPhrase.zh: 突然下起傾盆大雨、大雨如注。

cultureTip: 台灣與東南亞建築常見「騎樓（covered arcade / shophouse walkways）」，提供遮陽避雨功能。英文中的「The smell of rain」有一個優美專有名詞「Petrichor（潮土仕 / 雨後泥土芳香）」，由泥土中的放線菌化合物釋放而成。

topic.en: Rollerblading & Scootering: Putting on Helmets & Protective Pads
topic.zh: 學騎滑板車與直排輪：戴好安全帽與護肘護膝安全防護

situation: 傍晚陽光不再熾熱，Sammy 和 Noah 在社區體育公園滑輪場穿戴好護具，練習直排輪轉彎平衡技巧。

dialogue.speaker: Sammy
dialogue.en: Noah, before we step onto the roller rink, let me inspect your safety gear.
dialogue.zh: Noah，在我們滑進直排輪場地之前，先讓我檢查一下你的防護裝備。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: I strapped on my hard plastic knee pads, elbow pads, and wrist guards securely.
dialogue.zh: 我的硬質塑膠護膝、護肘還有手腕護具全都緊緊扣好了。

dialogue.speaker: Sammy
dialogue.en: Click your helmet chin buckle firmly until it clicks. Safety always comes first!
dialogue.zh: 安全帽的下巴扣環也要用力扣上直到聽到『喀噠』一聲。安全永遠排在第一位！

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Watch me glide! Bend your knees slightly forward and push off gently in a V-formation.
dialogue.zh: 看我滑行！膝蓋稍微向前微彎，雙腳腳尖微微朝外呈 V 字型輕柔推蹬發力。

dialogue.speaker: Sammy
dialogue.en: Feel the evening wind whistling past our ears! Gliding smoothly on wheels feels like flying!
dialogue.zh: 感受晚風在我們耳邊呼呼吹過！腳踩輪子平穩滑行的感覺簡直就像在低空飛翔一樣痛快！

vocabulary.example: Fasten the buckle on your backpack securely.
Skilled skaters glide effortlessly across smooth concrete.
The outdoor roller rink was crowded with energetic kids.

dailyPhrase.zh: 安全永遠第一、安全至上。

cultureTip: 輪滑運動（Rollerblading / Inline Skating）訓練平衡感與下肢協調性。運動醫學強調配戴「三合一護具（Knee, elbow & wrist guards）」及符合安全規範的安全帽，可預防 90% 以上的擦傷與骨折意外。

topic.en: DIY Claymation Short Film: Storyboarding with a Smartphone
topic.zh: 自製定格動畫短片：用輕黏土與智慧型手機創作童話故事

situation: 暑假創客工作坊裡，Julian 和 Hannah 在客廳書桌架好手機三腳架與補光燈，一格格拍攝自創的太空小怪獸黏土定格動畫。

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: Hannah, keep the smartphone tripod completely stationary. If the camera wobbles, the stop-motion effect looks jerky.
dialogue.zh: Hannah，手機三腳架一定要保持絕對靜止不動。如果鏡頭有一絲搖晃，定格動畫看起來就會卡頓突兀。

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: I locked the exposure and manual focus. Now, move the green clay alien's left tentacle by just two millimeters.
dialogue.zh: 我已經鎖定好曝光與手動對焦了。現在，把綠色黏土小外星人的左觸手只輕輕移動兩毫米。

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: Snap! Move two millimeters... snap! Producing one second of smooth animation requires twelve individual frames.
dialogue.zh: 拍一張！再移動兩毫米……再拍一張！要做出流暢的一秒鐘動畫，足足需要十二張獨立畫面呢。

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: It takes immense patience, but watching a lifeless lump of colorful clay miraculously spring to life is pure enchantment.
dialogue.zh: 這需要極大的耐心，但看著一團毫無生氣的彩色黏土在螢幕上奇蹟般活靈活現動起來，簡直就像被施了魔法一樣迷人。

dialogue.speaker: Julian
dialogue.en: After shooting the frames, we will import them into an editing app and record funny monster squeaks and laser sound effects.
dialogue.zh: 拍攝完畫面之後，我們把照片匯入剪輯軟體，再親自配音怪獸叫聲與雷射光音效。

dialogue.speaker: Hannah
dialogue.en: Filmmaking blends storytelling, manual sculpting, and technology into a rewarding artistic journey.
dialogue.zh: 拍動畫將說故事、手工雕塑與數位科技完美融合為一體，真是充滿成就感的藝術探索旅程。

vocabulary.zh: 靜止不動的、固定不變的
vocabulary.example: Keep the microscope stationary while focusing on the specimen.
Cinema film traditionally projects twenty-four frames per second.

vocabulary.zh: 著迷、陶醉、魔法般的魅力
vocabulary.example: The fairy tale forest filled children with wonder and enchantment.
